 Normal reboot
 Reboot to recovery
 Reboot to bootloader
 App shortcuts support
 Intent-based launch and exit support

fdroid:com.huntercoles.pokerpayout.name: Poker Payout
fdroid:com.huntercoles.pokerpayout.summary: Poker timer and blind clock for Texas Hold'em home games: payouts, buy-ins, bank
fdroid:com.huntercoles.pokerpayout.description:
A poker tournament timer and blind clock for home games, with payouts that add up to the cent and a bank of who paid what.
Enter the players, buy-in, rebuys, add-ons and bounties once. The poker clock raises the blinds on schedule, the payout calculator follows the prize pool, and Settle up says who pays whom. Made for a Texas Hold'em home game, and fine for any tournament poker. Works offline: no internet permission, no account, no ads.
TOURNAMENT CLOCK
• Set up the night once: players, buy-in, bounty, rebuys and late entry (each with a cutoff), add-ons, food and an optional house rake. Save it as a preset, or start from a ready-made night
• Blinds from four numbers: game length, level length, starting stack and smallest chip. Every level is a multiple of your smallest chip, and a setup that can't work says why and offers the nearest fix
• A blind timer with big digits, the next level, ±1 minute nudges, breaks with a note and a big-blind ante. It keeps time through sleep, restarts and reboots
• The running clock in the notifications and on the lock screen, with a cue sound, a vibration or a flash for each new level
• Color-ups on breaks, and overtime levels if the game runs long
• Turn the phone sideways for a full-screen table view, with knockouts right from the clock
• The big moments on the clock: the bubble, in the money, the final table, heads-up and the champion
THE BANK AND PAYOUTS
• Track buy-ins, rebuys, add-ons, knockouts, bounties and who has been paid, with Undo
• Pick tonight's players from the people you've played with
• Late arrivals and re-entries, each with its own buy-in and stack
• Bounties three ways: standard, progressive (half now, half onto the winner's own bounty) or mystery envelopes
• Top-heavy, standard and flat payouts, or your own weights. The places always add up to the prize pool
• Settle up at the end: the fewest payments so everyone is square, with a tick for each
• Share the payouts or the settle-up as text
TOOLS
• Chip set: a chip calculator for starting stacks from the chips you own, and a color-up plan
• Seat draw: random seats and the high card for the button
• Texas Holdem odds for two to ten hands, and run it out card by card
• Side pots when someone is all in
• Hand ranks
• Split the prizes: a deal by ICM or chip chop
• History: saved nights, season points and a CSV export
• Cue sounds, and music from your phone that plays with the clock
• Your currency: $, €, £, ₹, ¥, kr and more, or none
• Backup: everything in one file you keep
Open source under the MIT licence. Everything stays on your phone.

fdroid:com.nemu.clashfest.clash.alpha.name: ClashFest
fdroid:com.nemu.clashfest.clash.alpha.summary: Rule-based proxy client on the mihomo core: import, connect, protected
fdroid:com.nemu.clashfest.clash.alpha.description:
ClashFest is a rule-based proxy / VPN client for Android built on the mihomo (Clash.Meta) core.
 Made for the common case : paste or scan a subscription link, tap Connect, done. The subscription stays untouched; everything you change in the app lives in a separate layer on top of it.
 Features 
 VLESS (REALITY, XHTTP, Vision), VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, SSH, mieru and more, via the mihomo core
 Subscriptions in Clash YAML format with headers from your operator (quota, expiry, announcements, branding)
 Per-app routing (allow-list / block-list), rule sets, custom rules, DNS and hosts editor, tunnels
 Proxy groups inline on the home screen: pick a node, test latency of one node or a whole group
 Live connections and logs
 Hardened by default: local SOCKS/HTTP listeners are closed, geo downloads only from trusted mirrors
 QR scanner without Google services
 Remote control of a TV box on the same network
 Privacy : no analytics, no tracking, no developer server. Your traffic goes to the servers of the operator you chose.

fdroid:com.shinydiscoballsdev.kifossk.summary: Lightweight FOSS kiosk browser for dashboards. Auto-recovery, zero Google.
fdroid:com.shinydiscoballsdev.kifossk.description:
kiFOSSk is a lightweight, open-source kiosk browser designed to turn your Android device into a dedicated display for remote dashboards. Whether you're monitoring ADS-B flights, viewing Home Assistant dashboards, or running digital signage, kiFOSSk provides a reliable, privacy-first solution.
Key Features:
• Home Launcher Mode: Automatically starts on boot without complex Device Owner setup.
• Resilient: Automatic retry with exponential backoff, and a friendly waiting screen when the dashboard host is unreachable — no blank screens, no manual refresh.
• Privacy Focused: Zero Google Play Services, no analytics, no telemetry.
• Customizable: Set dashboard URL, orientation, and screen timeout.
• Battery Optimized: Built-in option to request unrestricted battery usage for always-on displays.
• Secure: Minimal permissions, local storage only, connects only to your configured URL.
Perfect for GrapheneOS users, privacy-conscious homelab enthusiasts, and any spare Android device destined for wall duty.
Setup is simple: Install, enter your dashboard URL, and set as the default home app. No root, no Device Owner, no bloatware — just a clean kiosk experience.

fdroid:de.grobox.liberario.name: Transportr - Public Transit
fdroid:de.grobox.liberario.summary: Free Public Transport Assistant without Ads or Tracking
fdroid:de.grobox.liberario.description:
Transportr is a non-profit app developed by people around the world in their free time.
They want to make the use of public transport as easy as possible for everybody.
This app uses the data of various local public transport agencies
and provides a unified interface for them.
It can not verify the correctness of the data
and therefore offers no guarantees for the displayed information.
Please use at your own risk.
 🛣️ Trip Routing . Just tell Transportr where you want to go!
It will find the best connections for you, advises you where to change buses,
and even gives you an estimated time of arrival.
 ⏱️ Live Departures . Shows upcoming departures from any and all stations.
In supported areas, real-time delays will be shown as well.
 🗽 Software Freedom . The source code for Transportr is 100% open.
You can freely use, study, share and improve it.
This app is only as good as you make it.
You can even add your city yourself, if it is not already supported.
 🛰️ Finds your Position. Transportr uses GPS satellite navigation
to keep track of your current position - so you never get lost.
You can find nearby stations to start a new trip
and then see how far along the journey you are.
 🌟 Remembers Favorite Places. To get you where you need to go faster,
Transportr saves frequently used locations and trips.
That way you do not need to type them over and over again.
 🚫 No Ads, No Tracking . This app does not display ads
or annoying notifications.
It also does not use tracking tools such as Google Analytics to spy on you.
 🗺️ Beautiful Maps . Displays stations or your entire trip on a map
and always knows where you are to not miss where to get off the bus.

AppStow is an Android app for organizing and launching installed apps, websites, web apps and custom shortcuts.
Create your own categories, mark frequently used entries as favorites and arrange your overview to suit your needs.
Features:
• Organize installed apps in custom categories
• Assign apps to multiple categories
• Add emoji symbols to categories

• Open HTTPS web apps in an integrated WebView

Note for AppStow 3.0: Backup files from version 2.x cannot be imported into 3.0. A regular app update is not a backup import and does not require a backup file.
AppStow requires Android 13 or newer.
AppStow is free software licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

fdroid:io.gitlab.carsten_scholtes.parti.name: Parti
fdroid:io.gitlab.carsten_scholtes.parti.summary: Help with partitioning into fractional parts (compute lcm).
fdroid:io.gitlab.carsten_scholtes.parti.description:
Parts are usually specified in the form of fractions as divident / divisor.
With different parts using different divisors it is difficult to compare the sizes of the parts.
The main gist of Parti is to determine the least common multiple (lcm) of all different divisors.
(The different parts can be expressed using the lcm as common divisor making the parts easily comparable.)
Divisors are represented and processed as BigInts in order to provide exact results.
(BigInts are designed to store whole values of arbitrary size, as long as enough memory is available.)
 General Usage:
 After entering a divisor in the central editor widget
 it can be added / removed with the button to the right of the input field.
 The list of divisors in the bottom section is changed accordingly.
 Also, lcm and gcd in the top section are updated to reflect the new list of divisors.
 Tapping a value in the list puts the value into the editing widget.
 Dragging a list value to the left removes it from the list and puts it into the editor widget.
 Dragging a list value to the right removes it without changing the editor widget.
 In the top bar, a button for clearing the whole list is available.
 There are also buttons for undoing and redoing any changes of the current session.
 The value of the gcd can be changed deliberately
 with any change modifying the list of divisors accordingly:
 Tapping the value of the gcd opens a requester to replace the gcd with an arbitrary whole number.
 There is a button to set it to 1 (or to the value it had before it was set to 1).
 Further buttons increase or decrease the gcd by 1.

fdroid:it.danieleverducci.lunatracker.name: 🌜 LunaTracker 🌛
fdroid:it.danieleverducci.lunatracker.summary: LunaTracker is a newborn baby tracking app.
fdroid:it.danieleverducci.lunatracker.description:
Parenting can be tough. You get home from the hospital, exhausted, with this little fragile unknown thingy that has no user manual and a single way to let you know something's not ok: crying.
You have to react fast, even if it's 4 AM and you have no idea of the reason behind the cries.
This app is meant to log all the relevant events (diaper change, breastfeeding, baby bottle feeding, etc.), so you can always remember what was done last time and when. It supports syncing the data between different devices (using your WebDAV server for the best privacy) so that when the baby needs attention, the dad can step in, leaving the mom sleeping peacefully.
Dedicated to my daughter Luna.
A HUGE thanks to all our contributors. See https://git.ichibi.eu/penguin86/luna-tracker/src/branch/master/README.md
NOTE: The content on this app is for informational or educational purposes only and does not substitute professional medical advice or consultations with healthcare professionals.
Feature graphic ("Baby and baby milk bottle. Baby feeding."): © Vyacheslav Argenberg / http://www.vascoplanet.com/, CC BY 4.0 , via Wikimedia Commons

fdroid:no.falkp.vario.name: Vario
fdroid:no.falkp.vario.summary: Aircraft-like altimeter and variometer with GPS, terrain and barometer modes.
fdroid:no.falkp.vario.description:
Aircraft altimeter and variometer instruments for your phone, for aviation
enthusiasts. Not for navigation use, just for fun!
Three altitude sources, cycled with the MODE button:
* GPS - altitude straight from the GPS receiver. Very coarse.
* MAP - ground (terrain) elevation below your position, from the Open-Meteo
 elevation API (GLO-90). This is ground elevation, not height above ground.
* BAR - barometric altitude, computed from the pressure sensor in the
 device and sea-level pressure (QNH) which is fetched from api.met.no.
 Accurat and fast. QNH can be set manually if you do not want to give position
 access.
The altimeter is the classic three-pointer 100s / 1000s / 10 000s layout with a
Kollsman window. Tap a dial to zoom in, tap again to zoom out. IMP/MET switches
between feet and metres. Long-press MODE or IMP/MET toggles a debug overlay
with a pressure strip chart in BAR mode.
Privacy:
* No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no crash reporting.
* Settings are stored on the device only.
* Coordinates rounded to four decimal places are sent to
 api.met.no (QNH) and api.open-meteo.com (terrain elevation); those two
 services see your IP address as well.
* Everything except the two QNH/elevation lookups is offline.

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlymemory.description:

The application provides two predefined card decks, as well as the option to select own images from your device.
In addition to a single player mode, it is also possible to play in a dual player mode.
Privacy Friendly Memo Game has three difficulty level:
1. a game field with 4x4 cards (overall 16 cards)
2. a game field with 6x6 cards (overall 36 cards)
3. a game field with 8x8 cards (overall 64 cards)
What makes Privacy Friendly Memo Game different from other similar apps?

Privacy Friendly Memo Game does not require any permissions. The selection of images is done by a task to the gallery so the app does not have any access to the device's storage without the user's control and interaction.
For comparison: The Top Ten of similar apps from the Google Play Store requires an average of 3,9 permissions (in September 2016). These are for instance the access to the network.

Many other free apps in the Google Play Store dazzle annoying advertising and also shortens battery life.

apple-macos:1596445123.description:
RECnGO is the ultimate live streaming studio app for video content creators and streamers.
It replaces a complicated, expensive (and unnecessary!) live streaming kit and lets you stream with your mobile devices in studio quality. Finally, an effortless streaming experience to Facebook, Youtube, Twitch, TikTok, your website, or any custom RTMP destinations–it’s perfect if you’re a content creator, podcaster, sports club, or videographer for social and corporate events.
- LIVE STREAM TO FACEBOOK, YOUTUBE, TWITCH, OR CUSTOM RTMP
Reach your audience on whatever platform they hang out on–set up and start streaming in minutes!
- PERSONALIZE/BRAND YOUR LIVE STREAMS OR PODCASTS
Insert logos, overlays, speaker names, and other visuals during your live stream–giving your production an instant “It’s like a TV studio!” wow factor
- USE MULTIPLE CAMERA ANGLES FOR A SHOW-STOPPING STREAM
Use as many devices and camera angles as you need–you can link up to 12 phones and/or tablets into a live streaming chain. For a more immersive experience audiences love, switch between camera angles often during streaming (vs. making a single-camera yawn-inducing production).
- EDIT SOUND LIVE WITH THE STUDIO’S BUILT-IN AUDIO MIXER
Adjust and balance the sound during your live stream for each device independently from the studio device’s audio mixer–this is huge. When you see people chatting next to a device you’re using to record or live stream, you can mute the mic on it from where you sit! Shhh!
- USE WHATEVER LENS YOU PREFER (FRONT, BACK, ULTRA-WIDE)
Switch between the front and back cameras without walking up to the device during your streams–handy during live Q&As when the mic is handed to someone in the audience
- ADJUST WHITE BALANCE
Individually, on all cameras–perfect when the sun decides to come out/hide and the video suddenly goes cold/warm as your stream goes on
- USE THE FLASH WHEN YOU NEED IT
Turn the flash on and off independently for each device–ideal when you're streaming on cloudy days and the room becomes darker... and what was a bright spot when you set up is now dark
- ZOOM IN AND OUT FROM YOUR STUDIO DEVICE
Individually, on all cameras–insanely useful when streaming whiteboard presentations with ridiculously small letters even the audience in the room can’t see (... imagine the people watching the steam!)
- ADJUST LATENCY WHEN YOU NEED TO
Adjust your external camera’s latency settings according to the quality of your WiFi connection as you're streaming–perfect for balancing the data flow (audio & video) from your individual cameras
- ENJOY AUTOMATIC STREAM BITRATE BALANCING
It’s streaming magic in the background–a generous 10-second buffer zone irons out sudden changes in your upload speed during your live stream
- LIVE STREAM, RECORD, OR BOTH
Record your live stream and save it on your local device–edit and repurpose later to get the most ROI for your efforts
- MANAGE YOUR DEVICES REMOTELY
Orchestrate your entire stream from inside the intuitive live video studio app while sitting down at the back of the room with a coffee–it’s that easy to use
- MINIMAL LEARNING CURVE
When you’re stuck or need help, navigate to the tutorial section or contact the live video support team for a solution.
Grab a seat in this powerful live video production studio and enjoy pro live streaming and video content creation–with your mobile devices.

apple-macos:6786884579.name: Koadro: Photo Pixel Art
apple-macos:6786884579.description:
Turn any photo into real pixel art, in the colors you choose and at the exact size you'll print, stitch or build it.
Koadro is a creative pixel art generator that keeps your picture honest. Nothing is redrawn and nothing is guessed: every pixel comes straight from your photo, a painting, a pet, a face, a landscape. You decide how fine the detail is, how many colors it uses, which palette sets the mood, and how big it will be in the real world.
Make it real:
- Set the canvas in centimeters or inches, and the size of every pixel, so a print, a cross stitch or a bead board comes out exactly as planned.
- Turn on lines to count every square, then export a PDF that prints sharp at its true size, from a postcard to a wall.
- See it as beads on a pegboard or raised like glazed ceramic before you make it.
Make it yours:
- Set the resolution, from chunky retro blocks to fine detail.
- Hold the color count wherever your eye likes it.
- Choose a palette with a mood: Mono, Nord, Noir, Matcha, Sepia, Dusk, Van Gogh, Ukiyo-e, Riso, Terracotta, or the retro CGA and PICO-8. Or let Koadro read a palette straight from your image.
- Mix your own palettes, color by color, and the photo uses only those.
- Add dithering for that classic pixel texture.
- Go monochrome in any color, from a few tones to sixteen.
- Rebuild the picture from mosaic tiles: square, triangle, diamond, hexagon.
- Save a look as a template and apply it to the next photo in one tap.
- Transparent backgrounds stay transparent, so a cutout becomes a clean pixel sticker.
- Crop, rotate and straighten freely, your original always kept, and Enhance readies each photo before it becomes pixels.
How it works:
1. Pick any photo, or take one on iPhone or iPad.
2. Set the detail and the number of colors.
3. Choose a palette, or pull one from the image itself.
4. Set the real size, and add dithering, effects or a mosaic.
5. Export a crisp PNG to share, or a PDF to print at its true size.
The free tier is a real tool, not a trial. Resolution up to 128 cells, up to 16 colors, every built-in palette, dithering, the lines and outlines effects, crop, rotate and Enhance, transparent backgrounds, square and triangle mosaics, export up to 1024px, and 10 projects. No watermark on any of it.
Koadro Premium, one purchase, unlocks the rest: exact sizing in centimeters or inches, a PDF for printing and PNG export up to 4096px, resolution up to 256 cells, up to 64 colors, custom palettes, saved templates, monochrome in any color with up to 16 tones, diamond and hexagon mosaics, the beads and relief effects, and unlimited projects.
Pay once. No subscription. No ads. No watermark. Ever.
No account, no cloud, no upload. Everything runs on your device, and your images never leave it.
Your photo, your colors, your size. You make every decision, Koadro just makes it easy.

flathub:com.odnoyko.valot.name: Valot
flathub:com.odnoyko.valot.description:
Valot combines time tracking with earnings calculation in one clean app. Set your hourly rates, track your work time, and instantly see what you've earned. Simple tracking for professionals who value their time.
 Key Features:
 Compact tracker accessible via system hotkeys for quick time logging
 Real-time task tracking with live timer updates and instant feedback
 Project organization with custom colors and icons for easy identification
 Client management with custom currency support for international work
 Comprehensive reporting with detailed charts and statistics
 HTML/PDF export capabilities with professional formatting options
 Built-in Pomodoro timer with customizable session lengths for focused work
 Clear and intuitive interface designed for effortless daily use
 Valot offers a clean, modern interface, making time tracking simple and efficient without getting in your way.

flathub:com.voxdsp.Borg.name: Borg ER-3
flathub:com.voxdsp.Borg.description:
Fixed-state modular synthesizer using FART oscillators, if you can hold back
 the chuckles for a moment stands for Frequency, Amplitude, Resolution, and
 Transformation oscillators, the resolution regards harmonic resolution and
 transformation regards the wave-shape being produced by the oscillator.
 The envelope can be clicked and dragged into any shape, the biquads can be
 manually configured on a per coefficient basis, they are executed in sequential
 order so BIQUAD 1 executes first.
 Exported files save to ~/EXPORTS/Borg_ER-3/

flathub:io.github.TransmissionRemoteGtk.name: Transmission Remote
flathub:io.github.TransmissionRemoteGtk.summary: Remotely manage the Transmission BitTorrent client
flathub:io.github.TransmissionRemoteGtk.description: Transmission Remote Gtk allows you to remotely manage the Transmission BitTorrent client using its RPC interface. You can use it to to manage torrents (start/stop/verify/reannounce/remove/remove and delete), add new ones (it works as a .torrent fle handler from a webbrowser), and configure settings on transmission-daemon.

flathub:io.github.daid.EmptyEpsilon.name: EmptyEpsilon
flathub:io.github.daid.EmptyEpsilon.description:
EmptyEpsilon is a spaceship bridge simulator game. It's fully open source, so it can be modified
 in any way people wish.
 EmptyEpsilon places you in the roles of a spaceship's bridge officers, like those seen in Star
 Trek. While you can play EmptyEpsilon alone or with friends, the best experience involves 6 players
 working together on each ship.
 Each officer fills a unique role: Captain, Helms, Weapons, Relay, Science, and Engineering.
 Except for the Captain, each officer operates part of the ship through a specialized screen. The
 Captain relies on their trusty crew to report information and follow orders.

flathub:io.github.nozwock.Packet.name: Packet
flathub:io.github.nozwock.Packet.description:
Send and receive files wirelessly with Android devices using Quick Share or another device with Packet installed.
 Packet requires Bluetooth to be enabled and the devices to be connected to a Wi-Fi network with mDNS.

flathub:org.freefilesync.FreeFileSync.name: FreeFileSync
flathub:org.freefilesync.FreeFileSync.description:
FreeFileSync is a folder comparison and synchronization software that creates and manages backup copies of your important files. Instead of copying every file every time, FreeFileSync determines the differences between a source and a target folder and transfers only the minimum amount of data needed.
 NOTE: 
FreeFileSync allows you to open files in external applications or run custom scripts. However, when sandboxed as Flatpak, external applications or scripts from your host system are not accessible. If you want to give FreeFileSync access to your host applications/commands, run this command in terminal to give it access to your session DBus:
 flatpak override --user --socket=session-bus org.freefilesync.FreeFileSync 
(Or you can use Flatseal to configure this permission).
Now you can run any app/command, if you prefix it with " flatpak-spawn --host ", i.e.:
 flatpak-spawn --host mycommand arguments

flathub:org.gnome.Hitori.name: Hitori
flathub:org.gnome.Hitori.description:
Hitori is a logic game similar to the popular game of Sudoku.
 You play the game against the clock, aiming to eliminate all the duplicate
 numbers in each row and column in the fastest time.
 Multiple sizes of game board are supported, and you can place markers on
 cells to help work out the solution.
 If you get stuck, the game can give you a hint.

flathub:org.onionshare.OnionShare.name: OnionShare
flathub:org.onionshare.OnionShare.summary: Securely and anonymously share files, host websites, and chat with friends
flathub:org.onionshare.OnionShare.description:
OnionShare is an open source tool that lets you securely and anonymously share files, host websites,
 and chat with friends using the Tor network.

flathub:org.zotero.Zotero.name: Zotero
flathub:org.zotero.Zotero.description:
**Please report issues with this Flatpak in the manifest issue tracker instead of the Zotero
 Forums.**
 Zotero is a tool for managing references and research materials. It helps to collect bibliographic
 data, organize files, and generate citations in a wide range of formats.

flathub:studio.planetpeanut.Bobby.name: Bobby
flathub:studio.planetpeanut.Bobby.description:
Bobby lets you open SQLite database files (.db, .sqlite) and browse the tables inside.
 Handy for app development or inspecting downloaded databases.
 Search tables and views of any size
 Copy rows or cells to the clipboard
 Made with care by a human
 Don't forget to sanitize your database inputs!

fedora-packages:libnss-mysql/libnss-mysq.name: libnss-mysql
fedora-packages:libnss-mysql/libnss-mysq.description: Store your UNIX user accounts in MySQL. "libnss-mysql" enables the following: * System-wide authentication and name service using a MySQL database. Applications do not need to be MySQL-aware or modified in any way. * Storing authentication information in a database instead of text files. * Creation of a single authentication database for multiple servers. This is often referred to as the "Single Sign-on" problem. * Writing data-modification routines (IE self-management web interface). libnss-mysql is similar to NIS or LDAP. It provides the same centralized authentication service through a database. What does this mean? Username, uid, gid, password, etc comes from a MySQL database instead of /etc/password, /etc/shadow, and /etc/group. A user configured in MySQL will look and behave just like a user configured in /etc/passwd. Your applications such as ls, finger, sendmail, qmail, exim, postfix, proftpd, X, sshd, etc. will all 'see' these users!

bluejetty:00036324:ios.description:
For Brawl Stars Fans: Color, Draw & Create Epic Skins!
Unleash your creativity in the ultimate Brawl Stars fan art studio. Color stunning character pages, draw freehand designs, and craft your very own custom skins. Whether you want to relax with coloring or design the next legendary Brawler look, Brawl Art has everything you need.
Highlights
- Brawl Stars Universe: All your favorite characters, outfits, and skins - always updated.
- Color & Draw: Switch between guided coloring pages and a freehand drawing canvas.
- Skin Maker Studio: Design and customize your own epic Brawler skins from scratch.
- Easy-to-Use Tools: Bucket fill, pencil, brush, eraser, and a full color palette.
- Stickers & Effects: Over 100 stickers and creative elements to enhance your art.
- Save & Share: Export your masterpieces or share them with friends instantly.
Key Features
- Hundreds of Brawl Stars coloring pages updated regularly with new characters and skins.
- Freehand drawing mode: sketch, paint, and create original Brawler fan art.
- Custom skin creator: mix colors, outfits, and accessories to build unique designs.
- Vibrant color palettes with bold and bright options for stunning results.
- Recolor option: revisit and repaint your favorite Brawlers again and again.
- Wide selection of heroes, emotes, gliders, and outfits to color or redesign.
- Offline support: color and draw anytime, anywhere - no internet needed.
- Simple, stress-free interface designed for all ages.
How to Play
1. Pick a Brawl Stars character, skin, or start with a blank canvas.
2. Color with guided tools or draw freely with pencil, brush, and more.
3. Customize your creation with stickers and effects.
4. Save your artwork or share it with the community.
Brawl Art is more than a coloring app - it is the ultimate creative playground for every Brawl Stars fan. Color iconic pages, draw original art, or design your dream skins. Relax, create, and experience your favorite game in a whole new way!
Download Brawl Art today and start coloring, drawing, and creating!
DISCLAIMER: This material is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information see Supercell's Fan Content Policy: www.supercell.com/fan-content-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://atillaozder.com/about/terms

bluejetty:00135790:ios.description:
Looking for a fun way to liven up your night? Look no further than Party Circle – the go-to app for group party games! Enter Party Circle and play with friends! Customize your experience by choosing from many hilarious categories, making sure you set the perfect vibe for your party’s mood! Whether laid-back or super silly, we’ve got you covered!
Dive into the excitement with friends and get ready to learn a lot more about each other with more than 15+ modes to cover all party moods. This game is suitable to play with friends, with your partner, and even big party squads. With over 10,000 challenges, your game night has never been more fun!
With the flexibility to create custom challenges, you can bring in your own version and make it all about guts, bluffs, attitude, or humor! The sky's the limit to what you can do! Invite your friends, gather them in a circle, and let the endless excitement unfold! Gonna be an unforgettable night!
Suited for any occasion and an awesome way to break the ice at your next party. Not only includes classic game modes like 5-Second Rule, Most Likely To, and Would You Rather, but it also includes many more new and exciting types of games that you’ve never seen before! Fun and exciting party games to play with your friends or family!
Say goodbye to old party games and welcome to the inner circle of fun. With Party Circle, you’ll never have a dull night again. Are you ready to create lasting memories with your friends? Download now!

Build your expedition team to seek the secret behind lost civilizations!
Hold the torch high! This could be the greatest adventure of your life!
Old wars are raging on; new ones are brewing in other reaches of the world.
Latest news from the ocean says adventurers have found a mysterious island shrouded by fog where lost ancient civilizations hide.
Everything there, lands, resources, treasures and knowledge, is igniting ambitions of the rapacious. To defend your Kingdom, it’s your time to lead the expedition team to disclose the secret of the Lost Island one step ahead.
Game Features
◆ Explore the unknown island! When you are fighting against ghosts and sea monsters for the buried treasures in the cursed island, vicious pirates will watch your every move and strike when you least expect it, so beware!
◆ Build your stronghold! Explore the mists, find treasures. Mingle and socialize with adventurers from all walks of life at the tavern!
◆ Craft the most powerful artifacts! More treasures and more advanced skills help clear dangers in your way forward.
◆ Make friends and rally adventurers around the world! Be it on land or at sea, you are not alone no matter how powerful your enemies might be.
◆Experience varied strategies! A resourceful king knows how to calculate, maneuver, and manipulate in order to stay on top.

bluejetty:00078249:ios.description:
Go beyond Dual WhatsApp — go Multi with Mirror Chat!
Mirror Chat lets you access WhatsApp in a sleek, mobile-friendly interface. Want to use more than one account? Unlock unlimited profiles with Mirror Chat Pro.
Why Mirror Chat stands out:
1. Multi-profile support (pro): Use multiple WhatsApp accounts in one app — personal, work, side business? No problem.
2. Mobile-optimized UI (free): Feels like a real app, not just basic WhatsApp Web.
3. Choose your WhatsApp mode (free): Switch between Classic, Business, or other web versions for better compatibility.
4. Full web functionality (free): Send messages, photos, voice notes, and more.
5. Message unsaved numbers (free): Start chats without adding to contacts.
6. Real-time notifications (free): Stay up to date without missing a thing.
7. Save statuses easily (free): Long-press to download any status.
Unlock more with Mirror Chat Pro:
1. Multi-profile support: Add and switch between unlimited WhatsApp accounts on one device. (Only works on iOS 17+)
2. Enhanced privacy: Lock Mirror Chat with PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID.
3. Theme customization: Switch between dark and light mode.
4. User agent switching: Browse in stealth mode using Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.
5. Document access: Open PDFs, Word files, and presentations directly.
6. Support the app: Your subscription helps us maintain updates and stability, especially when WhatsApp makes changes.
Subscription & Terms:
Upon downloading Mirror Chat, enjoy complimentary access to all WhatsApp features. Additionally, you can sample our Mirror Chat Pro with a 3-day or 7-day free trial for the yearly package at no cost. Post-trial, the chosen subscription fee applies. To prevent automatic renewal, ensure cancellation 24 hours prior to your trial's conclusion. Note: Remaining trial time is void upon opting for a subscription.
Subscription Management:
You have full control over your subscriptions. To cancel, navigate to 'Settings', select your name, proceed to 'Subscriptions', find 'Mirror Chat', and select 'Cancel Subscription'.
Disclaimer:
Mirror Chat is an independent, UNOFFICIAL tool for WhatsApp Messenger and is not affiliated with its official developer. All product names, logos, brands, trademarks, or images mentioned within the app belong to their respective owners. These trademark holders have no association with us or our products and do not endorse or sponsor this app or any of our digital offerings.
Your privacy is paramount to us, and safeguarding your data is our commitment. We do not store or transmit any data through Mirror Chat's servers; all communication is encrypted and directly relayed to WhatsApp.
For inquiries or concerns, reach out at https://mirrorwa.web.app/reports.

bluejetty:00014848:ios.description:
The VEKTR® app is a free app available to all VEKTR® users. Even though anyone can download the app, not everyone will be able to use it. bluejetty:00032751:ios.description:
Tournament Bracket maker is a popular bracket builder app for organizing tournaments. Stop manual organization and simply create a tournament, add teams, choose bracket methods (single elimination, double elimination, round robin) and get started.
Using our Tournament bracket app, you can launch unlimited tournaments, so whether it’s a sports organization, eSports league owners, or any institute that wants to manage a tournament, this is the app you need.
Our bracket maker has different elimination algorithms which makes it ideal for all types of competitions and tournaments. Besides that, it also allows you to customize team names and even make changes to the generated schedules which makes it among the best-rated apps in the market.
Leave the tournament schedule on us and start focusing on other things, just import your team names or player names, and our generator will build an entire schedule of competitions (which you can edit). Isn’t it cool?
Features
- Unlimited Bracket Building: Our PRO users can make unlimited brackets and launch unlimited tournaments, so whether you want to manage a single tournament or want to manage multiple tournaments, our app can do it all
- Customizing Team / Player Names: Unlike most bracket makers in the market that only shows “Team 1 vs Team 2”, you can actually add up your team names in our app which makes it easier to manage and remember. Isn’t it what every tournament/esports organizer wants?
- Modify Generated Competitions: Once you enter the number of teams/players who are going to play the tournament, our app shall generate the matches and challenges between those teams, as a user you can modify or change which team shall compete with which one, that too just by simple drag and drop. Wanted that? We got you covered.
- Bracket Methods: Most of the tournament bracket maker apps come with single elimination methods. However, that’s not the ideal way to run a tournament, that’s why we sat down with different tournament organizers and have added 3 different elimination methods i.e. Single, Double and Round Robin.
- Social Shareability: The world is becoming more and more social, everyone wants to post everything on social media. One of the tournament managers we interviewed wanted to share every single competition and the entire bracket on social media and our app has it integrated, you can generate a PDF or just share a Image on your social media accounts.
- Score Management: Besides generating the entire tournament, our app also allows you to add scores for individual competitions. This way, you can just enter the score and the winner shall be decided.
- Realtime Leaderboard: As and when a team wins, the results shall be updated on our leaderboard on a real-time basis. So just open the leaderboard for a tournament and know which team is ruling the tournament and by how many points.
Combine all the above mentioned features with multiple tournaments which makes managing, building, and organizing tournaments much effortless and easy. What are you waiting for, install the Tournament Bracket Maker app now!
Privacy Policy: https://tournament-maker.appstraw.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://tournament-maker.appstraw.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00076516:ios.description:
Kudos is the personal finance app that puts your money on autopilot. Our AI works behind the scenes to lower your bills, find smarter cards, and make sure you never leave money on the table.
NEVER MISS A CARD BENEFIT AGAIN
The average person loses $624 each year on benefits they forget about or don't know they have. Kudos tracks every benefit across all your cards and makes sure you use them before they expire.
ASK KUDOS AI ANYTHING ABOUT YOUR MONEY
Ask Kudos AI anything about your money, from your spending to your cards to your missed rewards. Every answer is grounded in your actual financial data, not generic advice.
AI-POWERED SPENDING INSIGHTS
Kudos analyzes your spending across all your cards and surfaces exactly where you're losing money — the wrong card at the gas station, duplicate subscriptions you forgot about, credits about to expire. Each insight is actionable: complete it, track your savings, and watch the numbers add up.
LOWER BILLS WITH ONE TAP
Overpaying for internet, phone, or cable? Kudos sends an AI agent to negotiate directly with your provider — no phone trees, no hold music, no awkward conversations. Users save hundreds per year on bills they were already paying. 
THE BEST CARD AT EVERY STORE
Stop guessing at the register. Open the Cheat Sheet and Kudos detects the store you're at and tells you exactly which card to use to earn the most. Not nearby a store? Search by merchant or category to plan ahead.
FIND YOUR NEXT BEST CARD
Not sure which credit card to apply for? Kudos matches you with cards based on your actual spending habits — not generic "best of" lists. Compare welcome bonuses, rewards rates, and annual fees side by side to find the card that earns you the most.
ALL YOUR CARDS IN ONE PLACE
See transactions, balances, and spending across every card in a single dashboard. No more logging into five different bank apps to figure out where your money went.
FREE CREDIT SCORE MONITORING
Track your credit score and understand what moves it — all inside the app you already use to manage your cards.
EARN CASHBACK WHEN YOU SHOP
Activate shopping cashback at thousands of retailers. Stores pay Kudos a commission and we pass 100% back to you — on top of your existing credit card rewards.
WHY KUDOS?
- AI bill negotiation saves hundreds per year
- Smart spending insights catch costly mistakes
- Track your card benefits automatically 
- Personalized card recommendations based on your spending
- All your cards, balances, and transactions in one view
- Free credit score monitoring
- Shopping cashback at 15,000+ stores
- No browser extension required
Download Kudos and start saving — on your bills, your purchases, and your time.
Terms of Use: https://joinkudos.com/terms

bluejetty:00034086:ios.summary: Dive into the mysterious realm of stage magic with "Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick," where danger lurks behind every trick and illusion. Join the renowned detective twins as they untangle a series of chilling on-stage deaths in this thrilling
bluejetty:00034086:ios.description:
Dive into the mysterious realm of stage magic with "Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick," where danger lurks behind every trick and illusion. Join the renowned detective twins as they untangle a series of chilling on-stage deaths in this thrilling addition to casual games. If you're a fan of unsolved mysteries games and detective games mystery, this enthralling narrative will captivate your attention from the very beginning. Engage with a series of complex brain teasers and logical thinking challenges, making "Twin Mind" a crown jewel among intriguing games!
Magicians often take staggering risks while on stage just to capture the undivided attention and admiration of their audiences. In fact, if a magician dies during a performance, it gets more media coverage than if one of them achieves worldwide fame! So when the press announces the deaths of two prominent figures in the world of magic in the space of a week, the voice in your head starts telling you this is not an accident. If it weren't so tragic, the circumstances of the victims' deaths would be almost comical – Neptune drowned, and Golden Dragon's armor was pierced by his own arrow. But whatever is the case - It is up to you to find out what really happened.
· CAPTIVATING PLOT!
Experience a gripping tale of mystery where you'll play as the famous twin detectives known for solving the most perplexing unsolved hidden mystery games. Investigate the suspicious deaths of two magicians to uncover whether these were mere accidents or part of a darker plot!
· INTRICATE PUZZLES!
Challenge your intellect with brain teasers and logical thinking as you navigate through the intricate puzzles and mini-games that make Twin Mind stand out among intriguing games. Perfect for enthusiasts of clues games offline, each puzzle brings you closer to solving the haunting riddles of the magic world!
· INTERACTIVE GAMEPLAY!
Make choices that influence the outcome of your investigation, a unique feature for fans of crime investigation games and suspense games. With multiple endings available, your decisions will shape the resolution of these unnerving events!
· COLLECTIBLE TREASURES!
Explore elaborately staged scenes true to the essence of find things hidden games. Keep an eye out for various collectible items scattered throughout the game. These treasures not only enhance the gaming experience but also add depth for players who enjoy an extra layer of engagement in their casual games!
"Twin Mind: The Deathly Trick" combines suspense, logical challenges, and a captivating narrative in one unforgettable adventure. Don't miss this standout detective games mystery!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/

bluejetty:00130159:ios.description:
Forget about communication stress and discover the world of efficient and effortless writing with Writely—the AI-powered keyboard that aims to make your chatting experience smoother and more enjoyable than ever before. This amazing app can help you do much more than just type. 
GET HELP FROM A SMART AI BOT
Streamline your daily writing tasks with an all-knowing AI assistant. Whether you need to craft a captivating text, summarize a book, or solve math problems and programming tasks, this chatbot has got you covered. Simply type in your request, and the app will carry out the tedious writing routine for you. On top of that, you can choose from hundreds of handy, ready-to-use prompts to jump into the conversation with the bot right away.
CHECK GRAMMAR AND SPELLING
We know how frustrating it can be to send a message and later realize that it's full of typos and grammar mistakes. But with our AI-powered keyboard, you can breathe a sigh of relief, as your messages are double-checked for accuracy. Say goodbye to embarrassing autocorrect fails and awkward misspellings.
REPHRASE YOUR MESSAGES
Struggling to find the appropriate words to express yourself? The AI keyboard can offer phrasing suggestions, ensuring that your message is clear and concise. This is especially useful to non-native speakers who may need help with the nuances of the language. 
FINISH YOUR WRITING 
Ever been in a hurry and couldn’t find the right words? Writely can analyze the context of your conversation and offer suggestions for completing sentences. It's like having a personal writing assistant right at your fingertips!
FLAVOR YOUR MESSAGES WITH EMOJIS
Our smart AI keyboard can add emojis to your messages, giving them a personal touch and making them more eye-pleasing. Writely suggests emojis based on the general tone of your message and the context of your conversation. 
TURN YOUR TEXTS INTO POEMS
Writely transforms regular text messages into original poems, helping you reveal your inner writing talent and creativity. With its advanced algorithms, the app can analyze the structure and tone of your texts, converting them into a poetic form. Our breakthrough AI keyboard offers a unique experience for anyone looking to upgrade their writing skills and create truly worthy messages.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR KEYBOARD
Choose from various themes to personalize your keyboard and make your typing experience more enjoyable. From colorful and vibrant designs to minimalist styles, you can choose a theme that suits your taste and preferences.
Navigating tricky communication scenarios won’t be a problem with Writely. By offering alternative wording options and suggesting ways to finish your sentences, the AI keyboard can assist you in effectively communicating your message, even in challenging situations. With Writely, you can express yourself more clearly and confidently. It’ll help you avoid misunderstandings and build stronger relationships with your colleagues, friends, and family. Whether you need to apologize, ask for help, or clarify something, the app will come to your rescue. 
So why settle for traditional keyboards? It’s time you took your writing to the next level with Writely, the perfect AI keyboard. Download the app now and experience the difference!
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
• You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
• Subscriptions are billed automatically at the rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

https://aiby.mobi/keyboardai_ios/terms/

bluejetty:00087135:ios.name: MomsLab: Pregnancy Workouts
bluejetty:00087135:ios.summary:
"MomsLab" - learn more about nutrition, yoga, fitness and training for pregnant women. Achieve your ideal form and body after childbirth.
"MomsLab" contains special programs for all women, as well as pregnant women, aimed at preparing for
bluejetty:00087135:ios.description:
"MomsLab" - learn more about nutrition, yoga, fitness and training for pregnant women. Achieve your ideal form and body after childbirth.
"MomsLab" contains special programs for all women, as well as pregnant women, aimed at preparing for childbirth, and courses for mothers on maternity leave, aimed at recovery after childbirth. Classes are online, and you can do prenatal yoga or postpartum workouts at home.
Choose the right program:
1) Course "Comfortable pregnancy" - all the best that you can learn in courses for pregnant women in order to conduct a comprehensive preparation for childbirth:
- Home yoga for pregnant women and cardio yoga
- Fitness for pregnant women and classes for 1,2,3 trimester
- Kegel exercises and complex workouts for pregnant women
- Breathing exercises during childbirth and physical preparation for childbirth
- Psychoprophylactic preparation and meditation
- Diet during pregnancy and meal plans for pregnant women
2) Course "Recovery" is a course for young mothers. The program is designed for 12 weeks and is aimed at the recovery and weight loss of young mothers after childbirth. Losing weight after childbirth will be easy!
What is included in the program:
- Yoga classes of different durations, activity types, and exercises for the pelvic floor muscles in order to know that there are not only Kegel exercises after childbirth
- Pilates to recover the abdomen and exercises for the waist to solve the issue of how to reduce the belly fat after childbirth
- Yoga exercises for the whole body for a comprehensive recovery of the figure after childbirth
- Fitness and cardio as ideal postpartum recovery exercises
- Home SPA procedures for comfortable psychological recovery after childbirth
3) The program "Ideal weight" - we take control of nutrition! We try to smooth out the belly, leave such a result as a thin waist and instill a healthy diet for mom after childbirth.
Simple fasting with weight loss will not help you lose weight beautifully and reduce your stomach. Therefore, we remove severe restrictions while maintaining a healthy balance, give recommendations on nutrition for pregnant women, build a mom’s menu after childbirth, and answer important questions - diet during pregnancy and mom’s diet after childbirth - is it necessary or not?
What is included in the program:
- Personal nutrition plan with simple recipes: what kind of diet should be for pregnant women; how to build nutrition for a pregnant woman in the first trimester and beyond; what to eat for mom after childbirth; how to establish proper nutrition after childbirth for a nursing mother
- Adjustment for goals: gain, hold or lose weight
- Nutrition for a pregnant woman and nutrition after childbirth: automatic calculation of calories, proteins, fat or carbohydrates, nutritional recommendations
- Podcasts and lectures on conscious eating: psychoprophylactic work and valuable recommendations from experts
- Ability to connect options with your activity level: yoga for pregnant women, workouts for pregnant women or young mothers
- Mindfulness at home: breathing practices, meditations and mindful eating techniques are suitable even for beginners
The program is designed for different women:
— Rational nutrition of pregnant women: an individual approach takes into account the trimester of pregnancy when calculating calories and useful micronutrients in food.
- Mom's nutrition after childbirth: we will learn about the nutrition diary, answer questions about breastfeeding and care, discuss how to lose weight after childbirth for a nursing mother, combine proper nutrition and weight loss
Remember - the diet during pregnancy and the diet of the mother after childbirth are different from the diet of a woman who simply wants to reduce her belly fat or lose weight quickly. Take care of your health!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026088:ios.name: Destress Now - Stress Monitor
bluejetty:00026088:ios.summary:
Oh, do you feel overwhelmed, as if you are overwhelmed by an invisible mountain? Fear not, unpack "Destress Now" to save you!
This isn't just an app, it's your personal stress management guru, your guardian angel for mental health.
bluejetty:00026088:ios.description:
Oh, do you feel overwhelmed, as if you are overwhelmed by an invisible mountain? Fear not, unpack "Destress Now" to save you!
This isn't just an app, it's your personal stress management guru, your guardian angel for mental health. "Destress Now" can read your heart beat, analyze your HRV and resting heart rate like a detective, and give you a good idea of your physical stress. It also tracks your heart rate, breathing, sleep and step count, giving you the body's secrets in a beautiful graph so you can see your health at a glance.
After understanding your body, you can create a personalized health plan for yourself, such as reminding you to drink more water, go to bed on time, and keep exercising, so that your life is healthier and stress will be reduced.
"Destress Now" is not only powerful, the interface is also super cute, and a variety of stylish dial design, so that your watch instantly transformed into a fashion item. You can change the watch face at will, making the watch an extension of your personality, and it can perfectly integrate with your iPhone's Smart Island to make your life more colorful.
"Destress Now" also prepared a series of decompression small projects, such as squeezing bubbles, coin flipping, so that you can enjoy a relaxing moment after busy, away from pressure, and maintain a relaxed and happy mood every day.
Don't worry, we are still working hard, and there will be more and better features .
So embrace "Destress Now" and make it your life's little stress reliever!
Destress Now directly tracks and analyzes heart rate variability (HRV) in health data through HealthKit, allowing you to intuitively understand your body's condition.
The data information provided in the app is for reference only and is not recommended for any medical advice or diagnosis. Before making any health-related decisions, be sure to consult a doctor for advice, as only a doctor can provide an accurate diagnosis for your individual situation.
System Permissions
Photo Album Permission: Requests access to your photo album to save images to your local album. Access occurs only when you actively save.
Camera Permission: Requests access to your camera. Upon your authorization, it captures the frequency of light changes around your finger to measure your heart rate.
Location Permission: Requests access to your location information to provide local weather, view daily UV intensity, and calculate vitamin D-related data.
You can disable photo album, camera, and location permissions at any time in system settings.
HealthKit
This app uses HealthKit. With your authorization, it can read your relevant health data from the Health app (including steps, active energy, heart rate, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep analysis, activity records, and mindfulness/emotion data) to analyze HRV, sleep quality, real-time stress and emotional state, providing you with comprehensive health references.
You can manage or revoke authorization for this app at any time in the system Health app.

You will be automatically charged at the same price and enjoy the same period of privileges for auto-sub that can be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period to take effect.
Re-sub fee will be automatically charged to your account within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Users can self-manage subscriptions or turn off auto-sub at iTunes Account settings. All unused periods of free trial shall be forfeited upon purchasement of subscription.

bluejetty:00142096:ios.summary:
Bloom Community is now Plura!

bluejetty:00142096:ios.description:
Bloom Community is now Plura!
Featured on Cosmopolitan’s “10 Best Poly Dating Apps”, and Men’s Health's “The 9 Best Polyamorous Dating Apps”. Plura flips the script on the painful hamster-wheel of online dating and gets you to the date before the swiping. 
**Dive into Exciting Adventures:**
Plura is the go-to app for queer, growth-oriented, and alternative people to find their people. Dive into a world full of exciting opportunities as you meet a diverse group of friendly and open-minded people. Whether you're looking for fun dates, new friends, or cool events, Plura is your go-to place for new adventures.
**Choose from 1,000 monthly events** :
On Plura, you will find the events hosted by the top communities in your city: parties, workshops, munches, picnics, happy hours, jams and so much more. 
**Make sure you have an epic night:** 
See who’s coming to the event, and match, and make plans to catch up at the venue. Walk into the event recognizing a few friendly faces and jump straight into connection.
**No more lost connections:** 
Have you met someone you vibed with? Find them on Plura, match with them, and deepen the connection. Our data shows that matching after an event happens 10X more than with traditional swiping. 
**Find people who align with your values**
At Plura, we're a welcoming community that encourages you to be yourself and connect with others. We hope that all the people you meet on the platform are continually working to become better at consent, more skilled in communication, and prioritize inclusion over fear. 
**Consent**
At its best, consent is an ongoing collaboration between two or more people in constant verbal, physical, and emotional dialogue about what each other needs to willingly, safely, and pleasurably engage in an interaction with one another. Consent must be affirmative, competent, informed, unprepared, specific, and ongoing.
**Communication**
We express our interests, needs, and boundaries, which creates a shared space to connect and play. We choose discomfort over resentment and speak out when things don’t feel good. We equally invite people to communicate their experience whether it’s positive or negative.
**Inclusion**
To invite everyone to express themselves, organize, and connect, welcomed, and celebrated. Plura will not tolerate any sort of sexism, racism, transphobia, fatphobia, or ableism. Creating an inclusive and welcoming space requires work on all of our parts, especially those who have benefited from unequal power dynamics and move through the world with more privilege.
**Plura+ Subscription**
You may purchase an auto-renewing app subscription for premium features like seeing who likes you, discounts on ticketed events, additional bud notes, and more.
Plura+ subscription durations (auto-renewing)
- Monthly: $24.99
- 3-month: $47.99
- 6-month: $71.99
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. It will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Download Plura today, and let the good times begin!
Privacy policy: https://heyplura.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of use: https://heyplura.com/terms-of-service

Marble Blast: Match 3 & Shoot Zumba Game is a marble game with kinds of themes. Easy and fun game for everyone. Join the magical adventure of marble blast deluxe games!
Marble Blast is a dynamic marble puzzle game where you will navigate challenging mazes and obstacles to reach the goal. Use your phone’s gyroscope to move the ball with precision to solve the unique challenges each level presents. Overcome obstacles like sliding blocks, glass walls, powered objects and doors, and pinball bumpers while avoiding pitfalls and floors that break beneath you! Give it all you got using strategy and controlled movement to achieve the best times and highest scores!
How to play:
In marble levels, your goal is to match 3 or more marbles, to clear all the marbles before they reach the end of the path. The fun never stops with different types of levels: clear all marbles, survive the time, and help release magical dragonflies and birds in jungle.
Marble Blast Zumba Features:
Marble game levels:  Easy to learn but hard to master. Tons of maps with different shapes. New levels are added constantly, so your adventure never has to stop! Using color match to blast marbles, experience the classic Zumba gameplay.
Spectacular boosters:  Cool powerfull items like bombs, colorball, meteorite rain, arrows, fireworks and many interesting props waiting for your exploration.
Amazing graphics: Marble Blast Zumba is not just a boring marble game. Explore an amazing world of beautiful maps, good music, good animation effects, cute characters, and endless fun in jungle marble blast world!
Special event with great maps: A map can lead you to find a large number of surprises to boost your Zumba adventure.
Marble Blast Zuma/Zumba Puzzle game: Marble Shooting & Puzzle Games is the best puzzle games for brain, with marble HD graphic and hard challenges! Marble blast master Puzzle is an addictive, excited and amazing marble shooting games with many colorful marbles. I hope you will have great time to relax with this Marble Shooting & Puzzle Zumba Games. It will train your brain and you can also challenge this match3 zuma games with your friends.
Offline gameplay supported, but some game features will be limited.
Easy to play marble game, download now!

bluejetty:00133948:ios.description:
Read, listen, and understand Scripture. Beautifully designed, with the licensed NIV™, the classic KJV, and Discuss, an AI study companion that answers from the Bible itself.
EVERYTHING TO READ THE BIBLE, FREE
- The entire Bible offline, with fast full-text search in your chosen translation
- Licensed NIV™ plus KJV, BSB, WEB, ASV and translations in 10+ languages
- Bible Atlas: 900+ biblical places and the great journeys of Scripture on an interactive map
- Ask Siri for today's verse, any passage, or a Scripture search
- Highlights, notes, and bookmarks that sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
- Verse of the Day widgets for your home screen, in your chosen translation
- Audio Bible with system voices, including your own Personal Voice
- An Apple Watch app, and daily reminders at the time you choose
- Tap any verse to highlight, note, compare, listen, or share it as verse art
- Built accessibility-first: VoiceOver, unlimited text size, color themes
PLANS & DEVOTIONS
- 80+ reading plans: the whole Bible in a year (canonical or M'Cheyne's calendar), the New Testament in 90 days, every New Testament book a chapter a day, the Psalms, the prophets, and short plans for a busy week
- Daily classics: Spurgeon's Morning and Evening, one reading for every morning and evening of the year
- Seasonal journeys: 25 days of Advent from the first promise in Eden to the manger, and the Twelve Days of Christmas
- Follow several plans at once, on a schedule or at your own pace, and pick up today's readings from Home
- The reader shows where you are in the plan, lights up the verses, and marks the day complete
- Every reflection reads in your chosen font and text size
- Listen to any day read aloud: the passages, then the reflection and prayer
LISTEN
- A Listen tab: today's reading, Bible audio, podcasts, worship music and classic audiobooks in one place
- Podcasts in the app, with a sleep timer and resume; worship songs with previews, favourites and services you can share
DISCUSS: ASK THE BIBLE ANYTHING (AI)
Discuss is our AI Bible-study chat: ask in plain language and get Scripture-grounded answers with verses you can open in context. Try a built-in example, then subscribe or add credits to ask your own.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Reading the full Bible offline, search, highlights, notes, the daily verse, the Bible Atlas, audio, widgets, and the Watch app are free. Bible Premium unlocks the Plans & Devotions library and Discuss, and it is how a small independent team funds the licensed NIV™. Discuss is powered by AI, which costs real money to run, so it works on credits: a weekly or monthly subscription includes a generous allowance that refreshes each period and rolls over, or you can buy a one-time credit pack whenever you need more.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.accessibleresources.com/privacy/bible-privacy-policy

Fitted — AI Closet. Digital Twin. Style Assistant.
Fitted is your AI-powered wardrobe app that organizes your clothes, creates outfits, and lets you virtually try on looks with your digital twin. Whether you're dressing for today, planning a trip, or sharing your best fits with friends—Fitted makes getting dressed effortless.
Build Your Digital Closet:
Upload in seconds — Snap a photo or choose from your gallery. Our AI instantly tags brand, color, size, and category.
Fit Pic Magic — Upload a photo of yourself in an outfit and watch AI extract each piece into individual flat-lay images.
Gmail Import — Connect your email to automatically add recent clothing purchases from your receipts.
Unlimited Storage — Add your entire wardrobe and keep track of every piece you own.
Meet Your AI Stylist:
Ask Fitted — Chat with your personal AI stylist for outfit suggestions based on weather, occasion, and your unique style.
Smart Outfit Generator — Shuffle and mix your pieces to create fresh combinations. Lock your favorites and let AI fill in the rest.
Weather-Aware Styling — Get outfit recommendations tailored to today's forecast.
Trip Planner — Tell Fitted where you're going, and it builds a custom packing list with complete outfits for every day.
Virtual Try-On:
Create Your Digital Twin — Upload a face and body photo to build your virtual avatar.
See Yourself in Any Outfit — Generate realistic images of you wearing outfits from your closet—before you put anything on.
Save & Share — Download your favorite looks to share with friends.
Discover & Connect:
Explore Public Closets — Browse other users' wardrobes, fits, and collections for style inspiration.
Follow & Friend — Connect with fashion enthusiasts and see their latest looks.
React & Comment — Show love for outfits you admire.
Direct Messages — Chat with friends about fits and style.
Stay Organized:
Filter by anything — Search your closet by color, category, brand, or season.
Favorite pieces — Keep your go-to items at the top.
Create Collections — Organize outfits for trips, events, seasons, or moods.
Track Your Wardrobe — See your closet value and style stats at a glance.
Why Fitted?
Fitted isn't just an app—it's your styling command center. Save time every morning, discover new outfit combinations you never thought of, and finally wear everything in your closet.
Have Questions? We're here to help! Reach out anytime at help@fittedcloset.com

X: @fittedcloset

Fitted — AI Closet. Digital Twin. Style Assistant.

Fitted is your AI-powered wardrobe app that organizes your clothes, creates outfits, and lets you virtually try on looks with your digital twin. Whether you're dressing for today, planning a trip, or sharing your best fits with friends—Fitted makes getting dressed effortless.

Build Your Digital Closet:
Upload in seconds — Snap a photo or choose from your gallery. Our AI instantly tags brand, color, size, and category.
Fit Pic Magic — Upload a photo of yourself in an outfit and watch AI extract each piece into individual flat-lay images.
Gmail Import — Connect your email to automatically add recent clothing purchases from your receipts.
Unlimited Storage — Add your entire wardrobe and keep track of every piece you own.

Meet Your AI Stylist:
Ask Fitted — Chat with your personal AI stylist for outfit suggestions based on weather, occasion, and your unique style.
Smart Outfit Generator — Shuffle and mix your pieces to create fresh combinations. Lock your favorites and let AI fill in the rest.
Weather-Aware Styling — Get outfit recommendations tailored to today's forecast.
Trip Planner — Tell Fitted where you're going, and it builds a custom packing list with complete outfits for every day.

Virtual Try-On:
Create Your Digital Twin — Upload a face and body photo to build your virtual avatar.
See Yourself in Any Outfit — Generate realistic images of you wearing outfits from your closet—before you put anything on.
Save & Share — Download your favorite looks to share with friends.

Discover & Connect:
Explore Public Closets — Browse other users' wardrobes, fits, and collections for style inspiration.
Follow & Friend — Connect with fashion enthusiasts and see their latest looks.
React & Comment — Show love for outfits you admire.
Direct Messages — Chat with friends about fits and style.

Stay Organized:
Filter by anything — Search your closet by color, category, brand, or season.
Favorite pieces — Keep your go-to items at the top.
Create Collections — Organize outfits for trips, events, seasons, or moods.
Track Your Wardrobe — See your closet value and style stats at a glance.

Why Fitted?
Fitted isn't just an app—it's your styling command center. Save time every morning, discover new outfit combinations you never thought of, and finally wear everything in your closet.

Have Questions? We're here to help! Reach out anytime at help@fittedcloset.com

Stay Connected:
Website: fittedcloset.com
TikTok: @myfittedcloset
Instagram: @myfittedcloset
X: @fittedcloset

More Info:
Privacy: https://app.fittedcloset.com/pc/pp.html
Terms: https://app.fittedcloset.com/pc/ts.html

bluejetty:00190278:android.description:
Introducing Rain Video Music - Photo Editor with Song, a versatile and innovative app that combines the power of photo editing and video creation with mesmerizing music. Unleash your creativity and transform your photos into captivating videos that tell a unique story. With a wide array of features, this app offers a seamless and enjoyable editing experience, making it an essential tool for anyone looking to enhance their visual content.
Key Features:
1) Photo to Video Options:
- Photo Slideshow: Create stunning slideshows using your favorite photos and add music to bring your memories to life.
- Video Editor: Edit and customize your videos with various filters, transitions, text, and stickers to make them stand out.
- Video Trim: Precisely trim and cut your videos to remove unwanted parts or focus on specific moments.
- Video Merge: Combine multiple videos into a single, seamless masterpiece effortlessly.
- Slow Video: Slow down the pace of your videos to highlight essential moments and add a touch of drama.
- Fast Video: Speed up your videos for a fun and dynamic effect that will engage your audience.
- Reverse Video: Play your videos in reverse for a unique and mesmerizing experience.
2) Photo Editor Features:
- Photo Collage: Arrange your photos in beautifully designed collages and showcase your memories in style.
- Echo: Create captivating visual effects with the echo feature, giving your photos an otherworldly touch.
- Erase: Remove unwanted objects or people from your photos with the powerful erase tool.
- Photo Frames and Effects: Choose from a wide selection of frames and effects to add the perfect finishing touch to your photos.
- Unlimited Wallpapers: Access a vast collection of high-quality wallpapers for your device to keep it fresh and stylish.
3) Lyrical Video Status Maker:
- Express yourself with lyrical video status messages by using your beautiful images combined with heart-touching music and lyrical texts.
- Share your creations on social media platforms to impress your friends and followers with your unique style.
Rain Video Music - Photo Editor with Song brings together an intuitive interface and powerful editing tools, allowing users of all skill levels to create masterpieces effortlessly. Whether you are a social media enthusiast, a content creator, or simply someone who loves adding a personal touch to you

bluejetty:00098339:ios.description:
Ace Your GED Exam with Confidence!
Prepare smarter, not harder with the ultimate GED Exam Prep app. Whether you're returning to your studies or brushing up for test day, this app gives you all the tools you need to succeed and earn your high school equivalency diploma.
Be ready, stay sharp, and pass your GED exam on the first try.
Key Features:
*Up-to-Date Questions – Practice with a comprehensive library of questions aligned with the latest GED exam standards.
*Detailed Explanations – Understand every answer with clear, concise explanations that build your knowledge and test-taking confidence.
*Covers All Major Courses – Get full coverage of GED subjects including Mathematical Reasoning, Reasoning Through Language Arts, Science, and Social Studies.
*Various Test Modes – Choose from Missed questions test mode, Quick test, or focus on Saved questions — study your way.
*Track Your Progress – Monitor your daily improvement, review performance stats, and stay motivated.
***********
Premium access
To access all the premium features and content, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://appslaunchpad.com/policy
Terms of Use: https://appslaunchpad.com/terms

The Quiet Collection is a spiritual formation resource that provides audio collections for contemplation through various seasons and stages of life.
Written by podcaster and New York Times bestselling author Emily P. Freeman, this is a resource you can listen to first thing in the morning, before you go to bed, or as you go along the way. With a combination of both ancient prayers and original content, the readings and reflective piano music will help you center your mind and ease the low-grade hum of anxiety that often pulses just beneath the surface of our lives.
Whether you consider yourself to be a person of faith, whether your beliefs are deeply rooted or recently uprooted, whether you closely identify with a particular Christian tradition or are just spiritually curious, we hope you'll find welcome here.
May the quiet surround and encourage you, and may grace surprise you kindly along the way.
Text + Audio: Every offering is accessible by either listening or reading.
Borrowed Prayers: Readings of ancient and familiar prayers, included with the free download of the app.
Collections: Every Collection is written and read by Emily P. Freeman and accompanied with original piano music by Caleb Peavy. The Collections are available for purchase in-app.

bluejetty:00076676:ios.name: LensAI・Identifier・Image Search
bluejetty:00076676:ios.summary:
EveryScan is an AI-powered scanner app that helps you identify animals, plants, coins, jewelry, food, cards, and other objects using your phone camera.
Skip search engines — just take a picture and get instant answers about the world around
bluejetty:00076676:ios.description:
EveryScan is an AI-powered scanner app that helps you identify animals, plants, coins, jewelry, food, cards, and other objects using your phone camera.
Skip search engines — just take a picture and get instant answers about the world around you. Whether you're exploring nature, examining collectibles, or curious about a movie scene, EveryScan delivers accurate image recognition right on your device.
Use the built-in AI translator to point your camera at any text and instantly translate it into one of 90+ languages. You can also scan any shopping item — from clothes and jewelry to electronics — to compare prices and find the best deal.
USE THIS APP TO:
- Scan sport cards and TCG cards to check their price, value, and rarity level
- Identify animals from a photo (including dog and cat breeds)
- Recognize insects, spiders, snakes, and reptiles
- Identify birds by sight or sound
- Scan plants, flowers, mushrooms, and trees
- Detect coins and learn their origin and estimated value
- Scan jewelry and antiques to discover their value and details
- Shop smarter — scan any item to compare prices 
- Examine stamps and discover their history and rarity
- Analyze food and meals for nutritional information
- Find movies, series, games, or anime from a video still
- Identify celebrities and actors from a photo
AI-POWERED FEATURES:
- Accurate image recognition tailored for camera use
- AI Assistant: ask it any follow-up questions and get instant answers
- Instant object detection and identification
- Universal identifier: insects, dog breeds, flowers, spiders, snakes, and more
- Real-time scanning with your phone
- AI Translator: supports 90+ languages
- Comprehensive data on animals, plants, collectibles, and everyday items
- Save and mark favorites for easy access
EveryScan helps you identify the world around you — just point your camera and learn instantly!
BEST FOR:
- Nature explorers and hikers
- Coin and antique collectors
- Shopaholics to compare prices on the go
- Card collectors 
- Movie and TV fans
- Students learning about animals and plants
- Anyone curious about objects around them
From nature lovers to collectors and movie fans — EveryScan turns your camera into a smart search engine for the real world!
FAQ:
How do I use the app?
Just point your camera at any object — the app will recognize it and provide all the information in seconds.
Can this app identify animals from a photo?
Yes. The AI analyzes the image and identifies the animal, including species or breed.
What about insects? Will I know if it's dangerous?
Yes. The app identifies insects and provides information about them, including whether they are commonly known to be harmful.
Can I use the scanner to identify trading cards?
Yes. The app also shows the card's estimated value, price, and rarity level.
Is the app free to use?
EveryScan offers a free version with core features. Advanced tools may require in-app purchases.
No more typing into search engines — just point your camera and learn instantly. EveryScan combines AI image recognition with a simple interface, giving you a world of knowledge at your fingertips.
Privacy Policy: http://aiscanner.co/pp 
Terms of Use: http://aiscanner.co/tou 
Support: support@aiscanner.co
