bluejetty:00060747:ios.description:
SideBooks is a high performance, high speed PDF viewer that allows you to enjoy reading with the feel of actual paper.
=Features=
Curl animation that simulates the actual turning of paper pages has been added to the standard page slide function.
Supports viewing from 3 directions, documents that open left to right, right to left and vertically. It provides the optimal environment for viewing any book.
All zoom rates have been optimized providing high speed, dynamic screen display.
An infinite hierarchy of folders can be created, moved, deleted, renamed, etc. using the enhanced bookshelf management function.
Real visual bookshelf function that corresponds to back cover style display.
Files can be imported by 3 methods, Network transfer through Dropbox, USB transfer through iTunes and direct transfer from other applications.
Books can be protected so others cannot view them by using the password protected locking function.
This is a universal application that operates on the iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad.
=Functions=
Overall:
*Brightness Adjustment
*Screen rotates to match the orientation of the device
*Screen Rotation Lock
*Password Protected Start-up Lock
Viewer:
*Support PDF,ZIP,CBZ,RAR and CBR format
*Page Turning: Choose from slide or curl
*Viewing Directions: Choose from opening left to right / right to left / vertically
*Page Spacing: Choose form wide / narrow / none
*Facing Pages: Choose the pair of facing pages by setting the cover to on or off
*Trim function within the range of page display
*Cache pre-read function for the previous and next pages
*Set the display for each book and remember the page number of the last page read
*Text search function (list display type)
*Contents function (also supports hierarchy type)
*Bookmark function (with editable memos)
*Edit handwritten notes
*Send to other applications (Open-In)
*Send by email
*Printing function (Air Print)
*In-page link function
*Link to outside URL function (built-in browser / Safari / Printing)
*Display / Don't Display link buttons
*Page turning function using tap or swipe
*Expansion / Contraction function using pinch and double tap (1-1024x zoom)
*Viewing of encrypted PDF files with password protection
*Display / non-display of statusbar when reading
Bookshelf:
*Display form: Choose form list bookshelf / visual bookshelf
*Function to set theme of visual bookshelf with each folder
*Bookshelf thema extension pack (Add-On)
*Cover editing function (corresponds to the trim)
*File editing function: create, move, delete, setting for all books in folder
*Bookmark list
*Reading history list
*Unread list
*Edit of mark choose form already read / unread
*Book name search function
*Network transfer through Dropbox
*USB transfer through iTunes
*Direct transfer from other applications
Special thanks to, 
"Give My Regards to Black Jack"
SHUHO SATO
Manga on Web
http://mangaonweb.com

bluejetty:00024871:ios.description:
iPeriod® – Period & Cycle Tracking Since 2008
Trusted by millions of women. Beautifully redesigned for today.
Since 2008, iPeriod has helped women track their periods, understand their cycles, and recognize patterns in their health. Now beautifully redesigned, iPeriod makes personal health tracking easier and more intuitive than ever.
“A must-have Personal Assistant” – MSN
“Top iPhone App for Busy Women” – Forbes
“Simple yet ingenious” – Popular Science
“What’s Hot” – App Store
YOUR CYCLE. YOUR HEALTH. YOUR WAY.
Whether you're tracking periods, planning for pregnancy, observing fertility signs, or navigating perimenopause, iPeriod helps you record what matters to you.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE iPERIOD
• Trusted since 2008, with millions of downloads
• Beautifully redesigned Home screen and interactive cycle ring
• Intuitive calendar with cycle history and predictions
• Easy daily tracking of periods, symptoms, moods, and more
• Expanded symptom library, including perimenopause and menopause-related symptoms
• Personalized period and fertile-window estimates
• Customizable tracking, charts, and reports
• Discreet reminders and familiar “iP” app icon
TRACK WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Record periods and flow, fertility signs, ovulation information, physical and emotional symptoms, moods, basal body temperature, weight, sleep, activity, and personal notes.
Find symptoms quickly with the new search feature, customize your tracking, and explore patterns in your health history over time.
A BEAUTIFULLY REDESIGNED EXPERIENCE
Explore your cycle with an interactive ring, a clearer calendar, redesigned daily details, easier navigation, and smoother performance. Everything is designed to make tracking feel effortless.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your health information is your business.
• We never sell your private health data
• We never share your cycle or symptom history with advertisers or data brokers
• Your backed-up health information is encrypted
• Password protection helps keep your information secure
• You control when to export or share your health reports
Your health. Your history. Your choice.
SMART, DISCREET REMINDERS
Set reminders for upcoming periods, fertile windows, medications, breast self-exams, and personal health needs. Check estimated period dates when planning travel or important events.
CHARTS, REPORTS & APPLE HEALTH
Explore cycle patterns and past entries with charts and reports. Export PDF reports to review your history or bring to a healthcare appointment.
Integrate supported Apple Health information, including menstrual data, activity, weight, and other wellness information.
MAKE iPERIOD YOUR OWN
Personalize your experience with custom symptoms and moods, flexible settings, and advanced chart options.
iPERIOD PREMIUM
Enjoy more features while supporting an independent small business.
• Ad-free experience
• Advanced, customizable charts
• Additional symptom and mood customization
• Unlimited PDF report exports
Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Eligible annual subscribers can try Premium free for 7 days. PDF export is also available as a separate one-time purchase.
Since creating iPeriod in 2008, we've remained an independent small business dedicated to thoughtful women's health tools and respecting your privacy. Your support helps us keep improving.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Cycle predictions and fertility estimates are informational only. iPeriod is not a contraceptive method or a substitute for professional medical advice.
Privacy Policy:
https://iperiod.net/PrivacyPolicyiPeriod.html
End User License Agreement:
https://iperiod.net/iPeriodEULA.html
The iPeriod you know and trust. Beautifully reimagined.

bluejetty:00138231:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Yatzy! This is a classic dice game filled with strategy and fun. Embark on a journey with Yatzy GO! – the ultimate classic dice game adventure that seamlessly blends luck and strategy. Whether you know it as Yatze, Yatzi, Yatzee, or Yahtzee, our app promises the best in classic dice gameplay. Download now and roll the dice to test your luck in achieving a BIG Yatzy!
HOW TO PLAY?
New to this dice board game? No worries! Yatzy GO! is fun, fast, and easy to learn. With 13 rounds and 5 dice per round, roll up to 3 times, aiming to attain the highest score by completing various dice combinations. Full House, Three-of-a-Kind, Four-of-a-Kind, Small Straight, Large Straight, and Yatzy! Choose wisely, as each combination can only be scored once! Outscore your opponents to claim victory and earn rewards!
HIGHLIGHTS
- Fever Time: when the game reaches a certain round, each player gains an extra roll opportunity.
- Dice Collections: Personalize your game with a variety of dice skin options!
- Championship System: Compete in thrilling tournaments to prove your Yatzy mastery and earn exclusive rewards!
- Suitable for all ages — play with friends and family!
- Offline available in all modes, no Wi-Fi needed.
- Sharpen your brain with strategic choices for the best combination.
- Relaxing sound effects for a delightful gaming experience.
- Yatzy GO! is free to download and play!
Yatzy GO! is your go-to destination for the best dice game! Easy to learn but challenging to master – roll the dice and claim the Yatzy crown now!

-Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
-Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
-Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
-Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00138010:ios.summary: AuroraReach app is an aurora tracking, forecasting and alerting app that gives local aurora visibility scores for cities around the world. We take weather conditions like cloud cover, visibility, time of day etc. along with aurora score to
bluejetty:00138010:ios.description:
AuroraReach app is an aurora tracking, forecasting and alerting app that gives local aurora visibility scores for cities around the world. We take weather conditions like cloud cover, visibility, time of day etc. along with aurora score to generate a score that can help you find the aurora visibility times for a gives city. Along with aurora, weather conditions are also predicted for up to 4 days. We also let users checkin an aurora sighting and alert based on that.
We track ~24K cities around the world for aurora activity and weather conditions. It is easy to get started by subscribing to alerts for multiple cities and get alerted on the app for free. Realtime aurora map shows the aurora activity on the map and you can interact with the map to select the cities we are tracking from map and having activity at that time. Aurora Travel destination searching is easier with this and with our city search page you can search by city or country for viewing the city aurora forecast report and subscribe to cities for alerts. You can favorite the cities for quick accesses in the future even if you are not registered with an account.
As we track city specific aurora scores, we cover cities under the northern lights (aurora borealis), southern lights (aurora australis) and even cities where aurora hasn't occurred till date. Web page has sighting specific pages to chat on realtime aurora sighting, this will be released soon in the app version too. 
Enjoy hunting auroras with AuroraReach and find your next aurora destination with this app.

bluejetty:00163209:ios.description:
Votre compte retraite sur mobile, c’est ...
... pour les actifs :
 - visualiser votre carrière, quelles que soient vos activités (fonctionnaire, salarié, indépendant...), et vos droits à la retraite (nombre trimestres et de points cotisés)
 - accéder aux coordonnées des régimes auxquels vous avez cotisés dans votre carrière
 - consulter des contenus pour vous aider à mieux comprendre les droits à la retraite que vous avez acquis
... pour les retraités :
 - connaître la date de votre prochain versement retraite
 - consulter et télécharger vos attestations fiscales des deux dernières années
 - consulter des contenus pour vous aider à mieux comprendre votre retraite
Pour tous : des actualités qui vous éclaireront sur la retraite dans le système actuel et sur les changements à venir.
Pour se connecter, vous devez simplement créer votre compte sur Mon compte retraite, si vous ne l’avez pas déjà fait sur www.info-retraite.fr
A propos de l’Union Retraite :
L’Union Retraite est le groupement d’intérêt public (GIP) qui réunit les organismes de retraite, de base et complémentaire. Sous la marque Info Retraite, il propose des services développés en commun par l’ensemble des régimes pour simplifier la retraite des assurés. Ces services sont disponibles sur le site internet commun à tous les régimes de retraite, www.info-retraite.fr, et sur ceux de certains régimes. L’application Mon compte retraite offre un accès simple, pratique et sécurisé à une partie de ces services.

bluejetty:00095689:android.description:
PicsSwap is an intelligent AI-powered photo and video editing app designed to enhance your appearance, swap faces, and generate dynamic videos from static images. Whether you want to enhance body features, create eye-catching videos, or completely transform your image with a face swap, 
This all-in-one app is perfect for users who want to explore aesthetic changes, fun transformations, or social media-ready content with just a single tap.
PicsSwap: AI Photos & Videos is a next-generation creative app that uses artificial intelligence to transform photos into animated videos and high-impact visual edits. Designed for users who want to stand out on social media or explore artistic self-expression, the app offers a wide range of AI-driven tools including dance video generation, gym-themed face swaps, and custom animation presets.
Whether you're looking to bring a single image to life with movement or visualize yourself in a gym-ready look, PicsSwap makes it easy to create visually striking and engaging content.
Twerk Video Generator Turn your image into a fun, energetic twerk dance video. Choose from different dance styles, outfits, and background effects. Great for social media sharing and entertainment.
Face Swap and Gender-Based Animation PicsVid intelligently detects facial features and gender to generate the most suitable video effects and poses for men and women. Achieve personalized results with high accuracy.
AI Body Enhancer Easily modify body features such as chest, belly, arms, or muscles. Enhance your physique with natural-looking results powered by advanced body detection and enhancement algorithms.
AI Face Swap Swap faces on photos and videos with high precision. Place your face on any model, character, or celebrity in seconds. The AI blends facial features smoothly for seamless results.
Photo to AI Video Convert your photo into a full-motion video. Choose from categories like casual, fitness, party, dance, or fashion clips. The AI animates your face and body realistically for lifelike video output.
Gender-Adaptive Editing Automatically detect user gender to provide the most fitting transformations. Select from male and female styles to match poses, clothing, and effects tailored to your preferences.
Realistic Video Generator Upload your image and generate high-quality videos such as model walks, body posing, or fashion showcases. The app renders smooth and realistic video content using deep motion AI.
Features
- Twerk Vibes A bold and rhythmic dance sequence with smooth hip movement.
- Shake in Style A blend of confident gestures and body shakes with stylish flair.
- Sultry Kneel A dramatic pose-focused animation that combines elegance and attitude.
- Back Bounce Energetic movement emphasizing the back and hip rhythm.
- Knee Down A low-motion, grounded dance with expressive body flow.
- Slay & Sway A stylish and fluid performance that combines grace and confidence.
- Twerk Throne A power-driven sequence focused on assertive twerk choreography.
- Dance Moves A selection of high-energy freestyle moves designed for visual impact.

bluejetty:00060958:ios.description:
Impress gives everyday entrepreneurs and small business owners the tools to be impressive.
As small business owners or self employed contractors, we need a better way to stand out from the crowd. Impress makes it easy to create high-quality professional business cards, logos, stickers, and more from the convenience of your phone or tablet. You can also create designs by entering keywords and letting our Designer generate images for you.
Design and order your products while you're on the move, and they will arrive at your doorstep in just a few days! As a small business ourselves, we know that every customer counts and we pride ourselves in:
• Transparent pricing.
• Lightning fast customer service.
• 100% money back guarantee if you're not satisfied with your order.
Business card details: Select from multiple professional and modern designs, or use our Designer to generate your own. Create a professional looking photo collage with your photos. Once your order is placed, we will send a proof within 1 business day.

• Printed in premium paper stock with a smooth matte or glossy finish.
• Select from multiple professional design templates.
• Printed in full color on both sides of the card.
• Final card size: 3.50" x 2.0”.
• Final artwork size: 3.66" x 2.16" (300dpi).
There's no need to walk to your local Fedex or Kinkos anymore. Create amazing marketing collateral for your small business or store from the convenience of your iPhone or iPad. Integrate your existing logo into one of our great designs or easily create a new one with our easy to use graphic design tool.
Have a Squarespace or Wix website? Complement your site with beautiful business cards. Don't want a printed product? Use our photo collage designs in your digital ads when you run them on Angie's List, Craigslist or Yelp.

bluejetty:00129297:ios.description:
Bhagavad Gita Hindi app is to learn about the timeless wisdom of the Shrimad Bhagwat Geeta, where Lord Krishna imparts teachings on Dharma and Bhakti. Available in Hindi, English, and as an audio podcast, it's your ultimate guide to a transformative spiritual journey!
Explore the Bhagavad Gita Hindi all chapters and verses that encompass the knowledge of Supreme
Ishvara – The Supreme Lord
Jiva – The Living Entity
Prakruti – The Material Nature
Kala – Eternal Time
Karma – Activities
Immerse yourself in the timeless wisdom of this sacred scripture, which contains the essence of Vedic knowledge and serves as the keystone of Hinduism.
*************************************
BHAGAVAD GITA HINDI FEATURES:
*************************************
1. Complete All Chapters: Access all chapters of Bhagavad Gita, comprising slokas, offering invaluable insights into life's fundamental truths.
2. Yoga of Consciousness: Each chapter represents a specialized yoga, guiding you on the path of attaining realization of the Ultimate Truth and achieving communion with the 
 Supreme.
3. Slokas with Vivarana: Dive deep into the profound verses of Bhagavad Gita, accompanied by detailed explanations and commentaries for a comprehensive understanding.
4. Gita Saramsam: Explore the essence of each chapter, extracting the key teachings and philosophical principles that can enrich your spiritual journey.
5. Sri Krishna's Jananam: Learn about the birth and divine manifestations of Lord Krishna, unraveling the mysteries of His existence and His role in imparting wisdom.
6. Krishna Slokas and Astotharamulu: Delve into a collection of beautiful slokas and chants dedicated to Lord Krishna, deepening your devotion and connection with the divine.
7. Festivals List: Stay updated with a comprehensive list of festivals and their significance, allowing you to align your spiritual practices and celebrations accordingly.
8. Sloka Sharing: Share your favorite slokas with friends and loved ones, spreading the profound teachings and inspiring others on their spiritual path.
9. Track Progress: Keep track of the slokas you have completed, allowing you to monitor your progress and stay motivated on your journey of self-discovery.
10.Favorites: Create a personalized collection of your favorite slokas, enabling quick access to the verses that resonate deeply with you.
11.Greeting Card Generator: Create beautiful greeting cards adorned with inspiring quotes from Bhagavad Gita, perfect for sharing on special occasions or sending heartfelt 
 messages.
12.English Translation: Benefit from an English translation of all Bhagavad Gita slokas, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the profound teachings.
This comprehensive Bhagavad Gita app features slokas, commentary, Gita essence, Krishna's birth, slokas, and more. Experience the festival calendar, share slokas, track progress, and generate greeting cards with quotes. 
Our Bhagavad Gita Hindi app is your all-in-one guide to the divine teachings of Shrimad Bhagavad Geeta. From detailed slokas and insightful commentary to devotional tools and a spiritual festival calendar, it supports your journey toward self-realization and spiritual growth.
Dive into the timeless teachings of the Bhagwad Geeta, enrich your bhakti with devotional chants, and explore related scriptures like the Garud Puran for a holistic spiritual experience.
Start your spiritual journey today! Jai Shree Krishna!

bluejetty:00160078:ios.name: Wishbob – Online wish list
bluejetty:00160078:ios.summary: Wishbob is the free online wish list that isn't tied to any shop - for birthdays, Christmas, weddings, baby showers and every other occasion. Add gifts from any online shop and share your list via a link with family and friends. They reserv
bluejetty:00160078:ios.description:
Wishbob is the free online wish list that isn't tied to any shop - for birthdays, Christmas, weddings, baby showers and every other occasion. Add gifts from any online shop and share your list via a link with family and friends. They reserve gifts without an account - so you avoid duplicate gifts. 10 million wishes have already been added on Wishbob.
THE ADVANTAGES OF WISHBOB
- Create an online wish list for free - no traditional registration, simply with your email address
- Add wishes with one click from any online shop - with the Wishbob Button, the browser extension for Chrome and Firefox or the Shop Browser in the app
- Share your wish list by link, messenger, email or QR code
- Avoid duplicate gifts - guests reserve without their own account
- Optional notification when someone reserves a gift - the surprise stays intact
- Works on iPhone and iPad, and in the browser on any computer
- Safe and private: only visible via your link, GDPR-compliant on EU servers
THE WISH LIST FOR YOUR MOST IMPORTANT OCCASIONS
BIRTHDAY WISH LIST
Family and friends find the right gift - for every age and budget. Guests see right away what's already reserved.
CHRISTMAS WISH LIST
Keep the whole family's wish lists in one place. You can also share the letter to Santa with grandparents and relatives.
WEDDING WISH LIST
Your online wedding registry: edit it together and share it with a QR code on your invitation.
BABY WISH LIST
Note sizes, brands and models for your baby's essentials - for a baby shower, birth or christening.
KIDS' BIRTHDAY WISH LIST
Help grandparents and relatives with specific, age-appropriate gift ideas.
MORE OCCASIONS
Wishbob also works as a wish list for Easter, christenings, starting school, graduations and housewarmings.
HOW WISHBOB WORKS IN 3 STEPS
1. Create a wish list - open Wishbob in the browser or in the app, enter your email, choose the occasion
2. Add wishes - from online shops with one click or your own ideas manually
3. Send the link to family and friends - they reserve their gifts
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
- Prioritize wishes („important“ or „very important“)
- Givers can optionally leave their name
- Invite others to edit your wish list - ideal for parents and couples
- Remove fulfilled wishes with one click
- Personalize banner, profile picture and occasion text
- Manage and reuse multiple wish lists in parallel
COMPATIBLE ONLINE SHOPS
Wishbob works with all online shops. Direct integration with Amazon, Etsy, Mamas & Papas, Boots, eBay, ASOS, John Lewis, Argos, Currys and Waterstones, among others. Wishes from local shops, experiences or vouchers can be added manually. The Wishbob browser extension is available for Chrome and Firefox.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is Wishbob really free?
Yes. Wishbob is free - including for the people you send your list to.
Do I need an account or password?
No. You start with your email address, no traditional registration, no password. Alternatively, sign in with Apple, Google, Facebook or Amazon. Your guests don't need an account either.
How secure is my wish list?
Wishbob stores data on GDPR-compliant servers in the EU. Your wish list is only visible to people you actively share the link with.

Đồ gia dụng, hóa mỹ phẩm, chăm sóc nhà cửa nhập khẩu trực tiếp, chất lượng ổn định.

bluejetty:00071157:ios.description:
Who is taking a nap in the grass? Isn’t that your Red Panda? Adopt your new virtual pet, chose a name for him and discover exciting adventures and games in the jungle!
As a virtual pet, your friend will always be by your side. Feed him with treats and make sure that he is always hydrated. Play exciting games so that he doesn’t get bored. Wash him whenever he gets dirty while playing. And the most important thing: pet your Red Panda so that he knows how much you love him!
Of course, your Red Panda also likes to be entertained. The glade of the bamboo forest invites you to play and to explore. If you want for new challenges for you and your companion, you won’t have to look too far. Use the map and travel to new exotic places where you can unlock more than 10 mini games. Take him gliding in heights above the old ruins and help him avoid obstacles and canyons.
You prefer calmer activities? No problem. Puzzle games and other riddles are entertaining for everyone! The playground invites you and your Red Panda to play around. Travel to the Dome and see the exciting and interactive games that are waiting for you. Here you can gain experience and collect coins while having fun with your Red Panda.
But the best thing about this? You can do these things in either 3D or in augmented reality! That way you can bring your Red Panda into your own world and interact with him directly.
To be full up on energy for the next adventure, your companion will also need to take breaks now and then. A shadowy spot is the best place for a nap, so the mysterious ruins are just the right place. But maybe you can find another place to count sheep with your panda?
Your pet always wants to look good on pictures, that is why grooming should not be forgotten. Help your pet clean its fur from bothersome insects. Change up the look of your Red Panda with lots of cute skins. Visit the cave to switch up the look.
Your new friendship is all set to explode into full bloom!
• Choose a name for you Red Panda and start a wonderful friendship!
• Take care of your Panda’s needs
• Discover the bamboo forest and more exotic places
• Play exciting games for rewards
• Unlock up to 16 great skins for your pet
• Use the augmented reality mode and bring your Red Panda into your life
In case of questions or issues, feel free to send us an email at apps@tivola.de.

bluejetty:00096893:ios.name: Color Shooter: Cube Sort
bluejetty:00096893:ios.summary:
Step into a soothing world where colors fall into harmony and every tap brings a little spark of satisfaction.
Color Shooter: Cube Sort offers a peaceful puzzle experience wrapped in soft visuals, relaxing sounds, and simple, rewarding inte
bluejetty:00096893:ios.description:
Step into a soothing world where colors fall into harmony and every tap brings a little spark of satisfaction.
Color Shooter: Cube Sort offers a peaceful puzzle experience wrapped in soft visuals, relaxing sounds, and simple, rewarding interactions.
Your adorable elephant companion leads the way. With each gentle shot of color, cubes clear one by one, creating a smooth and calming flow across the board. There’s no rush and no pressure—just satisfying color matches and the quiet joy of watching the screen tidy itself.
Relaxing & Easy-to-Play
Play at your own pace using simple tap controls. Launch your elephant or other little shooter creatures onto the conveyor and match cubes by color. Clear the board step by step and enjoy the feeling of everything falling neatly into place.
A Soft Layer of Strategy
Organize your shooters in the 5 waiting slots, time each move, and keep the conveyor running smoothly. These small decisions add just enough depth to keep your mind engaged, without ever overwhelming you.
Soothing Visuals & Gentle Feedback
Every correct match creates a crisp, clean pop of color.
Watch the board shift from cluttered to orderly as you clear cubes in a calming rhythm.
It’s the perfect way to relax your mind during breaks, evenings, or whenever you need a moment of peace.
Features You’ll Enjoy
• Calm, satisfying color-matching gameplay
• One-tap controls perfect for all ages
• Cute elephant companion that brightens every level
• Light strategy with no stress or time limits
• Smooth animations and soothing sound effects
• Short, relaxing sessions ideal for daily unwinding
Whether you’re looking to clear your mind, enjoy gentle brain stimulation, or simply relax with a soothing puzzle, Color Shooter: Cube Sort offers a comforting escape into color and flow.
Download now and unwind with every calming pop of color.

bluejetty:00030400:ios.name: WSB-TV Weather
bluejetty:00030400:ios.summary:
Chief Meteorologist Brad Nitz and Severe Weather Team 2 have made the most accurate local weather app, “The WSBTV Weather App,” even better. 
Atlanta’s most powerful weather app includes the following:
- There is a new radar in the weath
bluejetty:00030400:ios.description:
Chief Meteorologist Brad Nitz and Severe Weather Team 2 have made the most accurate local weather app, “The WSBTV Weather App,” even better. 
Atlanta’s most powerful weather app includes the following:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250-meter resolution, the highest available.
- New alert types - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types.
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab.
- Locally crafted forecasts - Select a location inside the Atlanta market to see a local forecast created by WSB’s local weather experts. The app also tells you which member of Severe Weather Team 2 crafted the local forecast. National applications that come pre-loaded on your phone don’t have local experts focused solely on getting the local forecast right every day.
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it.
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
The WSBTV Weather App also has these critical benefits and features:
- The app is constantly updated with the latest area storm and forecast information and includes Severe Weather Team 2’s 5-day Forecast with the “Weekend Always in View.”
- Live Stormtracker 2HD Radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- It provides Location-Based Storm Alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, The WSBTV Weather App supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- Level 3 interactive radar, animation/loops and visible satellite map
- Additional items added seasonally
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Daily and Hourly forecasts updated hourly
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

bluejetty:00154253:ios.description:
Paiactive focuses on hardware and software products in the field of big health such as personal smart health, smart exercises and healthy home environment. We are dedicated to become the leader and definer of quality life by providing relevant AI data computing and operation services.
Smart skipping rope
The smartskipping rope provides you with professional data calculation as skipping time, times, frequency and consumed calorie. The statistics are saved on the cloud while can be synchronized to the APP in anytime. Every time you skip, calculate BPM and output rate curve, can easily find your body rhythm and the rhythm of constant rope jumpping. 
Intelligent body fat scale
The Intelligent body fat scale body fat scale provides you with 12 whole body data such as body weight, body fat, BMI, water and protein, as well as 10 local data measurements such as fat rate and muscle mass. It provides statistics and analysis of your physical condition, rational diet and Exercise advices.
Smart Sports Watch
The smart sports watch supports 14 sports modes such as running and cycling, providing you with all-round functions of motion track, real-time heart rate and data recording. At the same time, it supports sleep, real-time heart rate monitoring, message notification, reminder and other common functions
**Pactive app supports HealthKit, you can view your health data through HealthKit**

Monthly subscription with 7-day free trial period is $9.99 or equal to the same price tier as Apple App Store Matrix determines as the equivalent of subscription price in USD. 
Weekly subscription with 3-day free trial period is $7.99 or equal to the same price tier as Apple App Store Matrix determines as the equivalent of subscription price in USD.

Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to iTunes Account Settings. For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when a user decides to subscribe.
*Motion & Fitness Activity - so we could track your steps
*Location - so we could build your trainings' routes
*Health kit - so you could export your data to Apple Health
*Notifications - so we could notify you about your progress

bluejetty:00081968:ios.description:
Magnific (formerly Freepik) is your all-in-one AI creative suite for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Whether you're designing from scratch or turning ideas into impactful content, Magnific helps you generate, edit, and publish visuals directly from your device.
From Idea to Image in Minutes
· Quickly turn any idea into images with the AI Image Generator and models like GPT-2, Nano Banana 2, Imagen 4, Flux, Classic, Ideogram, Mystic, and Seedream.
· Prepare your visual for any format. Whether you're working on social media posts, stories, or presentations, you can start building your campaign or assets from the ground up right from your phone.
· Keep your images consistent with styles. From photorealistic visuals to more creative illustrations, you have a wide variety of styles to ensure consistency across all your pieces.
· Get full control over your creations with color, framing, and lighting effects. You can also control and create new characters to star in your designs.
Create Engaging Clips from an Image or Text
· Use models like Seedance 2, Veo 3, Kling 2.1, Runway Gen 4, MiniMax Hailuo 02, PixVerse 6, and many more to turn text prompts or photos—depending on the model—into cinematic, animated, or realistic videos.
· Animate images created with the AI Image Generator using your visuals as starting or ending frames. Produce on-brand, visually consistent clips for promotional campaigns from the palm of your hand.
Perfect Any Visual with AI
· Get your images campaign-ready with a sharp, professional finish using Upscaler.
· Replace the background of your visuals with Background Remover and place your products or characters anywhere in a matter of seconds.
· Edit any detail of your image with the AI Photo Editor. Enter your prompt and quickly adjust your visuals.
· Create full video projects with the Video Editor, trimming and adjusting your clips with mobile-friendly tools.
Get Started with Ready-to-Use Content
· Access millions of photos, vectors, icons, PSDs, templates, mockups, and videos to kick off your projects quickly.
The Perfect Creative Partner for Everyone
· The Magnific app helps you create complete, professional designs with easy-to-follow workflows, ideal for:
· Small businesses and entrepreneurs: create ads, menus, flyers, or product visuals in minutes.
· Content creators: generate AI visuals and videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more.
· Creative professionals: access advanced design tools and AI models in a mobile-friendly format.
· Design beginners: no prior experience needed—just jump in and explore.
· Mobile-first users: a complete design studio in your pocket.
Download Magnific today and start designing smarter, anytime, anywhere.

· Terms of Use: https://www.magnific.com/legal/terms-of-use
· Privacy Policy: https://www.magnific.com/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00023034:ios.description:
War and Magic – A free SLG wargame combining real-time and turn-based tactical gameplays. 
The choice of more than 10 million players all over the world. The fantasy tactical multiplayer online role-playing simulation strategy wargame has creatively inserted chessboard gameplay into battles, making it possible to fulfill the needs of war and battle strategy mania, board game (chess) fans and SLG gamers. As the lord, you could manage the entire city and use military strategies to fight other lords. Also, you could fight in person to maximize your tactical wisdom in chessboard battle playing, marshalling heroes and troops to win every battle. Simple rules, easy to start yet capable of mobilizing your brain’s full tactical potential. That’s what makes this game the best time-killer ever!
Gameplay
*Battle*：
1. Know how strong your enemies are and pick suitable heroes.
 Your reputation and prestige will attract more heroes to serve you.
2. Equip your heroes with good troops!
Dozens of troops of different races are ready to fight. A perfect hero and troop match-up plus a suitable formation make 1+1>2.
3. Mind every step on the chessboard!
Wise choices could even turn the tides in your favor in an adverse battle.
*War*:
1. Manage your city well at first!
Collect resources, build functional buildings, research techs and train troops. They are all necessary.
2. Find like-minded allies!
It is hard to survive alone in the huge war with so many powers in play. To get the throne, you need a powerful alliance. You could work with players of different states or unite those of your state to show the world how powerful you are!
3. Find your role in the war!
The complex system makes it possible for you to be any role in this war. A powerful warlord, an outstanding strategist, a resource collector or dealer, or the spy that dances among varies alliances to maximize your interest. It’s totally up to you to decide who you want to be!
4. Take the Dragon City to prove your strength!
The throne of Tyroria belongs to the strongest. Dare you accept the challenge?
*Others*：
1. There are always new heroes and units to satisfy your need of collection.
2. Brilliant events and festival celebrations make the game never boring.
3. All Players in One Server. The real-time translation system allows you to communicate with people all over the world.

bluejetty:00184838:ios.name: Score Creator: compose music
bluejetty:00184838:ios.summary:
Score Creator is a music composition application that is specially designed for mobile platforms. It's a simple but powerful music creation tool that caters to your need to write music on the go.
*** The app's user experience is completely
bluejetty:00184838:ios.description:
Score Creator is a music composition application that is specially designed for mobile platforms. It's a simple but powerful music creation tool that caters to your need to write music on the go.
*** The app's user experience is completely optimized to make composing music on mobile devices easier and faster than ever. No more "tapping and zooming" the screen just to add a music note or a chord symbol. No more "dragging and dropping" from the palette just to add a sharp/flat sign. All you need to do to write a song is tap the keyboards (notes and chords) that are designed like a text keyboard. COMPOSING MUSIC IS NOW AS SIMPLE AS TEXTING YOUR FRIENDS!
*** Apart from being a songwriting app for songwriters, Score Creator also functions as a music teaching and learning tool for music teachers and students. Teachers can teach students how to read music notation by directly entering music notes into the app and playing back the song, while music students can practice by themselves by notating their favorite songs in the app and playing along with their own musical instruments.
*** The app is a perfect tool for writing different types of sheet music, including lead sheets, solo instrument scores, SATB choir scores, sheet music for brass & woodwind bands, and more.
*** FEATURES:
- Compose music scores. The app supports treble, alto, bass and neutral clefs, with a wide range of notes and music symbols: note lengths, time signatures, key signatures, slurs, ties, dynamics, articulations & ornaments, and more.
- Write lyrics.
- Write chord symbols.
- Multiple tracks with different instruments: piano, guitar, violin, saxophone, drums, flute, horn, tuba, ukulele, mandolin, and more.
- Scores for transposing instruments: saxophone (soprano, alto, tenor, baritone), Bb clarinet, Bb trumpet, and more.
- Playback sound for each instrument.
- Transpose songs into any key.
- Import songs from MIDI & MusicXML files.
- Change clef, time/key signature and tempo in the middle of a song.
- Export songs to MIDI or MusicXML files so that they can be imported into other apps such as Finale, Encore, MuseScore, and Sibelius. The files can be copied to your computer or sent via email.
- Send exported MIDI files to other apps on your current device.
- Import MIDI files from other apps.
- Export songs to PDF files.
- Export songs to audio files (.wav, .mp3).
- Editing features: multi-note selection, copy & paste, undo & redo, and more.
- SCAN SHEET MUSIC FROM PHOTOS.
- SCAN SHEET MUSIC FROM PDF FILES.
*** End User License Agreement: https://www.termsfeed.com/eula/c6cf438c81097acbfd5a7d51600b6bba
*** Privacy policy: The app does not collect or store any kind of personal information.

bluejetty:00153278:ios.description:
Hole Stars – Scoop, Solve, and Shine
Looking for a game that’s fun, fast, and totally satisfying? Meet Hole Stars — a relaxing puzzle game where you guide a growing black hole through colorful levels, collect everything in sight, and beat the clock in style.
From tiny objects to giant surprises, every level is packed with items to collect, puzzles to solve, and obstacles to outsmart. Whether you’re in it for the challenge or the relaxing vibes, Hole Stars is the perfect break-time pick-me-up.
Easy to Play, Hard to Put Down
Swipe to move your black hole and start collecting! As you gather more, your hole grows bigger, letting you scoop up larger items and clear the board even faster. Watch out for tricky objects and blockers that’ll keep you on your toes.
Think Fast, Move Smart
Each level is a puzzle with a twist: time is ticking! Use strategy, quick thinking, and helpful level boosters to collect everything before the clock runs out. Whether you're sorting, planning your path, or just going with the flow — every move matters.
Satisfying, Soothing Gameplay
Enjoy smooth animations, crisp visuals, and gentle ASMR-style sound effects as you play. Hole Stars is built to be relaxing and satisfying — perfect for short sessions or deep puzzle streaks.
Play, Compete, Repeat
Want to challenge yourself even more? Compete with friends, rise through the leaderboard, and show off your speed and puzzle skills. It’s easy to pick up and play — but there’s always a new challenge waiting.
What Makes Hole Stars Shine:
- Addictive black hole gameplay with a unique twist
- Dozens of clever puzzles and satisfying levels
- Swallow items, grow stronger, and clear the board
- Use smart boosters to tackle tough spots
- Avoid sneaky blockers and stay one step ahead
- Clean design and smooth, ASMR-inspired effects
- A relaxing mix of strategy, action, and fun
- Ideal for fans of sorting games and brain teasers
- Join the leaderboard and race to the top!
Whether you’re chasing high scores or just want a satisfying way to unwind, Hole Stars is your new favorite way to play.
The stars are waiting — download now and shine bright!

Privacy Notice: https://static.moonactive.net/legal/privacy.html?lang=en

bluejetty:00080292:ios.developer: Shanghai Diyu Network Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00080292:ios.summary:
Bellybook is the AI food journal for people who love to eat.
Snap a photo or just describe your meal. Your AI food assistant recognizes every dish, estimates calories and macros, tags the cuisine, and tells you where the dish comes from —
bluejetty:00080292:ios.description:
Bellybook is the AI food journal for people who love to eat.
Snap a photo or just describe your meal. Your AI food assistant recognizes every dish, estimates calories and macros, tags the cuisine, and tells you where the dish comes from — no forms, no barcode scanning, no guilt.
Your meals become a lifelong story of flavors: the places you ate, the cuisines you explored, and the dishes you keep coming back to.
HOW IT WORKS
• Snap or chat: take up to 6 photos of a meal, or type a sentence. The assistant does the rest.
• Fix anything by talking: "that's not hot pot, it's mala tang" — your record updates instantly.
• Smart reminders: say "remind me to eat lunch at 12 every day" and it's set.
YOUR FOOD PASSPORT
• Unlock cuisines from around the world, from Sichuan and Cantonese to Japanese, Italian and Mexican.
• Every dish comes with its origin and history.
• See where you've eaten on your personal food map.
INSIGHTS THAT FEEL GOOD
• A playful daily nutrition board with calories, protein, carbs and fat.
• Trends, meal timing and food diversity over weeks and months.
FOODIE COMMUNITY
• Climb the gourmet and cuisine-expert leaderboards.
• Invite friends and explore together.
AN APP THAT EVOLVES WITH YOU
Report a bug or suggest a feature right from the home screen. We aim to resolve every piece of feedback within 24 hours, and every fix is shown publicly in the Resolved tab.
BELLYBOOK PRO
• Analyze up to 5 meals a day (free: 2)
• Up to 6 photos per meal
• Unlock every cuisine and keep your full food history
• Complete nutrition reports and insights
Monthly, yearly and lifetime options are available.
Subscription terms: Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://bellybook.cn/article/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://bellybook.cn/article/user-agreement

bluejetty:00024626:ios.description:
Astonishing Eleven is the football/soccer management game you've been waiting for!
Become the manager of your own football team and lead your players to the ultimate reward: becoming the best coach and winning the Grande Cup!
Astonishing Eleven is not your usual sports simulation game. It's not only about stats and ratings. It's not just training youngsters, transferring players, exploring strategies and signing free agents, or building a dynasty. In Astonishing Eleven, you're writing your own GM life story with one goal in mind: win the Grande Cup. But the road to victory is not an easy one!
*Play offline, whenever you want, wherever you want, as much as you want! Play the game on the road, kick during your lunch break, or sign contracts between commercials. It's the ultimate football GM simulation!
*A living world
Astonishing Eleven features a simulated but living world. Fans are posting about the game and your brand new rookie. Players send you messages about their concerns or their contract. Or you might have to improvise what's for dinner when the team cook gets sick!
*You're the general manager! Step into the game. Adapt your strategy and coaching systems to kick more often, do aggressive tackles, or create more ball movement. All your choices as GM have consequences and will decide of the victory or loss. 
*Follow the scoreboard, the rankings, and the reactions from the fans, Astonishing Eleven reporters and players. You can also post your statistics online to compare your performances to other GMs in our daily and weekly leaderboards!
Train your players, from the youth team to All-Star, it's your job as manager to find the ones who have the potential to become legendary football stars and build a football dynasty with the best strategy. 
Enjoy the game!
Join our Discord server: https://as.discord.astonishing-sports.app

bluejetty:00015129:ios.name: Conversation Therapy
bluejetty:00015129:ios.summary: Work more effectively toward your speech therapy goals. Help people who have had a stroke, live with autism, or have a speech or language impairment get talking with an app that sparks conversation. The best way to improve talking is by tal
bluejetty:00015129:ios.description:
Work more effectively toward your speech therapy goals. Help people who have had a stroke, live with autism, or have a speech or language impairment get talking with an app that sparks conversation. The best way to improve talking is by talking!
- Get a tool that helps adults, teens, and children put therapy strategies into practice
- Improve language, social skills, speech, and thinking while using this powerful speech therapy app
- Carryover the lessons from speech therapy at home with an app that’s easy for everyone to use
- Focus on what matters – stop racking your brain for fresh topics and let the app guide you
- Take things in any direction with thousands of possible conversation starters
- Create the right experience for each person with customizable settings
- Talk one-on-one, host groups of up to 4 at a time, and track improvement with ease
** SEE HOW IT CAN HELP – download the Lite version for FREE! **
Coming up with fresh, attention-grabbing conversation starters every day is surprisingly hard, even for speech therapy professionals. Think of this app as your talk facilitator, taking the pressure and planning out of starting and maintaining dialogue while you monitor how your clients use their speech strategies.
"This is the app that is going to pave the way for converting speech therapists to the digital age."
- Ryan Knoblauch, SLP, The Speech Knob
GETTING STARTED IS AS EASY AS 1, 2, 3
Target higher-level expressive language, pragmatic, problem-solving, speech, and cognitive-communication goals with open-ended conversation starters. Here’s how it works.
1) CHOOSE YOUR CATEGORIES. Tailor your experience with specific topics like Food or Health, or select all topics for free-flowing discussion that could go anywhere! You can always change the settings to see only age-appropriate categories for children, teens, or adults.
2) START THE CONVERSATION. Look at the picture, then touch any of the 10 buttons to see a question. The questions on the left are simpler (like “What is…?”) while the ones on the right are more complex (“How do you know…?”). Hear the question aloud, record your own audio, and score answers as you go.
3) USE YOUR STRATEGIES. While taking turns discussing the answers to the questions, use your word-finding strategies, smooth speech techniques, or other personalized therapy approaches to communicate more clearly.
ALL DONE? E-mail an automatically generated summary of your results, along with any audio, or share the results to a PDF, file storage, printer, or copy/paste.
GET EVERY FEATURE YOU NEED IN ONE EASY APP
- 275+ vivid photos, with 10 questions per photo, for over 2,750 possible questions
- 10 languages: English, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Zulu
- 11 categories full of real-world topics including daily life, hobbies, current events, social issues, health concerns, and much more
- Record audio at any time with just a tap
- Perfect for treating language, cognitive-communication, pragmatic, and speech disorders
- Great as stimulus material to work on fluency, articulation, eye contact, and word-finding strategies in spontaneous speech
- No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
BETTER DISCUSSIONS MEAN BETTER PRACTICE. Inspire curiosity and creativity while motivating people to keep improving – DOWNLOAD IT NOW!
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find

The most beautiful and intuitive Budget & Expense app. Thank you for choosing Cookie.
Ad-free, no splash screens, and zero financial distractions. Beyond the bills, it’s the footprint of your life.

Cookie supports screenshot, voice, photo, and text entry. Our AI large models automatically identify information and generate entries, truly freeing your hands for a seamless tracking experience.

bluejetty:00145215:ios.description:
The greatest selection of verified cars in the UAE is available on the DubiCars app. 
With over 29,000 used cars and new cars for sale from over 500 trusted car dealerships and private sellers from all across the UAE, DubiCars is the one-stop shop for all your car buying and selling needs. 
√ Up to 20 HD photos of each car
√ 360 degrees tours
√ Detailed specs of all car features
√ Call, WhatsApp, or Email the dealer directly
√ Get notified when new cars are listed
√ Monitor the price of your favorite cars
√ Advanced search filter 
Find your perfect car through advanced search filters that allow you to filter out the listings based on the car prices, mileage, make, model, year of manufacture, color, specs, number of cylinders, gearbox type, etc.
DubiCars features thousands of 100% verified listings of new cars and used cars for sale across different segments. Whether you are looking for small hatchbacks, sedans, premium sedans, coupes, mid-size SUVs, large SUVs, or even a supercar, DubiCars surely has the right car for you.
The DubiCars app lists:
Cars For Sale In The UAE
Cars For Sale In Dubai
Cars For Sale In Abu Dhabi
Cars For Sale In Ajman
Cars For Sale In Sharjah
Cars For Sale In Umm Al-Quwain
Cars For Sale In Fujairah
Cars For Sale In Ras Al Khaimah
Some of the popular new and used car brands in the UAE are Toyota, Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Honda, Lexus, Hyundai, Ford, etc. Some of the most popular car models in the UAE are the Toyota Land Cruiser, Nissan Patrol, Toyota Prado, Mercedes-Benz G-Class, BMW 5-Series, Ford Mustang, etc. All of the aforementioned models and more cars for sale are listed on DubiCars.
Each car listing features HD photos and videos. With a detailed description of the car, it is easy for users to be well-informed and to shortlist a particular car. Buying a new or used car on DubiCars is a convenient process. The seller can be contacted through the DubiCars app via phone call, SMS, email, and even WhatsApp. 
A 240-point inspection can also be arranged with our trusted partners, and you can request it through a listing detail page. The inspection reports ensure that pre-owned cars are of good quality and help you make the most out of your deal with the seller. Most cars sold by dealerships even come with an option to finance the purchase. Buyers can also request a detailed car valuation or explore certified listings.
Selling a car on DubiCars is an easy process too. From a detailed specs table to a provision for a long and detailed description of the vehicle, the DubiCars app is the perfect place to list your car for sale in the UAE. With hundreds of thousands of visitors every month, your car sale listing is sure to find a buyer. In case the car needs to be sold in a hurry, DubiCars offers VIP Home, Premium, Featured classifieds that allow you to place your car higher up in the list.
The My Ads section of the DubiCars app allows users to manage their ad postings from one place. Within My Ads, you can view and edit ads, upgrade packages to reach more users, and track how each listing is performing in terms of stats and engagement.
Safety and security are prioritized by DubiCars. All transactions on DubiCars are done via a secure payment system and this ensures that users are protected from fraud.
The New Car section in the DubiCars app comes with powerful features that help you research new cars with ease. Delve into our rapidly growing database of new cars, search by brand or model and see available trims, specs and prices. 
On the whole, whether you want to purchase or sell a car, DubiCars has you covered through a single, easy-to-use, and convenient app.
DubiCars
Buy, Sell, Smile

bluejetty:00021606:ios.description:
## AI Thumbnail Maker for YouTube and Twitch
Create thumbnails for YouTube videos and Twitch stream covers.
This thumbnail maker gives you two ways to work: 
1. An AI thumbnail generator for faster drafts and variations, perfect to generate professional thumbnails in seconds or to create thumbnails variations for YouTube,
2. A standard thumbnail editor for manual design and full control over each layer.
### AI Thumbnail Generator
Use AI to create and edit thumbnails in different ways depending on what you need.
You can:
- start from a text prompt
- start from an existing thumbnail
- start from a photo or selfie
- import an image from your photo library or clipboard
- generate multiple thumbnail versions
- keep editing an AI thumbnail instead of starting over
This AI thumbnail flow is useful if you want to remake an older thumbnail, build around a face photo, or get ideas quickly before refining the final image.
### Thumbnail Editor
The standard thumbnail editor is made for manual editing without making things complicated.
Features include:
- saved projects and templates you can reuse for new videos
- background removal to turn photos into stickers
- a built-in stickers gallery
- 300+ fonts and text styles
- layers for simple image and text editing and composition 
- access to millions of photos from Unsplash
### iPad Thumbnail Editing
The app is fully supported on iPad.
### Privacy
Your editing projects are stored on your device.
If you use AI thumbnail generation or AI editing, your prompt and any images you choose are sent securely to our servers so the feature can work.

bluejetty:00016288:ios.summary:

If you or your budding palaeontologist love dinosaurs, this engaging app is packed with dino games, real facts, and interactive activities that make learning ex
bluejetty:00016288:ios.description:
Step back in time and explore the prehistoric world with Dino Fun – Dinosaurs!
If you or your budding palaeontologist love dinosaurs, this engaging app is packed with dino games, real facts, and interactive activities that make learning exciting and fun.
Designed by teachers in Canada with over 15 years of childcare experience, Dino Fun follows a learning-through-play approach that keeps children engaged while they discover fascinating facts about dinosaurs that once roamed our planet.
Whether you’re exploring a Dino Park, collecting fossils, or cracking open dino eggs, Dino Fun – Dinosaurs combines education and entertainment in a way kids love.
Dinosaur Bone Collecting Game
Help the palaeontologist collect bones across six exciting dinosaur worlds! Jump from platform to platform in fast-paced dino games set in fun themes like Jungle, Halloween, and Christmas. When enough bones are collected, they magically come together to form a dinosaur skeleton. Tap the completed skeleton to hear a fun fact about the dinosaur you helped build! This action-packed Dino Fun game builds coordination, problem-solving, and cognitive skills while keeping kids entertained.
Dinosaur Flashcards
Discover over 30 different dinosaurs with interactive flashcards featuring:
* Real-life images
* Correct pronunciation of dinosaur names
* Fossil visuals
* Over 120 interesting dinosaur facts
Each card includes easy-to-understand icons showing what the dinosaur ate, how big it was, when it lived, where its fossils were found, and one unique fun fact. These Dinosaur Games for Kids are perfect for curious minds who want to learn more about dinosaurs and dinosaurios in an engaging way.
BONUS GAME – Dinosaur Fossil Quiz
Test your knowledge after exploring the flashcards! Match fossils to the correct dinosaurs by choosing from four options. This quiz is a fun way to reinforce learning and makes Dino Fun even more interactive.
Dino Egg Tapping Game
All dinosaurs hatched from eggs, and now kids can experience the fun of cracking them open! Choose an egg and tap it a certain number of times to make it crack. When it opens, a lively dinosaur animation appears, delighting kids while helping build number recognition and fine motor skills.
Dinosaur Dancing
Tap the dinosaurs and make them dance to fun, upbeat music!
This playful activity is perfect for little fingers that love to tap, tap, tap, and adds another layer of joy to Dino Fun – Dinosaurs.
Why Kids Love Dino Fun
* Multiple dino games in one app
* Real dinosaur facts presented in a kid-friendly way
* Designed by educators
* Encourages curiosity, learning, and imagination
* Perfect for fans of Dino Park, dinosaurs, and dinosaurios
Travel back to prehistoric times and enjoy hours of learning and play with Dino Fun – Dinosaurs! Where Dino Fun, dinosaurs, and education come together for a roaring good time

Watch them learn all the names of numerous pet, farm, jungle, zoo and water animals through fun and play. A pleasant voice will always encourage and praise your kids and motivate them to continue to build their vocabulary, memory, and cognitive skills while playing. The game is enriched with animations, pronunciations, sounds and interactivity for repeat playing & learning. It will keep your kids busy and yet you will never be worried about them losing any piece of the puzzles!

* Placing the objects in a scene
* Jigsaw puzzle
* Memory game

Simple & intuitive child-friendly interface
30+ different languages and pronunciations - English, Arabic, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.
Hundreds of puzzle pieces in 100+ different puzzles
Easy navigation between puzzles
Easy movement of puzzle pieces across screen
High-quality graphics
Sweet background music
Drag & drop animations
Balloon animation & happy cheering after each correctly solved puzzle
The theme of this Puzzle is ‘Animals’, check our other apps for more themes like 'Food', 'Kitchen', 'Furniture', 'Cars' and 'Tools'

bluejetty:00157982:ios.description:
Swordsman's Journey: The Legend Begins
A new era dawns in the martial world, where heroes emerge amid clashing swords and shifting alliances.
In this ink-wash Wuxia world, you take the role of an unnamed young swordsman stepping into the chaos of the Jianghu. Will you settle every grudge with your blade, or wait for the perfect moment and overcome your enemies through strategy?
Your Jianghu legend begins here!
== Game Features ==
【Customize Your Martial Arts, Forge Your Own Style】
Hundreds of martial arts can be freely combined. Mix Sword Arts, Ultimate Skills, Internal Arts, and Agility techniques to create a build that matches your own strategy.
There is no single fixed path. Adapt your techniques, outthink your opponents, and forge your own martial way.
【Journey the Jianghu, Discover Endless Opportunities】
Explore an ink-wash world filled with encounters and opportunities.
Study secret manuals in Huanshi Pavilion, exchange martial arts insights with friends, and meet various heroes through unexpected Jianghu encounters.
Every choice may lead to a different opportunity and shape your journey in the martial world.
【Cultivate Internal Energy, Break Through Your Limits】
Regulate your breathing, cultivate your Meridians, and guide the flow of internal energy throughout your body.
As your cultivation progresses, unlock further improvements and continue breaking through your limits to reach higher martial realms.
【Peak Swordsmanship, Prove Your Strength】
Challenge the guardians of different realms at Sword Discussion Peak.
Victors can leave their mark at the summit and earn exclusive titles. Will you wait patiently for the perfect opportunity, or make your name known in a single decisive battle?
The Jianghu will remember your name.
== Step into the Jianghu, Become a Legend ==
Swordsman's Journey brings the world of Wuxia to life with distinctive ink-wash visuals.
Take up your sword, explore the Jianghu, master countless martial arts, and write your own legend.
== Gentle Reminders ==
※ This game is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases for virtual currency, items, and other content.
※ Please manage your playtime responsibly and enjoy the game in moderation.

bluejetty:00022684:ios.description:
Feel the power of music.
KaiserTone contains the "Amazing Quality Sound Engine AQS-XI”. This high-speed sound engine makes use of over 64000 frequency bands to deliver the very highest quality audio. Sound Engine AQS-XI provides an equalizer, virtual surround, cross fader, gapless playback, silence detection, noise reduction, and a dynamic limiter, to allow you to listen to your favorite music at your preferred sound quality.
KaiserTone plays music files stored on the iTunes library and in the high-resolution music database (HiRes DB).
Supports High-resolution sources:
1) playback of high-res sources up to 768kHz/32bits
2) PCM and DoP (DSD over PCM) playback of high-res DSD files up to 12MHz/1bit. 
Supported audio format:
- iPod Library(iTunes): audio format used by Music App of Apple
- Hires DB: DSD(2.8MHz~12MHz/1bit, .dsf, .dff), FLAC(8k~384kHz/8~32bit), WAV(8k~768kHz/8~64bit), Apple Lossless(8k~384kHz), AIFF(8k~768kHz/8~32bit), AAC(8~320 Kbps), MP3(8~320 Kbps), MP4(as Sound), M4V(as Sound)
* In iPod Library, Music app exclusive data (Apple Music, DRM, iCloud) can be cooperative played back with the restriction function by Music app.
Compatible models:
iPhone 6s or later, iPod touch 7, iPad Pro, Air2, Air
Playback Options:
- 6 modes of continuous playback (+ Medley)
- Music shuffle
- Spectrum analyzer (stereo split, bandwidth resolution, persistence, etc.)
- Speaker, headphones, Bluetooth, AirPlay, dock
- SNS posting (Twitter, facebook, ...)
- Sleep Timer from 10 min. up to 8 hr.
Sound Quality Effect:
- Presets equalizer: Normal, Perfect, Eargasm Explosion, Rock, Rap, Metal, Country, Jazz, Acoustic, Classic, Blues, Oldies, Reggae, Opera, Speech, Bass, Mid, Treble
- Graphic equalizer:(5 Band, 10 Band, 20 Band, 30 Band, Spline curve 16k, 32k)
 Range: -12dB ~ +12dB. (Minimum Step: 0.1, 0.5, 1.0dB)
 Six types of equalizers for your enjoyment:
 ○ Beginner: 5 Frequency bands: 100Hz-8KHz
 ○ Average: 10 bands: 32Hz-16KHz
 ○ Expert: 20 bands: 32Hz-22.62KHz
 ○ Master: 30 bands: 25Hz-6.3KHz
 ○ Spline Curve: Customizable frequency band range
　16k: 32Hz-16KHz, 32k: 16Hz-32KHz
- Virtual surround sound presets
- Digital Output (Max 768kHz/32bit)
- DoP output v1.0/v1.1
- "Prevent the head cutting" for DAC (0 to 3.0 sec.)
- Up-sampling with integral multiples settings
Volume control:
- Fine volume
- Left/Right balance
- Gain adjustments
- stereo/monaural
Music Selection
- Playback music from the iTunes Library and the HiRes DB
- by artists, albums, songs, genres, playlists(Create/Delete), Compilations, Composers, SampleRates, Formats
- "Shuffle" play can be selected from the song list
- "All songs" has the top of the artist/album
- Songs can be searched from the artist, album, song lists
- “Album artist” settings
- Grid View (on iPhone5/more)
- Mini Player
- Add to queue
Settings
- Customize the design with 24 different colors
- Silence detection (Automatically skip silences lasting 3 or more consecutive sec.)
- Automatic dynamic limiter, noise reduction
- Spectrum analyzer (stereo, bandwidth, color...)
- Crossfade (0 to 20 sec.)
- Pause Fadeout (0 to 1.0 sec.)
- Album art view swipe action settings
- Player orientation settings
- Edit the music selection tags
Other
- 7 Virtual surround sound presets (live Reverb)
- Control playback with headphone buttons and Bluetooth
- Output with speakers, headphones, Bluetooth, AirPlay, docks
- Album art display
- Gapless playback
- Auto pause on unplugging headphones / receiving a phone call
- Background playback
- Display lyrics when included in the song file
- importation to the HirRes DB by iTunes and AirDrop, by Files app
Notes :
* In Hires DB, it cannot play a track with compression dff file / DRM protected file.
* Only Playlist created in this app can be deleted
* The download button of purchased sound source from mora is displayed only for "language:Japanese or region:Japan". mora's service is only available in Japan

bluejetty:00071187:ios.description:
You can check the battery status of your phone and watch with your watch.
Compatible with complications (automatic update).
You can check the charging amount and charging status of the phone in a timely manner from the clock face.
We will notify you by a notification when the charge amount of the phone or watch becomes less than the specified% or becomes full charge.
The graph also displays the change in charge level for your phone and watch.
- Set up complications with the watch app on your watch or phone.
- The battery status displayed in the complication is automatically updated approximately every 12 to 60 minutes.
　The reason why the update interval has a range is that it depends on Watch OS.
　If the automatic update has stopped (for example, there is no update for more than 1.5 hour), tap the complication to restart it.
　In the iPhone app, the latest update time is displayed under the watch's charge status display.
- Tap the complication to update to the latest status.
- A circular complication can be assigned to the outer circle and the inner number to indicate the battery level of the phone and watch, respectively.

The support site can be translated into various languages with the "Translate" option on the right side of the site.

Build a pelvic floor routine that includes both strengthening and relaxation. Happy Floor combines audio-guided exercises and video tutorials to help you practise at your own pace.
NEW IN 2.0

● Daily audio-guided strengthening and control exercises
● Guided release sessions to help you practise relaxing your pelvic floor
● A step-by-step Progression Plan
● An activity calendar and streaks to help you build a routine
● Reminders to help you stay consistent
● A library of guided exercises and video tutorials
● English and Spanish language and voice options

Complete functionality of the app is only available with a subscription. We offer a free trial so you can try these features before paying. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

You can manage or cancel your subscription from the Account screen or your iTunes Account Settings. Cancel at least 24 hours before your free trial ends to avoid being charged. If you cancel during a paid subscription period, your access continues until the end of that period.

bluejetty:00179018:ios.description:
The Crestron Home™ app makes it easy to access and control every aspect of your Crestron smart home with the tap of a button on your iPhone® or iPad®, or with the sound of your voice. Lighting, climate, audio, video, shades, security, and more are at your command, from wherever you happen to be. Experience rooms that awaken with a single touch and environments that adjust to your every mood. Enjoy the peace of mind that comes with knowing your home is safe and sound, whether you’re home or away. Crestron Home elevates your living experience, transforming your everyday commands into instantaneous delight. 
Designed for you
Personalize your experience for every room and space in your home. Create scenes to activate multiple smart home features with one tap. Easily personalize your room images and screen savers. 
Seamless, simple control 
Easily manage one or multiple homes, remotely or on the premises. 
Responsive and intuitive 
Access all your home’s information via smooth animations and easy-to-navigate, responsive icons. Organize your favorites, navigate your rooms, and personalize each destination with your image of choice.
Easy accessibility 
Instantly activate any level of control you require. 
Dynamic performance 
Commands are displayed dynamically, from home screen actions to climate control. Set your preferred temperature and see the transition occur right before your eyes. 
Connected entertainment 
Enjoy what matters, including a rich multimedia experience that features your preferred entertainment services, all easy to access and control. 
NOTE: Use of the Crestron Home app requires a Crestron smart home system that has been installed and licensed by a Crestron Authorized Dealer. Visit our Dealer Locator page to find one near you:

- Crush your enemies and take their land to expand your territory.

Get real-time CTA bus and train updates, Metra schedules, and Pace connections — all in one simple app built for Chicago commuters.

• Live CTA bus and ‘L’ train tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts

Whether you’re commuting downtown, heading to Wrigley, or connecting to the suburbs, Chicago Transit keeps you moving with confidence.
Coverage Includes:
• CTA Buses and ‘L’ Trains (All Lines)
• Metra Commuter Rail
• Pace Suburban Buses
• South Shore Line connections
• O’Hare and Midway Airport access
• Real-time alerts, detours, and service updates
Plan your journey, check live arrivals, and save your favourite stops — all in one app designed for the greater Chicago area.

Chicago Transit is a real-time public transport app for the Chicago area. It provides live CTA bus and train tracking, Metra schedules, and Pace connections.
Does it work with the CTA?
Yes — Chicago Transit supports all CTA buses and trains with live arrival times, maps, and alerts.
Can I track Metra trains?
Absolutely. The app includes live Metra schedules, service alerts, and real-time updates where available.
Does it include Pace suburban buses?
Yes. You can plan and track trips across Pace routes connecting the suburbs to the city.
Does Chicago Transit show service alerts and delays?
Yes — you’ll get live notifications about delays, detours, and planned maintenance for all major systems.
Can I use Chicago Transit offline?
Yes — offline maps and saved timetables make it easy to travel without mobile data.

bluejetty:00096318:ios.description:

Turn your Mac into a powerful printer companion. Print photos, documents, and more directly from your Mac with the Smart Printer App. Supports AirPrint for fast, secure, and high-quality printing.
Smart Printer App makes printing effortless. Print your documents, photos, and web pages in just a few clicks. You can also generate creative images with the built-in AI Image Generator, challenge yourself with fun AI Quizzes, and design custom Labels. Print photos instantly and share them with family and friends.
Key Features:
AI Image Generator: 
Create stunning, high-quality images with just a prompt. Perfect for posters, presentations, and personalized printables. Unleash your creativity with endless design possibilities powered by AI.
AI Quiz: 
Challenge your mind with fun, interactive quizzes powered by AI. Learn, test, and stay entertained right inside the app. Stay sharp and make learning enjoyable every day.
Documents scanner:
Print, scan, and manage all your documents with ease. Supports PDF, Word, and multiple file formats. Work smarter with reliable document tools built for productivity.
Print Photos: 
Bring your memories to life with vibrant, high-resolution photo printing. Share and preserve moments with professional-quality prints. Turn every snapshot into a masterpiece worth keeping.
Labels: 
Design and print custom labels instantly. Ideal for organizing, mailing, or creating personalized tags. Save time and add a professional touch to everything you label.
OCR Scanner:
Turn printed text into editable digital content in seconds. Perfect for digitizing receipts, notes, and paperwork. Boost efficiency by converting physical documents into smart digital files.
Web Search: 
Search the web directly within the app and print information instantly without switching apps. Stay productive by accessing knowledge and resources in one place.
Easy Setup and Connection
Getting started is simple with Smart Printer App. Just connect your printer to the same Wi-Fi network as your Mac, and the app will automatically detect and configure it for instant printing — no complicated setup required.
Why Choose Smart Printer App?
Smart Printer App is designed to meet all your printing needs with precision and ease. With powerful features and an intuitive design, it’s the perfect solution for anyone looking to simplify and enhance their printing experience. Whether you’re printing everyday photos, important documents, or tackling more complex tasks, Smart Printer App delivers the flexibility, reliability, and control you can count on.
Smart Printer App follows a freemium model. Users can use the app for 3 free attempts. After that, they may activate a 3-day free trial or purchase a premium subscription. During the 3-day free trial, users can use the app without any restrictions. After the free trial ends, the subscription will be automatically charged unless canceled.
Users may choose from weekly, monthly, or annual subscription plans to gain full access for the duration of their subscription, app also offers lifetime plan where user can pay once and get lifetime access to the app as below price.

Blood Pressure Tracker: Your Personal Health Companion
Blood Pressure Tracker is a professional health monitoring and recording application designed to help you easily track, manage, and understand your blood pressure readings. Achieve your health goals with comprehensive daily tracking and accurate determination of your blood pressure zone.
● Main Features:
- **Smart Blood Pressure Recording:** Effortlessly record daily systolic and diastolic blood pressure readings. Manual input and automatic synchronization from your blood pressure monitor ensure your records are always up-to-date and accurate.
- **Charts and Trend Analysis:** Visualize your blood pressure data through intuitive charts and trend analyses, helping you better understand fluctuations and take timely action for your health.
- **Health Information on Blood Pressure:** Access valuable articles extracted from the official WHO website to enhance your knowledge about blood pressure, prevention strategies, and healthy living habits.
- **Simple and Exquisite UI Design:** Enjoy a user-friendly interface that makes health management easy and accessible.
● Subscription Service:
Unlock the full potential of our app with a subscription! Choose from weekly, monthly, or yearly plans to enjoy an ad-free experience and easily export your blood pressure records in PDF format.
- **Subscription Details:**

 - Monthly Subscription: $7.99 per month
 - Yearly Subscription: $19.99 per year
Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
