The content in the app is not affiliated with Apple and is intended for reference only.
We wish you a healthy body and a happy mood! Thank you for supporting us, and we look forward to providing you with continuous improvements!

bluejetty:00170840:ios.name: Multitracker
bluejetty:00170840:ios.summary:
Multitracker is a live player that allows you to play multiple audio files and midi files comfortably and flexibly with the help of playlists. 
If a USB audio interface is connected to the iPad, the audio tracks (stems) of a song can be ro
bluejetty:00170840:ios.description:
Multitracker is a live player that allows you to play multiple audio files and midi files comfortably and flexibly with the help of playlists. 
If a USB audio interface is connected to the iPad, the audio tracks (stems) of a song can be routed to any of the outputs of the interface. At the same time, the headphone output can also be used as an additional routing destination, so that you have two additional channels available.
To play midi songs, Multitracker provides a midi player that allows each MIDI track to be assigned to any existing Midi device (whether via USB or iPad instrument such as Sound Canvas).
Of course a midi song can be played in sync with audio tracks.
If necessary, a metronome with 9 different click sounds and freely selectable time signature can be added to your song or be played alone.
It has never been easier to play multitrack and midi songs on stage!
Features:
- supports any class compliant audio interface
- Headphone output selectable as additional routing destination (2 additional channels)
Audio Player:
- unlimited number of audio tracks (stems) depending on the performance of your iPad
- Supports wav, mp3, flac, aac, ac3 (also mixed in one song)
- Each audio track (Stem) can be routed to any output
- Audio tracks can also be routed to outputs that are not currently connected
- equalizer per track
- compressor per track
- Volume fader per track
- Solo and mute buttons per track
- Copy / Paste function for routing and volume for faster configuration
- List of all audio routings
- Output channel busses with faders and listing of all assigned stems
Midi Player:
- Supports MIDI Format 0 and 1
- Each MIDI track can be assigned any MIDI locations (external / internal) - at the same time
- Transpose for each track separately or for the entire song
- Midi Clock Send in sync with the Midi Song (without Song Position Pointer)
- Switchable automatic metronome
- changeable Tempo
- Program change commands adjustable for each channel and midi device
- Prgogram Changes can be sent when the song is started or loaded
- You can also save songs that contain only Program Change messages but no Midi Song
- sends MIDI Time Code (MTC Master)
- sends MIDI Machine Code (MMC)
Metronome:
- can be played with or without Midi Song
- Choice of 9 different click sounds
- Time signature can be set arbitrarily
- Adjustable Click Duration
- Midi Clock synchronous to the metronome
Playlist:
- Playlist is easy to create with pre-configured songs
- Pause between songs on / off switchable
- Quicksave-option
- Display of faders configurable
- Size of faders configurable
- Playlists can be saved
- Playlists can be adjusted while playing
- FastForward / Rewind
- Pause 
- Start / Stop / Pause / Skip / VolumeFader controllable via Midi (Midi Learn)
- Songs selectable by MIDI Program Change commands
Live View:
- extra large song title (as well as next titles)
- extra large transport buttons
- Playlist View can be faded in
- Pause / Start Next Buttons can be faded in
 Fast Forward / Rewind
general:
- works in background
- import / export all song settings and playlists for backups and migration
- import / export audio data from / to cloud services (iCloud, Dropbox etc. )
- share audio files between apps
- 3 free demo songs to download 
- Multitracker is permanently extended and improved!
System Requirements:
 - iPad with iOS 9 or later
Optional: 
- USB-Audio Interface (Class Compliant)
- Lightning to USB-Cable or Camera Connection Kit (if you want to provide your iPad with power when connected to USB Interface)

bluejetty:00066459:ios.summary: Improve your pelvic floor muscle control, strength, and overall body performance with Kegel Men — the leading men’s health app designed to enhance pelvic floor function, blood circulation, and vitality through a personalized Kegel Exercise
bluejetty:00066459:ios.description:
Improve your pelvic floor muscle control, strength, and overall body performance with Kegel Men — the leading men’s health app designed to enhance pelvic floor function, blood circulation, and vitality through a personalized Kegel Exercise Plan.
Spend just 5–10 minutes daily with Kegel Men to activate your pelvic floor muscles, improve endurance, and boost circulation — helping you achieve better performance, stability, and confidence in your body and daily life. No matter your age, Kegel exercises are highly effective for improving pelvic floor muscle strength, bladder control, and overall men’s health.
Kegel Men creates a personalized plan designed by physiotherapists and doctors, ensuring each session matches your level and goals.
Enhance your pelvic floor control with guided fitness exercises that support circulation and body coordination, and practice breathing exercises to improve focus, relaxation, and control.
Kegel Men helps men improve their pelvic strength, blood flow, and confidence through the scientifically proven method of Dr. Arnold Kegel.
This method focuses on strengthening the pelvic floor muscles (PT muscles) — essential for posture, bladder health, and core stability.
Weak pelvic floor muscles can lead to reduced control or discomfort, but just like any other muscle group, they can be strengthened through regular Kegel training.
+ Get Your Personalized Kegel Plan
Create a training plan tailored to your needs and lifestyle.
 Take a short quiz in the app to define your goals, and your plan will adapt daily as you progress.
+ Fitness Routines for Every Level
Complement your pelvic floor training with functional exercises that enhance blood circulation, body coordination, and mobility.
 These exercises help you build strength, endurance, and flexibility, improving your overall physical performance.
+ Master Your Breath
Integrate guided breathing exercises to improve focus, relaxation, and pelvic floor control.
 Develop a deeper connection between your body and mind to support both physical and emotional balance.
+ Doctor-Recommended Training
Healthcare professionals recommend pelvic floor muscle exercises to support men’s health and muscular control.
 Perform at least two Kegel sessions daily, with optional breathing and fitness exercises for a complete wellness approach.
+ Join the Kegel Men Community
Connect with thousands of men who share their progress, exchange experiences, and stay motivated.
 Ask questions, learn from others, and grow with a supportive community focused on men's well-being.
+ Healthy Habit Challenges
Develop habits that support your health and performance with challenges like No Smoking, Better Sleep, and Mindful Focus.
 Each challenge helps you boost energy, circulation, and overall vitality.
+ Informative Articles
Gain expert insights on pelvic health, men’s pelvic health, blood circulation, and daily body maintenance through physiotherapist-written articles and guides.
Unlock your full potential and strengthen your pelvic floor from within.
Download Kegel Men now to improve control, confidence, and overall physical performance.
Disclaimer: All content in this application is for informational purposes only. Please consult your doctor before starting any exercise program.
Privacy Policy: https://api.kegelman.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://api.kegelman.app/terms-of-use
Support: info@kegelman.app

bluejetty:00069691:ios.description:
Some notes deserve a private space of their own.
Safety Note+ Pro is the separately purchased Pro edition for personal notes, journals, sensitive lists and confidential ideas. Keep private writing apart from everyday notes, then unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode.
A DEDICATED PRO EDITION
Choose Safety Note+ Pro when you prefer a separate paid app for private notes. Optional iCloud Sync and Cloud Backup remain separate services and may require an in-app purchase or subscription.
FLEXIBLE PRIVATE ACCESS
• Protect the app with a passcode
• Use Face ID or Touch ID on supported Apple devices
• Choose PIN, password or pattern-style access where available
• Return quickly to private writing without mixing it with ordinary notes
DECOY AND INTRUDER FEATURES
• Set a decoy password that opens alternate content
• Review supported intruder reports after failed access attempts
• Enable only the privacy features that suit your needs
FOLDER-LEVEL PROTECTION
• Add separate protection to selected folders
• Use folder colors and icons
• Organize personal, journal, work and other sensitive notes
WRITE AND ORGANIZE
• Create short notes, long-form writing and private lists
• Search, sort, move and copy notes
• Auto-save helps preserve changes as you write
• Choose from available themes
• Use one universal app on iPhone and iPad
OPTIONAL SYNC AND BACKUP
• Keep notes on your device for a local workflow
• Enable iCloud Sync on supported Apple devices
• Choose optional Cloud Backup where available
• Confirm that backup has completed before changing devices or deleting the app
IMPORTANT DATA SAFETY
Deleting the app may remove notes stored only on the device. Before deleting, reinstalling, replacing or erasing a device, confirm where your notes are stored and that any enabled backup has completed successfully.
Face ID and Touch ID are handled by Apple. Safety Note+ Pro does not receive or store your biometric face or fingerprint data.

- On Sundays at noon, your weekly photo dump is released, and you can view all the Drips posted by your friends that week.

bluejetty:00161130:ios.summary: Smart Accountant application is an application based on the hardware iPhone devices and is based on accounting and features to enable it to meet the needs of different users as needed and the possibility of adapting flexibly and in an easy
bluejetty:00161130:ios.description:
Smart Accountant application is an application based on the hardware iPhone devices and is based on accounting and features to enable it to meet the needs of different users as needed and the possibility of adapting flexibly and in an easy way that allows even people who have no accounting background or experience in dealing with accounting systems from dealing And benefit from it namely:
• Exemption / suspension of the Fund: The application is characterized by the possibility of choosing to stop the Fund or the option of activating the Fund and to carry out all movements on it and adhere to its balance and move between them easily and at any time.
• Classification of accounts: through which the distribution of customer accounts to categories categories for easy inventory and extraction of reports and balances, such as: (customers, suppliers, friends, relatives, employees, ... etc) with ease of modification.
• Classification of movements: The movements are divided into categories so that the user can know the type of item or classification that consumes his expenses or expenses more whether debt or personal expenses, family or study or business transactions or other and the extraction of reports.
• Add different currencies and ease of exchange between them and the extraction of reports.
• Easy, simple to use and fast performance.
• Auto Backup to Google Drive.
• The possibility of closing accounts during a certain period.
• Connect several devices to each other and define them as a master device and slave devices and work at the same time from any of these devices.
• Add an unlimited number of slave devices to the main device list.
• Export/Import data from one device to another using Google Drive account to transfer the database between devices smoothly.
Purpose of application:
1. Manage personal and family expenses and expenses.
2. Account management and personal debt.
3. Business transaction management.
Targeted:
1. Treasurers.
2. Expatriate Agents.
3. Representatives of companies and distributors.
4. Contractors and business entrepreneurs.
5. Professionals and shops.
6. All individuals of different levels and jobs.
Accounting operations available in the application:
1. Conversion between accounts.
2. Discount and deposit.
3. Inquire about balances.
4. Various reports.
5. Share Balance - Movement - Statement of Account.
The New :
1.Import from Excel for transactions and statements of accounts for each independent customer or for multiple customers combined in one Excel sheet in an accurate and easy way for users.
2.Export to Excel for all statements and reports available in the app with the ability to name the file before saving.
3.Adding an entry number for each file imported from Excel to facilitate the return of all transactions and details later using their entry number for review, also specifying a classification for the imported transactions.
4.Share transactions as a payment or receipt voucher in PDF format smoothly and with high flexibility.
5.Adding a new screen to modify or add any text or note on the payment voucher or receipt voucher before printing according to the user's desire.
6.Adding regions to distribute clients and accounts on them.
7.Adding a text or a note at the end of the account statements and reports with the possibility of modification as desired by the user at any time.
8.Adding the last payment date for each customer in the total reports to make it easier for the user to follow up on bad and overdue debts without having to enter each customer's account statement separately.
9.Printing a historical account statement from customer's page directly.
10.Ability to request activation of the application before the trial period ends.
11.Show/Hide the balances on the Accounts List screen.

Achieve Your Goals Easily: Worfit is designed to maximize your results in a short time!
Don't miss this opportunity! Worfit is all you need to get in shape quickly, and best of all, AT HOME. Install now and be amazed by the results!

bluejetty:00017388:ios.summary: Fancy watching a movie? Download the new VOX Cinemas app to book ahead of time and beat that ticket queue! We've made browsing and booking movies easier than ever —right from your iPhone or iPad. Check movie showtimes, book tickets, and dis
bluejetty:00017388:ios.description:
Fancy watching a movie? Download the new VOX Cinemas app to book ahead of time and beat that ticket queue! We've made browsing and booking movies easier than ever —right from your iPhone or iPad. Check movie showtimes, book tickets, and discover more about the latest movies showing at our locations across UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt and Lebanon.
Whether you're shopping at the mall or planning a movie night, check which movies are on and avoid the ticket queues by booking on our app.
Your VOX Cinemas app lets you…
• Save your favourite cinemas and book movies
• Skip the ticket queue – just scan your e-ticket at the cinema
• Save your e-ticket using Apple Wallet
• Purchase tickets using Apple Pay
• Pre-order your food & drinks before you arrive at the cinema
• Discover movie information with trailers, cast credits, synopsis & more
• Search for your favourite cinema locations or VOX Experience
• Available for download on Apple App Store for IOS Mobile Devices
For the movie-goer who knows what they want...
The hassle-free way to browse and book your favourite film genres from your iPhone or iPad. It’s a quicker way to find out what’s on at your nearest VOX Cinemas. Know what you're in the mood to watch for? Use the VOX Cinemas app to find out in seconds where and when you can watch the movie genre that'll make your day.
Feel like scaring yourself with a horror movie? Craving for the adrenaline rush of an action or thriller movie? Or perhaps you want to end a stressful day with a light-hearted comedy? The VOX Cinemas app makes movie ticket booking simple.
We’ll help you find the best of current movie releases including:
• Hindi movies
• Tamil movies
• English movies
• Arabic movies and many more
With a quick search, you can conveniently find and book. 
Discover our signature VOX Cinemas experiences with our ‘Ways to Watch’, including:
• MAX - Find your favourite films on the MAX mega-screens. Why not use the VOX Cinemas app to grab a spacious premium view seat?
• IMAX - Book tickets for these massive, state-of-the-art movie theatres where the curved screens offer an immersive movie experience.
• THEATRE & GOLD Experiences - Offering the most luxurious and lavish cinema experience in the region, indulge in fine dining while watching your favourite movies on the big screen.
• 3D and 4DX - Perfect for those who want to live the movie and not just watch it, find and book a 3D film or an exhilarating 4DX movie. 
• KIDS – Family day at the movies? Keep the little ones entertained with an animation or family movie at our kid-friendly big screens.
Pick and book the latest movies at the most exciting cinemas across the Middle East. Check out the latest Dubai cinema offerings at the popular Samsung Onyx, or grab a ticket to a traditional Arabic movie at our Zeman Awwal cinema. Looking for an easy way to find new movies at Doha cinemas, or planning your next Abu Dhabi cinema trip? Wherever you are, let the VOX Cinemas app make movie booking an effortless experience.
With the VOX Cinemas app, you can elevate your entire Middle East movie experience to the next level. Find the movies you love, when you want them, where you want them, with minimum effort and maximum enjoyment.
By downloading this App, you agree to the VOX Cinemas Privacy Policy (http://uae.voxcinemas.com/privacy)

The Rock Hill Herald local newspaper app is faster and easier to use. Read or watch daily local news coverage, investigative reporting, national headline news, crime, sports, local business, and more from Rock Hill, Fort Mill, Lancaster, Chester, and communities throughout York County in South Carolina.
The Rock Hill Herald local newspaper is your trusted source for local, daily journalism serving York County residents. Our newsroom delivers reporting on local government, public safety, education, courts, business, and community issues shaping daily life in Rock Hill and surrounding York County communities, alongside statewide coverage and national headline news.
LOCAL NEWS
• Daily local news and stories from Rock Hill, Fort Mill, Lancaster, Chester, and York County
• AI generated summaries on all articles reviewed by our newsroom
• The Rock Hill Herald local newspaper opinions, editorials and columns
• Edition, a digital destination delivering a complete daily report of local, statewide, national, and world news curated overnight by our editors
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video of local news stories and major national news coverage
• View photos and videos from local reporting and community events across York County
LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds
• Search for news articles, videos, games and more
• Bookmark news articles to read later
• Read articles your way with full support for dark mode and light mode
Other Features
• Browse articles by category
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email
• Comment on news articles
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper
• Recharge and unwind with puzzles and games
GET DAILY NEWS AND MORE WITH THE ROCK HILL HERALD LOCAL NEWSPAPER APP
The Rock Hill Herald local newspaper covers York County and South Carolina with in depth local journalism. Stay connected to local daily news, crime, sports, and national headlines wherever you go.

bluejetty:00178274:ios.name: Duct Calculator Elite
bluejetty:00178274:ios.summary: Duct Calculator Elite™ replaces your ductulator wheel with fast, precise duct sizing built on the friction-loss equations of the ASHRAE Handbook — Fundamentals. Trusted by HVAC professionals, mechanical engineers, and contractors since 2013
bluejetty:00178274:ios.description:
Duct Calculator Elite™ replaces your ductulator wheel with fast, precise duct sizing built on the friction-loss equations of the ASHRAE Handbook — Fundamentals. Trusted by HVAC professionals, mechanical engineers, and contractors since 2013. One price — no subscriptions, no ads, no accounts.
THREE CALCULATORS, ONE TAP APART
• DUCT SIZE BY AIRFLOW — Set airflow and either velocity or friction, and solve for round and rectangular duct dimensions. Specify the rectangular aspect ratio to match your available space. The nearest standard round and rectangular sizes are shown with the friction they actually run at.
• DUCT SIZE BY DIMENSION — Enter a round diameter or rectangular height and width, then lock airflow, velocity, or friction and solve for the remaining variables.
• PRESSURE DROP — Convert between duct length, pressure drop, and friction. Find the exact pressure drop of a given installation, or the maximum duct length that maintains your design pressure drop.
DESIGN TOOLS
• FRICTION RATE — Enter your available static pressure and duct run, add fittings from a built-in list of typical equivalent lengths (elbows, tees, wyes, supply boots), and get your total effective length and target friction rate — the Manual D style residential design workflow. Then send the result straight into Duct Size by Airflow with one tap.
• AIRFLOW FROM HEAT LOAD — Enter a sensible heat load and temperature difference to get the required airflow, corrected for air density.
ENGINEERING-GRADE MATH
Solves the Colebrook friction-factor equation directly for each duct material's surface roughness — the same method behind the ASHRAE friction chart — rather than interpolating from lookup tables. Roughness values come from Table 1 of the 2025 ASHRAE Handbook — Fundamentals, and the app shows you the one it used. Rectangular results use the Huebscher equivalent-diameter equation; air density is corrected for your temperature and elevation, and air viscosity for your temperature, so results hold up at altitude and outside room temperature. Below the turbulent range where the published methods agree, results are flagged as approximate.
PRECISE ENTRY, BUILT FOR THE FIELD
Type exact values directly in place — no cumbersome sliders, no pop-up entry screens. Confirm with a tap and every dependent value recalculates instantly. A clean layout keeps every result in view as you work, and everything runs fully offline.
CONFIGURED FOR REAL JOB CONDITIONS
• Duct dimensions: inches, centimeters, or millimeters
• Airflow: CFM, cubic feet per second, cubic meters per second, cubic meters per hour, or liters per second
• Velocity: feet per second, feet per minute, or meters per second
• Pressure loss: inches of water per 100 ft or pascals per meter
• Duct materials: galvanized steel, spiral steel, galvanized spiral (corrugated), aluminum, uncoated carbon steel, PVC plastic pipe, concrete, phenolic duct (pre-insulated), flexible duct (metallic), flexible duct (helix core, insulated), fibrous glass liner (spray coated), and fibrous glass liner (faced, smooth)
• Air temperature (°F, °C, K) and elevation (feet or meters) corrections
The next time you head to a meeting or out to the job site, leave the ductulator at home — everything you need is on your iPhone or iPad.
Questions or ideas for the next version? Email techsupport@cyberprodigy.com — we read every message.

First released in 2009, GoodReader® is truly a veteran of the A
bluejetty:00119171:ios.description:
GoodReader® Pro and our famous classic GoodReader app are essentially the same app, but this one comes with Pro Pack® pre-activated, no subscription or in-app purchase needed.
First released in 2009, GoodReader® is truly a veteran of the App Store.
In the modern app business, it's not easy to stay relevant that long. We're proud to say that after 17 years and counting, we've been delivering wonderful updates with extraordinary new features. And we're going to keep doing that!
GoodReader is a perfect combination of document-reading and file-managing capabilities. It's your one-stop shop for all your document needs on your iOS device.
Use the app once, and you'll be hooked. Soon you'll be wondering how you ever managed to work without it.
-= File Reading =-
PDF, TXT, MS Office, iWork, HTML, pictures, music & audio-books, videos. This is what you can view in GoodReader, plus you can also annotate PDF files and edit TXT files.
-= PDF Reading and Annotating =-
PDF files is where GoodReader truly shines. Reading experience is so superior, it's hard to describe. To rephrase one of our customers' review, "try it, and you'll see." While you're at it, give our PDF Reflow feature a try. You'll be surprised how much better PDF reading goes when you don't have to scroll left/right all the time, for every single line of text.
Annotating PDFs is another star feature of our app. Adding notes and drawings, highlighting text, and then sharing your annotated files or annotation summaries will be your main productivity and collaboration asset.
-= File Management =-
While reading files is a big part of GoodReader, it's not all it can do. It can also serve as a central hub for all your files, even those that can't be opened by GoodReader itself. It's like bringing your personal computer experience to your mobile device — easily managing huge collections of files and folders will make you forget you don't have your laptop around.
-= Connecting =-
Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Box.com, WebDAV, SMB, FTP, SFTP — these are all accessible from inside GoodReader. Download, upload, and sync individual files or huge folder collections.
-= Security =-
With GoodReader, your data security steps up to the level previously only dreamt of. With Pro Pack®, our new set of professional-level super-features, you'll get AES-256, a military-grade encryption, for all your data, at a price of a cup of coffee! And it's completely independent from the built-in Apple's Data Protection, so even if a hacker steals and unlocks your device, your data will still be protected by another strong layer of security, our own.
-= Multi-Windows =-
Seamlessly view and manage multiple files simultaneously on iPad.
-= Notes =-
Capture ideas and comments while reading or studying a technical document without even leaving the app. Sort and group your notes into categories.

bluejetty:00136425:ios.description:
iPrint: Smart Printer App - Your Ultimate Printing Solution (Hp, Brother, Epson, Canon, Konica, Lexmark, Kyocera, Oki, Samsung and more.)
Print, scan, and optimize your mobile printing experience with iPrint, the all-in-one Smart Printer App. Elevate your productivity with powerful features, including ePrint, AirPrint compatibility, an integrated scanner, OCR (Optical Character Recognition), and seamless cloud integration with iCloud and Google Drive.
Effortless Printing with ePrint:
Print directly from your iOS device to any compatible printer on your Wi-Fi network. ePrint makes printing a breeze – no need for a computer or complex configurations.
AirPrint Integration:
iPrint: Smart Printer App seamlessly integrates with Apple's AirPrint technology, allowing you to wirelessly print photos, documents, and more to AirPrint-enabled printers.
Scanner and OCR:
Transform your iOS device into a powerful scanner. Scan physical documents, receipts, or notes, and let our OCR technology convert them into editable text. It's the perfect tool for digitizing and archiving important information.
PDF Editing and Merging:
Edit, modify, and enhance your PDF documents directly within iPrint. Merge multiple PDFs into a single file effortlessly. Tailor your documents to your exact specifications.
eSign Documents:
Say goodbye to paper forms and contracts. eSign documents directly from your device, ensuring a secure and legally binding electronic signature.
Cloud Integration:
Access your documents on-the-go with cloud integration. Connect your iCloud and Google Drive accounts to effortlessly retrieve and print files stored in the cloud.
Privacy and Security:
Your privacy is our priority. iPrint: Smart Printer App follows stringent security measures to ensure your data is handled with care. Rest assured that your information is safeguarded.
Free to Download:
Start using iPrint: Smart Printer App for free and experience the convenience of mobile printing and scanning. Unlock advanced features with in-app purchases or opt for a premium subscription.
***Why Choose iPrint: Smart Printer App?***
 • Print wirelessly with ePrint.
 • Harness the power of AirPrint for easy document output.
 • Scan and OCR for paper-to-digital convenience.
 • Edit and merge PDFs right within the app.
 • eSign documents for a modern, secure workflow.
 • Access and print from your iCloud and Google Drive accounts.
 • Ensure the highest levels of data privacy and security.

Bov
bluejetty:00070040:ios.description:
Als eerste mee met de actualiteit, het nieuws uit je buurt, de strafste video’s en de leukste spelletjes? Jij kiest. Via het vernieuwde menu van de HLN app navigeer je heel eenvoudig tussen ‘Nieuws’, ‘In de buurt’, ‘Video’ en ‘Puzzel’.
Bovenaan de app ben je in één klik mee met de meest recente artikels en video’s, Sport, Showbizz, Nina, Bizar, Geld, Eten, Tech, Mobiliteit, Wonen, Reizen of Wetenschapsnieuws. En bij belangrijk nieuws ben jij als eerste op de hoogte via gratis pushberichten.
Het beste van de HLN app
• In de buurt: selecteer je favoriete gemeenten en blijf op de hoogte van regionaal nieuws, toffe adresjes en evenementen bij jou in de buurt.
• Video: alle straffe beelden die je gezien moet hebben, bekijk je hier. De interessantste fragmenten uit populaire tv-programma’s en trending video’s van over de hele wereld. Laat je entertainen en zoek inspiratie in de dagelijkse selectie van onze redactie.
• Puzzel: daag jezelf uit met meer dan 50 gratis puzzels, spelletjes en quizzen. Neem het op tegen andere lezers via highscores.
Haal meer uit de app met deze handige functies
• Snel een artikel opzoeken? Via het nieuwe snelmenu in de HLN app heb je directe toegang tot de zoekfunctie. 
• Een artikel opslaan of makkelijk terugvinden? Bewaar ze met één klik in ‘Jouw leeslijst’. Lees deze artikels in de app wanneer het jou het best uitkomt. 
• Zin in een podcast? We verzamelen HLN’s beste podcasts nu via de geïntegreerde podcastspeler in de HLN app.
Handig om te weten
De HLN-app is gratis te downloaden. Je hebt een abonnement om HLN+ artikels te lezen. Om onbeperkt te kunnen lezen, kun je in de app een HLN Mobiel maandabonnement afsluiten. Dit abonnement kost € 7,99 per maand. Bij het bevestigen van de aankoop wordt het bedrag van je iTunes account afgeschreven.
Een abonnement via de App Store wordt automatisch verlengd. Deze automatische verlenging kan tot 24 uur voor het aflopen van de abonnementsperiode worden stopgezet via de instellingen van je Apple ID. Ga daarvoor op je iPhone naar Instellingen > iTunes en App Store > klik op je Apple ID > Toon Apple ID > Beheer abonnementen
Enkele apparaten worden niet ondersteund door de HLN app. Heb je problemen met het downloaden van de app? Lees dan verder bij ‘additional information’.
Volg HLN op social media
Altijd op de hoogte blijven? Volg HLN.be op Facebook, Instagram of Twitter:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HLN.be
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hln_be/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/hln_be
Gebruiksvoorwaarden: https://www.dpgmedia.be/nl/gebruiksvoorwaarden

Het beste van de HLN app
• In de buurt: selecteer je favoriete gemeenten en blijf op de hoogte van regionaal nieuws, toffe adresjes en evenementen bij jou in de buurt.
• Video: alle straffe beelden die je gezien moet hebben, bekijk je hier. De interessantste fragmenten uit populaire tv-programma’s en trending video’s van over de hele wereld. Laat je entertainen en zoek inspiratie in de dagelijkse selectie van onze redactie.
• Puzzel: daag jezelf uit met meer dan 50 gratis puzzels, spelletjes en quizzen. Neem het op tegen andere lezers via highscores.

Haal meer uit de app met deze handige functies
• Snel een artikel opzoeken? Via het nieuwe snelmenu in de HLN app heb je directe toegang tot de zoekfunctie. 
• Een artikel opslaan of makkelijk terugvinden? Bewaar ze met één klik in ‘Jouw leeslijst’. Lees deze artikels in de app wanneer het jou het best uitkomt. 
• Zin in een podcast? We verzamelen HLN’s beste podcasts nu via de geïntegreerde podcastspeler in de HLN app.
 
Handig om te weten
De HLN-app is gratis te downloaden. Je hebt een abonnement om HLN+ artikels te lezen. Om onbeperkt te kunnen lezen, kun je in de app een HLN Mobiel maandabonnement afsluiten. Dit abonnement kost € 7,99 per maand. Bij het bevestigen van de aankoop wordt het bedrag van je iTunes account afgeschreven.

Een abonnement via de App Store wordt automatisch verlengd. Deze automatische verlenging kan tot 24 uur voor het aflopen van de abonnementsperiode worden stopgezet via de instellingen van je Apple ID. Ga daarvoor op je iPhone naar Instellingen > iTunes en App Store > klik op je Apple ID > Toon Apple ID > Beheer abonnementen

Enkele apparaten worden niet ondersteund door de HLN app. Heb je problemen met het downloaden van de app? Lees dan verder bij ‘additional information’.

bluejetty:00066218:ios.description:
Popping Bubbles from Ape Apps is the ultimate bubble popping game! Geared towards kids but fun for adults, you will have fun as you burst bubbles in this incredible hand eye coordination game.
If you are ready for classic bubble bursting fun, then you need to play Popping Bubbles! In this fun casual free game for kids and adults of all ages, you must pop the multi colored bubbles before they reach the top of the screen. Watch out for the toxic fart bubbles!
Game play is simple. Multi colored bubbles float up from the bottom of the screen. You must poke them with your finger before they float away. If you pop 4 bubbles in a row without them getting away, you will score an epic combination move and unlock thunder mode with golden bubbles! Pop the gold bubbles for extra points! In the higher levels, toxic fart bubbles will appear. If you poke them you lose points, so avoid the gas!
Popping Bubbles features five gameplay modes for players of all skill levels. There are the standard easy, medium, and hard levels which include global high scores leaderboards and achievements. Then there are the casual and endless bubbles modes for kids and less experienced players. Popping Bubbles has something for everybody!
I am always looking to improve my games, so if you have any suggestions on how to make Popping Bubbles better, please leave a comment or drop me an e-mail. This game is for you guys! Help me make Popping Bubbles the best free game on the market!
Will you become a bubble popping master? Or will you get sent back to the kids corner? There's only one way to find out. Hone in your finger eye coordination! Honor the sexy sax guy! Get the girl! All is possible when you download Popping Bubbles! Batteries not included.

bluejetty:00152616:ios.description:
Why Play Water Match?
-Brain Training: Sorting sharpens observation, and solving puzzles boosts logic and intelligence—exercise your brain while having fun! 
-Stress Relief: A relaxing way to unwind. Color sorting + exciting events = a calming yet thrilling experience. 
-Sensory Delight: Visual and auditory triggers gently stimulate your senses, offering deep mental relaxation through gameplay! 
-Sleep Aid: An immersive experience that provides a sense of achievement, helping you escape pre-sleep anxiety. 
-All-Age Fun: Casual puzzle gameplay with simple taps—kids and adults alike love the satisfaction of a perfect pour!
Game Highlights: Immersive Gameplay That Keeps You Hooked
-Endless Content: Tons of water sort levels, limited-time events, and clever twists (mysterious colors, covered bottles) keep the game fresh. 
-Perfect Difficulty Curve: Start with easy beginner levels, then tackle pro stages with hidden colors—brain training that never gets dull. 
-Visually Friendly: 8 vibrant water shades, sleek bottle designs, and smooth animations (lifting, rippling water) make every tap a visual treat. 
-Sound Satisfaction: Crisp glass clinks, delicate water-pouring sounds, and soothing music blend for a deeply relaxing audio experience. 
-Play Offline: Enjoy anytime, anywhere—no internet needed. Pause at will to fit your busy schedule.
Water Sorting: Simple Moves, Smart Strategies
-Tap and Play: Just tap the bottles to enjoy the flow of colorful water—instantly relaxing! 
-Collect Colorful Bottles: Fill bottles with the same color, and they transform into gift bags. Collect them all for a huge sense of achievement! 
-Brain-Teasing Fun: Which bottle to pour first? Which to save? Every move is a key step in solving a clever puzzle! 
-Helpful Empty Bottles: Empty bottles are your secret helpers. Unlock more to conquer the toughest challenges!
In-Game Events & Leaderboards: Fun for Everyone
Whether tackling solo challenges, racing in real-time contests, or battling in guild wars, there’s a mode for you.Team up, compete with friends, and climb the leaderboard to show off your skills.Social fun turns solo puzzles into group celebrations! 
Useful Tools: Beat Tough Levels
-Undo: Made a mistake? Rewind to your last move (keeps unlocked secrets) and retry stress-free! 
Shuffle: Stuck? Randomly rearrange a bottle’s water layers (even mysterious ones) to spark new ideas. 
-Add Empty Bottle: Place an extra empty bottle in a gap—new solutions appear instantly!
Download Water Match Now—Your New Go-To Water Sort!
Use logic to conquer levels, race friends up the leaderboard, and let your brain play free in this colorful world!

bluejetty:00150865:ios.description:
At Weiser, we understand that the locks you choose to protect your home is a decision you do not take lightly. That is why we do not take shortcuts when it comes to quality, because we know that a better lock means better peace of mind.
Remote Access Control 
Monitor the status of your locks and manage your home's access seamlessly from anywhere at any time.
Trusted Access Management 
Share app access with guests or create scheduled or one-time access codes for keyless entry.
Instant Activity Alerts 
Receive instant notifications anytime someone accesses your home, or when invalid codes are entered, or lock tampering occurs.
Intuitive Home Management 
Easily configure and manage multiple homes and locks for complete control.
Seamless Integration with Smart Ecosystems 
Add your lock via Wi-Fi to your preferred smart home ecosystems, including Google Home or Amazon Alexa, or amplify automation through IFTTT.
Weiser’s new Halo Select lock is Matter and Wi-Fi compatible, giving you the same Wi-Fi options as our other Halo locks. With Matter, you can connect to Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, and other Matter hubs via Thread.
Matter features may differ from ecosystem to ecosystem. You can check out ca.weiserlock.com/matter for more information
Security and Peace of Mind
Weiser provides unparalleled security while safeguarding your privacy. All data shared between the lock, the server, and the Weiser app is encrypted, and our servers are exclusively hosted in the US. Our goal is to provide you with the utmost convenience, trust, and safety for your smart living experience.
The Weiser App is compatible with all Weiser Halo and Weiser Aura smart locks.

bluejetty:00182535:ios.description:
*** Listed on Games Magazine's Electronic Games 100 for 2011! ***
Legend has it that over 642 million Chinese play Tichu nearly every day! I don't know about that. All I know is that Tichu might very well be the world's best card game. 
Tichu is a partnership game for four players where partners battle to be the first to play all of their cards and score points. Each hand is filled with strategy and risk. Will you be the first player to play all of your cards? Perhaps you'd like to make a little wager on that? Are you willing to risk 100 points? How about 200? 
Tichu has long been the favorite card game of all time on BoardGameGeek. Find out why! I promise that you won't regret it! 
Tichu boasts the following great features:
Fully licensed and authorized by designer Urs Hostettler and publisher Fata Morgana Spiele.
Computer controlled opponents boast a challenging and lifelike Artificial Intelligence that is configurable in numerous ways.
Up to 4 humans can play from any supported device in any part of the world.
Data automatically backed up to the cloud and synced to any device that runs the game!
Extensive tutorial and in-game documentation will teach you how to play and have you playing like a champ in no time.
Hint feature helps you play while you learn.
Choose from multiple beautiful deck styles.

bluejetty:00015914:ios.description:
Dailymotion turns every video into a living social space : a place to create, talk, and belong.
Not a feed to chase views, but a community built around conversations.
Watch → talk. Post → connect. Create → be you.
Because views without vibes are boring. 
Because your niche deserves a home. Because video should bring people together, not push them apart.
Dailymotion is where Gen-Z and everyday creators can record, edit, and publish with pro-level mobile tools, then build real back-and-forth with the people who get them. It’s familiar, but it works better: calmer design, healthier interactions, smarter discovery you can tune. Tools and spaces inspired by what creators love on platforms like TikTok or Discord, rebuilt for conversation and community.
CREATE YOUR WAY
- Chatrooms around videos: Join real-time conversations directly tied to each video for instant, meaningful back-and-forth.
- Super-Like & Daily Boost: Once a day, give a video extra visibility and show creators stronger support.
- Animated Captions: Auto-generated captions in 20+ languages that animate and highlight key moments.
- Smooth Camera Zoom: Cinematic zooming with intuitive slide or pinch controls for polished shots.
- Filters & Visual Styles: On-brand filters you can apply live or in the editor to keep a consistent look.
- Full Video Editor: Multi-layer timeline with text, stickers, transitions, and effects for expressive videos.
- Green Screen & Layouts: One-tap backgrounds, split screen, PiP, and background removal for richer storytelling.
- Reset Your Feed: Restart your recommendations anytime to regain control of what you see.
- Rate Videos Against Your Taste: Tell the algorithm what matches your vibe for cleaner, smarter discovery.
- New Platform Design: Cleaner, bolder, more readable UI shaped with Gen Z expectations and powered by a unified design system.
CREATE → CONNECT → BELONG
Communities that feel like home.
Real conversations, healthier interactions, and discovery you control.
Bring your niche, your humor, your creativity and connect with people who get you.
WHY DAILYMOTION
Authentically social video: watch, talk, belong.
Real engagement > empty impressions.
Tools that help you express, not obsess.
Feels familiar, works better.Bring your niche, your humor, your hot takes.
Turn views into conversations and conversations into community. 
Join Dailymotion.

bluejetty:00086789:ios.description:
Looking for an app that lets you connect with your friends and have serious fun? Say hello to Hago Hago is the latest social networking app that is taking the world by storm, providing you a new way to enjoy party games, chat rooms, live streams & 3D space all in one stop! With more than 500 million downloads worldwide, Hago is one of the liveliest places you can be online. It helps you discover new hobbies, get in touch with old ones, hang out with your new friends no matter where they may be, and much more!
#Party games#
Rather than have different games on your device, Hago lets you play hundreds of mini-games – all in one app. People will find even more fun on this app than Tinder, Wild Rift & PUBG! Come and enjoy a whole collection of excitement including Ludo, Ghost dorm, Dominoes, Among us, Draw & Guess (Dibuja y adivina), Free Fire, Roblox, Sheep fight, Brain teaser & more! Rewards are waiting for you by simply completing the missions or beating the opponents, like GameFi. Invite your friends or quickly match players from all over the world today to win! 
#Chat room#
Want to meet new people or chat with your friends? You can do that through the chat rooms.Moreover, the rooms support voice chat, which means you can have conversations in real-time! No matter if you wanna keep up with the Kardashians, or listen to Drake’s new album, you can always find what you want with up to 8 new friends in the chat room. Have fun!
#Live stream#
Hago offers fun live streaming, thanks to thousands of talented streamers providing dancing, makeup, singing and talk show content 24/7. All you need to do is browse through the offerings to find your favorite kind of live stream and enjoy! Even more, you can be the coolest guy in the room & get seen by your favorite streamers by supporting them with exclusive virtual animated gifts! Start with one click today & let the story go from there!
#3D Space#
It allows you to develop your 3D characters and 3D rooms in the app with more than 100 amazing outlooks! You are free to create your own virtual character or Metaverse avatar with NFTs. Explore the Hago metaverse by building your unique 3D character, holding your own karaoke concert, launching virtual parties, and playing dice with your 3D friends! 
#Party hosting#
If you’re away from your friends but want to have some fun, Hago makes that possible. You can have an exciting online party on the app. Whether it’s karaoke, gossip, wedding or birthday parties, Hago is the virtual place for you and your friend to have a fun night. 
Reviews
“It’s a good app for shy people like me to meet and start a chat. I watch live streams at night and play games. Excepto los contenidos de talentos y hermosas, también puedo participar en muchos eventos. I use it to kill boredom, and it has made staying indoors more enjoyable.” – Albert Shen
“Still very new to the app, but I love it already! I’ve discovered a number of NFT and blockchain broadcasters, which means I get to enjoy my favorite kind of content. Definitely worth downloading.” – Emily Whitman 
""Shoutout to Hago, this app really fires! Me and my boys LOVE the NBA YoungBoy’s listening party here, ppl tapped in! 5 Stars!"" - Daniel Boateng
Hago is a versatile app designed for everyone! It doesn’t matter what you see as fun; the app always has got you covered. Don’t miss out on the daily dose of multi-videos, mini-games, and other exciting content. Download Hago today!

https://www.tiktok.com/@hago_usa

bluejetty:00074112:ios.summary:
This powerful app shows you in beautiful detail the numerous ways you can play chords on your guitar, your ukulele, and other plucked string instruments.
Here you will find the classic chord shapes, but also every possible variation on the
bluejetty:00074112:ios.description:
This powerful app shows you in beautiful detail the numerous ways you can play chords on your guitar, your ukulele, and other plucked string instruments.
Here you will find the classic chord shapes, but also every possible variation on the fretboard. You'll be amazed how many different ways you can play the chords of your songs.
The app supports over 50 different chord types; slash chords are also supported. In total, there are over 7,500 chords.
Swipe a chord diagram with your finger to strum the chord on the instrument. The chord will be strummed according to the speed and direction of your finger. 
For a more accurate sound, you can select either steel strings or nylon strings.
Do a long press on a diagram to see it bigger.
You discovered an interesting chord but you don't know what it's called? You can use our Reverse Lookup tool to find out.
Pick the scale of your choice; the app will show you the diatonic chords for that scale.
Create rich chord sheets with the chords of your choice. Save your work to a file, then export your chord sheets as PDF.
Interested in alternate tunings? You're covered. Pick your tuning from our catalog and we'll show you how to play all your chords in that particular configuration. You can also create your own custom tuning, with 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 strings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00171468:ios.description:
Los Angeles Metropolitan Transit Authority ("LACMTA"), a government agency, is the owner and developer of this app.
TAP is your ticket to ride transit in greater Los Angeles! It is accepted on 27 systems including LA Metro, providing a vast network of buses and trains.
- Make your travel safe and easy with touchless payment and card management.
- Add a new TAP card to your iPhone and Apple Watch and use your fare immediately.
- Use your iPhone (8 and above) and Apple Watch (Series 3 and above) to tap with Apple Pay when boarding a bus or train.
- Enjoy flexible payment options including credit/debit cards, account cash and Apple Pay.
- Purchase a transit pass or Stored Value for any agency in Los Angeles County.
- Manage multiple cards in your TAP account (iPhone 5 and above).
- Add your TAP card to Apple Wallet, enable Express Transit and quickly tap and pay when you board. You don't even have to wake up your phone!
- Supports reduced fares for seniors, students, persons with disabilities and low-income riders.
- Transfer a TAP card in your account to your Apple Wallet and leave the plastic at home.

SEE WHAT’S AR
bluejetty:00174443:ios.description:
Discover the best locations worldwide: Where To? finds the closest and best rated places to eat, shop, party, and relax.
“In a matter of seconds the Where To? app can direct you to any type of place you're looking for”
- CNN
SEE WHAT’S AROUND YOU
Where To? is an incredibly easy way to find the closest steakhouse, bank branch, billiard club, or anything else you might be looking for – whether you are on vacation in Paris or in your own back yard! See your options on the built-in map, in a list sorted by distance or in Augmented Reality. With just a few taps, you can find any type of place you are looking for, close to wherever you are!
AUGMENTED REALITY
Explore a cool new way of visualization by displaying nearby locations in the live camera image, on top of reality. Being able to see through walls, it’s like X-ray vision for your iPhone.
YOUR LOCAL GUIDE
Where To? is your local guide in your pocket! It provides you with dinner menus, photos, videos, business hours, and more details. All you have to do is choose — then make a reservation, order your meal, or check the place’s homepage.
CHECK REVIEWS 
Is the food delicious? The service great? Let others know! Where To? also collects and displays ratings and reviews from various 3rd party platforms.
FAVORITES AND COLLECTIONS
Save your favorite places and organize them in collections. Import collections from KML or GPX. Share places and collections with your friends.
SHOWS YOU THE WAY
Whether by car, bike, walking or public transport, Where To? gets you where you want to go. Use the built-in route planner or any of more than 80 apps from the App Store. The bike navigation also supports shared bikes and scooters from more than 250 micromobility services.
CAR INTEGRATION
Turn the key and let your car guide you to the destination. You can send locations to supported onboard navigation systems (Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Mini).
WIDGETS
Access nearby places right from your home or lock screen – with configurable widgets in various types and sizes.
ADD TO SIRI
Enhance Siri by creating a shortcut to search using Where To? for nearby places. Or create workflows using the Shortcuts app.
GEO ALARMS
Create location-based reminders and get notified when arriving or departing.
SUPPORT FOR APPLE WATCH AND MESSAGES
Show your favorite places, select your favorite category or search by voice. And the included Apple Watch app displays nearby results right on your wrist! The included iMessage app lets you search for locations and share them in a conversation without leaving the Messages app.
¿HABLA ESPAÑOL?, PARLEZ-VOUS FRANÇAIS?
You’re going to Mexico and don’t know what a „Hair Salon“ is in Spanish? Where To? searches in 11 different languages and translates all categories to the local language on-the-fly.
AWARDS
- Featured by Apple as iPhone App of the Week and in App Store Rewind
- Multi-year winner of the Best App Ever Awards (“Best Travel App”)
WHAT OTHERS SAY
“continues a remarkable tradition as one of the best ways to find places around town” (4.5 of 5 stars)
- MacLife
“Highly recommended”
- Engadget
“the excellent location-aware points of interest finder for the iPhone”
- Daring Fireball
SOCIAL MEDIA
Follow us for announcements and updates:
- Facebook: https://fb.com/wheretoapp
- Mastodon: https://urbanists.social/@whereto
- X: @futuretap
Where To? PRO Terms of service: https://www.futuretap.com/whereto-pro-terms

bluejetty:00128158:ios.description:
Apple Design Award Winner 2022
A beautiful new adventure by multiple award winning developers of Old Man’s Journey and ELOH, in which a family of gibbons finds themselves lost in a dangerous world beyond their understanding.
- Experience free-flowing dynamic movement based on brachiation, the way real gibbons swing through the trees
- Master acrobatic moves, including launching from another gibbon’s hands in mid air
- A touching adventure of a family of gibbons trying to survive amid an encroaching human threat.
- Play through an hourlong adventure in story mode, or race to freedom through a procedurally generated jungle in liberation mode.
- Compete in the leaderboards and see how far you can swing, backflip and slide in Daily Run mode!
- Stunning 2D hand painted visuals that breathe life into a rapidly vanishing world.
- Explore varied environments, from the wild jungles of Southeast Asia to the hectic human world beyond.
- Collect all encyclopedia entries and find out more about gibbons and their habitat.
- Gibbon: Beyond the Trees deals with challenging but acute environmental topics, including deforestation, poaching and climate change.

Turntin is a trusted, AI-powered plagiarism detection solution built for students, educators, researchers, and professionals worldwide. 
Using industry-leading similarity detection technology, 
Turntin helps analyze written content to ensure originality and academic integrity. Whether you’re submitting an academic 
paper, publishing research, or preparing professional documentation, Turntin provides confidence that your work is authentic and properly cited. 

Why Choose Turntin? 
Advanced Similarity Detection – Turntin compares text against an extensive database of academic papers, scholarly journals, publications, 
and web content to identify even minor similarities. Fast & Reliable Reports – Receive clear, detailed similarity reports that highlight matched 
content and provide direct source references. Privacy & Security First – Submitted content is handled with strict confidentiality, 
ensuring data protection and secure processing. 
Multiple File Formats Supported – Upload documents in various formats or paste text directly for instant analysis. Academic & Web Database Coverage – Content 
is checked against a vast collection of peer-reviewed research, institutional repositories, and online sources. In-Depth Insights – Review originality scores, 
citation feedback, and guidance to improve writing quality and proper attribution. Who Can Benefit? Students & Educators – Promote academic honesty and 
prevent unintentional plagiarism in essays, assignments, theses, and research work. 
Researchers & Academics – Validate originality and ensure proper citation in scholarly publications. 
Writers & Content Creators – Maintain credibility and originality in professional and published content. 
Institutions & Organizations – Uphold integrity standards across academic and professional documentation. 
With Turntin, you can write, review, and submit work with confidence. 
Strengthen academic integrity, protect originality, and elevate the quality of written content—every step of the way.

bluejetty:00147481:ios.description:
SaveAround’s Mobile Application is a companion to our coupon books and contains extra deals that may or may not be found in our hard-copy coupons books. Our app offers access to a collection of coupons that can be redeemed with merchants in your geographic area (and in some cases online). By using the Mobile Application, as opposed to buying a hard-copy coupon book, you can choose how long you would like access to the coupon collection. We offer subscriptions ranging from 1 month to 1 year. Coupons are valid from January 1 throughout December 31 of each year. There may be multiple copies of some coupons in the collection, while for other coupons in the collection there is only one coupon that may be redeemed during the calendar year. Each January 1, the coupons in the collection are either renewed and can be used again or will be replaced by coupons from other merchants.
SaveAround® is North America’s premier Discount Coupon Fundraising Book. Since 1975, we have been helping schools and community groups raise funds, local merchants promote and grow their businesses, and people throughout the community save money. From famous national chains to your favorite local mom-and-pop businesses, SaveAround® offers coupon savings everyone will love.

bluejetty:00187924:ios.description:
The Celayix Team Xpress App features a number of capabilities, including availability submission, self-scheduling, shift confirmation, clock-in/out, safety check, time-off requests, and more for your scheduling and time tracking needs.
SCHEDULES
Team members can view and confirm their schedules, as well as receive and acknowledge any shift changes.
CLOCK-IN/CLOCK-OUT
Team members can clock-in/out of shifts, record meal breaks and perform safety checks directly from the app, avoiding a dedicated time capture device at every location. The result is precise time capture and compliance record, all delivered to supervisors in real time, notifying them of late arrivals and missed shifts.
TIME SHEETS
Mobile or field team members can keep track of time spent on projects or customers right on their mobile device and deliver their tracked hours to supervisors in real time for accurate payroll and billing.
AVAILABILITY
Team members can submit and communicate their availability to supervisors. This reduces the amount of time spent creating schedules. In cases of missed shifts, supervisors can also use the availability module to quickly find replacements without spending hours calling around.
TIME OFF
Team members can submit Time Off requests for supervisor review and approval with decisions communicated back through the app. 
MESSAGING
Communicate in real time through in-app messaging, eliminating the need to use other methods such as email, text, or phone.

bluejetty:00144807:ios.description:
Đánh bài Tiến Lên (Tiến Lên Miền Nam, Tien Len) là một trò chơi bài phổ biến ở Việt Nam. Tiến Lên được ưa chuộng rộng rãi vì cách chơi dễ hiểu, thú vị và không kém phần kịch tính. Trò chơi này có thể chơi ở bất cứ đâu, từ các quán cà phê đến các buổi tụ họp gia đình, hay chơi trong các dịp lễ, tết, hoặc các buổi họp mặt bạn bè. Trò chơi này không chỉ mang tính giải trí mà còn yêu cầu người chơi có sự tư duy, tính toán và chiến lược và cả may mắn.
Tiến lên là trò chơi bài căng thẳng và kịch tính. Người chơi đánh bài theo thứ tự lớn dần để chặn bài của đối thủ, tạo ra nhiều tình huống hồi hộp. Các tổ hợp bài mạnh như tứ quý hay bốn đôi thông mang đến cảm giác phấn khích khi chặt heo (2). Người chơi hết bài đầu tiên sẽ giành chiến thắng, mang lại niềm vui và cảm giác thành công.
Chúng tôi xin giới thiệu trò chơi đánh bài Tiến Lên Miền Nam - Tien Len, với mục đích mang trải nghiệm của trò chơi dân gian thú vị này đến với thiết bị di động của mọi người. Tiến Lên Miền Nam - Tien Len được đầu tư kỹ lưỡng về mặt giao diện cũng như cách chơi để mang trải nghiệm của trò chơi thân thuộc lên thiết bị di động mà không làm mất đi sự thú vị vốn có của nó. bluejetty:00183255:ios.description:
Pizza Hut KSA has made online pizza ordering now more exciting & convenient. Pizza Hut delivery app enables you to explore the Pizza Hut KSA menu, order pizza online, and get it delivered to your doorstep. You're in Cairo, Alexandria, Hurghada, Sharm El Shiekh, or any other city in KSA, just download the new Pizza Hut fast food delivery app to enjoy delicious pizza at home. 
Pizza Hut KSA app customizes exclusive deals & offers only for you on your favorite chicken pizza, stuffed crust, margherita pizza, garlic bread, pepperoni, vegan pizza, family meals & ranch boxes. Do not miss to check out the wide range of delicious starters, drinks & desserts on Pizza Hut app.
Order your delicious pizza at the comfort of your home or you can also takeaway your favorite pizza or pasta from your nearest Pizza Hut Restaurant in KSA. 
Pizza Hut KSA app enables you to explore the local menu and make online food ordering to the next level, follow just a few easy steps:
1. Download the Pizza Hut KSA app,
2. Choose a preferred mode of language 
3. Check your favorite items from easy to navigate menu,
4. Add goodness to your cart,
5. Easy Login to use saved addresses or continue as Guest,
6. Pick your preferred mode of ordering as takeaway or delivery,
7. Select location and provide a delivery address,
8. Hassle free proceed to check out and make the payment,
9. Track your order and get it delivered to your selected location,
10. Time to enjoy the food delivered at your doorstep.
Why use Pizza Hut Delivery App:
*Exclusive Pizza Hut KSA Menu:
Order from the wide range of chicken pizza, stuffed crust, margherita pizza, garlic bread, pepperoni pizza, potato wedges, cheesy pizza, prawn, vegan pizza, family meals, ranch box & much more. Do not forget to look for our Sides, Desserts & starters section.
*Personalized Pizza Cart: 
Customize your Pizza, Pasta, desserts, starters, or family meals with a wide variety of toppings, stuffed crust, and add-on options.
*My Orders:
We bookmark all your pizza orders so you don’t end up spending time repeating your previous orders. Get special Pizza Hut deals on our app with your order today.
*Pizza Hut Takeaway:
While you are out and about in the city, takeaway your delicious pizza from any nearest Pizza Hut restaurant in KSA by ordering from the Pizza Hut food delivery app.
*My Favorites:
We know your love for pizza, and we have added this place to store all your favorites.
*Exciting Offers: 
Get exclusive Pizza Hut Offers & Deals customized only for you so it leaves you wanting for more and get rewarded at the time of your order. 
*Easy payments:
Paying online has never been so hassle-free, with multiple payment options (including Cash on Delivery, online payments like (Credit/Debit Cards, etc.) at your fingertips. 
*Track your orders: 
Get notified and know your order status LIVE on the Pizza Hut delivery app without the hassle of calling.
*Find Pizza Hut:
Find your nearest Pizza Hut in KSA on our food app, or pick up your amazing local pizza offers and deals.
*My Account:
You can tap into the world of pizza by following our easy login process that now can be done via social mode as well.

bluejetty:00162914:ios.description:
Unni helps you find, compare, and book trusted Korean beauty clinics in Korea, all in one app.
Discover clinics with 9.5M+ real reviews. Compare local discounts, check transparent prices, and book with confidence.
Whether you’re visiting Korea or exploring treatments near your route and stay, Unni makes it easier to find clinics that match your beauty goals.
Find the right clinic with personalized AI recommendations, exclusive deals, and no hidden costs. From browsing treatments to chatting with clinics and booking appointments, Unni helps you plan everything in just a few taps.
With Unni, you can:
Browse 9.5M+ real reviews and decide with confidence
· Every review is receipt-verified, and clinics are penalized for pressuring or faking reviews — so what you read is the real thing.
· Use the "what fell short" filter to see reviews from every angle, not just the highlights.
Explore 4,900+ clinics and every treatment in one place
· Compare skincare, double eyelid and nose surgery, fat contour, face lifting, and more — all in one app, so you never have to search across a dozen sites.
Compare local discounts and pay like a local
· Unlock the same deals and prices Korean locals get, right from your phone.
See transparent prices with no hidden costs
· Compare prices by the exact details that matter — shot count, device used, number of sessions — so you know precisely what you're paying for.
Get personalized AI recommendations that match your beauty goals
· Tell Unni what you're looking for and get clinic suggestions tailored to you.
Find and book clinics near your route and stay
· Filter by neighborhood to find derm and plastic surgery clinics close to where you're staying — no detours, no wasted time.
Chat with clinics and book appointments directly in Unni
· Ask doctors your questions directly, connect with users facing the same decision in the community, then request a consultation and book — all without leaving the app.
Plan your beauty journey in Korea with confidence. Find, compare, and book trusted Korean beauty clinics with Unni.

bluejetty:00184203:ios.description:
Welcome to Citytouch!
Open accounts, apply for loans, save, invest, pay, transfer, and manage your entire banking relationship from a single app.
Whether you’re managing everyday finances or planning for what’s next, Citytouch helps you stay on top of your money with everything you need in one place.
Powerful banking, simplified
• Open a new bank account instantly, without stepping into a branch
• Get a complete, real-time view of your accounts, cards, loans, and investments
• Personalize your dashboard with smart tools to help you track your finances
• Switch seamlessly between English and Bangla
Move your money in a tap
• Send money instantly to any bank in Bangladesh via NPSB, RTGS, or BEFTN
• Transfer funds seamlessly to major mobile wallets
• Scan and pay with QR codes at thousands of merchants
• Withdraw cash without your card using Cash by Code
Settle bills in seconds
• Top up your mobile balance and pay utility bills instantly

• Activate cards and manage your PIN directly from the app

• Open a Fixed Deposit (FD) or monthly savings plan (DPS) in minutes
• Apply for digital loans directly through the app (for eligible customers)
• Access dedicated digital banking features for City Islamic accounts
Premium support and smart features
• Earn MyRewards points on your everyday transactions
• Get instant assistance through our AI Chatbot in Bangla and English
• Raise and track service requests directly from the app
• Explore ATMs, branches, and exclusive offers in Guest Mode before you log in
Getting started is simple
1. Download the app
2. Register using your City Bank account or card details
3. Start banking smarter
Download Citytouch and experience banking designed around you.
Need help? Call 16234 or email citytouch@citybankplc.com.

bluejetty:00155419:ios.description:

Free users can enjoy limited access to features 1-3: interrupting your mindless scrolling up to 30 times.

Limit distracting apps, like TikTok and Instagram, to enhance your productivity now!
1. Select Distractions
Identify distracting apps like TikTok and set usage limits.
2. Shield Reminder
A prompt will block apps when time is up, asking, "Why are you opening this again?"
3. Defer App Opening
Set defer times to reduce impulsive app usage.
4. Activate Strict Focus Mode
Block selected apps for 15 minutes to work uninterrupted. Exit focus mode when you're ready, helping you scroll with intention, not mindlessly.
5. Privacy & Data
All data is stored locally on your device. We do not collect any user data.
How much time do you spend scrolling through short-form content?
3 hours a day? 5 hours? Maybe even 10?

We get it—scrolling addiction is tough to stop. That’s why SigmaGrind gently interrupts your scrolling every 5-20 minutes (fully customizable) to remind you to scroll with intent, not habit.
Take control of your focus and time.
With our Pro subscription, unlock Strict Focus Mode — a powerful tool to block endless scrolling cycles and keep you on track.
Ready to scroll smarter, not harder?

Canopy is the firm-wide operating system that helps you build the accounting firm you've always wanted. And with the Canopy mobile app, you stay connected and productive from anywhere, giving you everything you need to manage your firm and clients from the palm of your hand.
Stay in touch with clients
Stay connected to your clients and their work. With ready access to your clients' information, you can keep things moving and answer the important questions on the go.
Take files anywhere
Be prepared for any client, IRS call, or firm conversation with mobile access to your files. Easily review, annotate, scan, and store them. Even upload photos from messages or file storage apps on the go.
Manage your work
Keep track of your client projects. Leverage workflow automation, create new tasks, update existing ones, or send client requests. Track time worked and reply to your clients—all from your fingertips.
Get paid faster
Review your clients' outstanding and past invoices, resend payment requests, and receive or record payments lickety-split.
Security built for mobile
Protect your information with multi-factor authentication, encryption, and touch or face identification. Manage devices and revoke access on the fly.
About Canopy
Canopy is a cloud-based practice management suite for accounting professionals. The suite includes the Client Engagement Platform—the foundation of everything—Document Management, Workflow, Time & Billing, Insights, and Tax Resolution.

bluejetty:00153365:ios.description:
Every drawing has a story. MagicBrew brings it to life!
Whether it's your child's crayon masterpiece, a doodle in the margins, or a photo you want to reimagine — MagicBrew transforms it into a beautiful animation with a single tap.
From the creators of PicCollage—trusted by 280 million+ users worldwide—MagicBrew is built with the same spirit: making creativity easy, personal, and full of joy.
■ Bring any drawing to life
Snap a photo of any drawing or artwork and watch it transform into a moving animation. Kids' drawings become adventures. Doodles become stories. Every piece becomes something you'll want to save and share forever.
■ Turn photos into videos with AI
MagicBrew's image-to-video feature takes any photo and animates it into a beautiful, shareable video. Watch a still moment start to move — perfect for family memories, creative projects, or simply surprising someone you love.
■ Explore ready-made effects and templates
Browse a growing collection of AI-powered style effects — from heartwarming 3D fairy art and chibi-style portraits to seasonal and holiday-inspired looks. New styles added regularly, so there's always something fresh to discover. No prompts, no fuss — just tap, brew, and watch the magic happen.
■ Go fully custom with AI
Want something uniquely yours? Describe exactly what you want and choose from multiple AI models to make it real. Fine-tune the results, adjust the style, and make every creation feel personal. No complicated settings — just your imagination and MagicBrew doing the heavy lifting.
MagicBrew is for parents, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who's ever looked at a drawing and wondered — what if it could move?
MagicBrew at a glance
· Animate drawings, sketches, and kids' artwork into videos
· Turn any photo into an animated video memory
· Transform photos with AI style effects — chibi, fairy art, and more
· Custom AI creation with free-text prompts and multiple AI models
· New effects added regularly — from heartwarming to whimsical
· Save and share your creations with family and friends
Try MagicBrew today and turn your art into something magical!
———
Terms of Service: http://cardinalblue.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://cardinalblue.com/privacy
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/magicbrew.app/

bluejetty:00136886:ios.description:
Unlock a World of Languages with GO2TRain!
Say goodbye to language barriers and start your journey to fluency with GO2TRain – the ultimate language learning app that makes mastering new languages fun, easy, and accessible for everyone.
Whether you’re dreaming of speaking English, German, French, Korean, Turkish, Italian, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, or Chinese, GO2TRain offers engaging lessons tailored to all skill levels. Join thousands of learners and start your language adventure today!
Why GO2TRain?
- Diverse Language Selection: Master popular languages like English, German, French, Korean, Turkish, Italian, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, and Chinese, with new languages added regularly.
- Engaging Video Lessons: Interactive video sessions from 45 to 90 minutes, making learning feel like having a personal tutor on hand.
- Find a Language Partner: Connect with other learners and practice together! Find a partner to improve your speaking skills in a real-world context.
- AI Chat for Instant Practice: Improve your writing and conversation skills by chatting with our AI assistant, available to help anytime!
- Downloadable Handouts: Review important point of lessons easily with downloadable study materials.
- Quizzes and Exercises: Test your skills after each session and advance your language abilities.
- Desktop Version Available: Prefer learning on a bigger screen? GO2TRain is now available on desktop for a more immersive experience.
Your Language, Your Adventure!
GO2TRain goes beyond language learning – it’s about experiencing new cultures and stories from around the world. Ready to embark on your language journey? Download GO2TRain now and open the door to endless opportunities.

Unlock the full potential of GO2TRain with our premium subscription plans:
Premium Subscription – Enjoy unlimited access for just $5.99 per month.
Premium 6-Month Subscription – Get 6 months of premium access for only $19.99.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation.
The renewal cost will be the same as the original subscription price.
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings

bluejetty:00042552:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Pick 'n Save app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Pick 'n Save grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Fresh Perks Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Pick 'n Save Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Pick 'n Save store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.picknsave.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.picknsave.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Pick 'n Save app, you need a Pick 'n Save digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Pick 'n Save Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Pick 'n Save's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.picknsave.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

MetroGo Call-A-Ride: Your Ultimate Travel Companion
Experience the ease and freedom of travel on Metro Transit St. Louis Call-A-Ride with the MetroGo app. Designed with our customers in mind, MetroGo allows you to seamlessly manage your travel needs from the convenience of your smartphone. Whether you're a daily Call-A-Ride customer or an occasional customer, MetroGo puts control in your hands to make your journey as smooth and efficient as possible.

Manage Your Trips: Effortlessly schedule, adjust, and cancel your rides with just a few taps.
Real-Time Tracking: Stay informed about your ride's progress with live updates.
Simple Payment Options: Securely pay your fare in advance or on the go, right from the app.
Users of this app must already be a registered Metro Transit St. Louis Call-A-Ride Customer. Upgrade your commuting experience and discover the convenience that other Call-A-Ride customers already enjoy with MetroGo. 
Note: For use by registered customers of Metro Transit St. Louis Call-A-Ride paratransit service.
