bluejetty:00120025:ios.name: Daily Chinese: Grow Vocabulary
bluejetty:00120025:ios.summary: Daily Chinese is the simplest way to grow your Chinese vocabulary. An optimized spaced-repetition algorithm gradually introduces new words each day and makes sure you never forget the words you already know. Master a variety of question typ
bluejetty:00120025:ios.description:
Daily Chinese is the simplest way to grow your Chinese vocabulary. An optimized spaced-repetition algorithm gradually introduces new words each day and makes sure you never forget the words you already know. Master a variety of question types that adjust their difficulty to challenge you, and access AI-generated example sentences and word breakdowns to reinforce your learning.
Create daily reviews from useful, practical word packs that contain 20,000+ total words, or build your own custom review from the exact words you want to learn. Learn the basics, get ahead at work, pass the HSK, survive abroad, and so much more.
Through practicing a little every day, Daily Chinese will help you master your Chinese vocabulary forever.
*Spaced-Repetition Algorithm*
The optimized algorithm shows you the words you need to review when you need to review them. New words are introduced daily and the words you’ve already reviewed are shown right before you might forget them, storing them in your long-term memory.
*Create Custom Reviews*
Build daily reviews from the exact words you want to learn. Search 20,000+ words, hand-pick your list, and order it however you like. Perfect for textbook chapters, class vocab lists, or words you pick up in the wild.
*Master Different Question Types*
More than just flashcards, the app has a variety of different question types to make sure you learn all elements of a word or idiom, including the Chinese characters, pinyin, and definition.
*Example Sentences and Insights*
AI-powered insights for every word and idiom that include example sentences, word insights, etymology, and cultural context.
*Own Your Progress*
Master words and idioms and watch your vocabulary grow. The words you learn are added to your vocabulary collection, giving you proof of your mastery and a record of your progress.
*Learn the Fundamentals*
For beginners, an introductory series presents words in an order that builds upon what you’ve already learned. You’ll quickly learn the basics and develop a strong foundation. 
*Prepare for the HSK*
Daily Chinese includes the most recent official vocabulary lists for all levels of the HSK, Mainland China’s Chinese proficiency exam.
*Master Idioms and Grammar Words*
Our expertly crafted packs of four-character idioms (成语) and grammar words will help you navigate Chinese sentences and take your language ability to the next level.
*Get Around and Live Abroad*
Need to read a Chinese menu, talk to your landlord, or survive study abroad? Our word packs will teach you the essential words you need to know if you are traveling, living, or studying in China. 
*Focus on China*
Go in-depth on Chinese cultural subjects and learn important terms related to politics, religion, traditional medicine, and geography.
*Read the News*
Start reading primary sources in Chinese and stay up on current events by mastering words related to international affairs, trade, technology, and more.
*Survive the Office*
Whether teaching English, working in tech, or running a multinational business empire, we have word packs to help you tackle any job.
*And More…*
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00060661:ios.description:
Welcome to Jurassic Dinosaur, an enchanting world where your little one can accompany a friendly Triceratops on a fascinating journey! In this colorful and interactive game for kids, your child assumes the role of a small Triceratops, who is eager to explore every corner of Dinosaur Island.
In this adventure-packed game, your young one will have the liberty to explore the habitats of various dinosaurs like the mighty T-rex, the headstrong Pachycephalosaurus, or the armored Ankylosaurus. Through this journey, children will not only have fun but also learn about these prehistoric creatures, thus making it one of the most educational games for kids. 
The daily life of the little Triceratops is filled with playful activities. Your child can guide the Triceratops to jump in mud pits, swim underwater in search of hidden treasures, hop onto trees from the ground, and swing through the forests using vines. There's always a new discovery waiting around the corner, and each reveals an interactive puzzle that helps children learn about shapes, colors, and the prehistoric world.
Take flight to the sky, taste marshmallows amidst the fluffy clouds, or turn into a balloon by eating magical red berries. The island is also home to a sleeping T-rex - but be careful not to wake him up! 
If a large rock blocks the path, don't fret! Help your Stegosaurus friend move it and continue the exploration. Stumble upon a mysterious cave? Take a leap of faith and slide your way to the other side! Fun interactions like these are designed to help kids understand the concept of spatial relationships, promoting learning through play in a child-friendly environment.
Uncover the secrets of Dinosaur Island and engage your little one's brain in an epic adventure that goes beyond a conventional dinosaur game. The island is brimming with exciting mysteries and pre-K activities that spark curiosity in toddlers, kindergarteners, and preschool-aged children. This interactive learning game is a must-have addition to your collection of games that work offline.
About Yateland
Yateland aims to create apps with educational value that inspire preschoolers worldwide to learn through play. "Apps children love and parents trust" is the motto that guides us in creating games that combine fun with learning. Discover more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
At Yateland, your child's privacy is our priority. We are committed to creating a safe and secure environment within our games. To learn more about how we handle user privacy, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy. By installing this application, you agree to our privacy policy terms.
In Jurassic Dinosaur, we've created an exciting, interactive world where the Jurassic meets fun learning games. Join us in this vibrant journey and experience the joy of learning through play!

bluejetty:00042434:ios.description:
Manage and track your blood pressure easily with the our app on your iOS device. Experience the smartest way to handle your blood pressure data with our comprehensive mobile application. Gain detailed insights into your systolic and diastolic blood pressure ranges with precise data analytics and artificial intelligence.
KEY FEATURES:
- Record systolic and diastolic blood pressure, pulse (BPM), and weight.
- Add notes (e.g., before sleep) and measurement details (feeling, measurement site, body position, etc.) for each entry.
- Store data in the cloud and access it from any device using your Apple ID.
- Share and export your blood pressure data with doctors, healthcare providers, or family members via text message or email.
- Print PDF reports or graphs directly from your device.
- Receive daily reminders to log your blood pressure data.
- Track BP trends for family members by creating multiple profiles.
DISCLAIMER:
The Blood Pressure App is designed to track, analyze, and record trends in your blood pressure. This app does not measure blood pressure itself; a separate blood pressure monitor is required.
PLEASE NOTE:
The app is not intended as a medical tool. It measures pulse using the camera but may have inaccuracies and should not be used for diagnosing or treating health issues. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.
The Blood Pressure feature and Pulse Measurement are included in the subscription.

- Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Account charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period concludes.
- Manage and cancel subscriptions in your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00029386:ios.description:
Tempty is an app dedicated to helping couples improve communication and intimacy in their relationships.
Tempty offers an exciting and fun way for partners to discover new sex ideas and explore their desires together.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
- Both partners download Tempty and connect with each other.
- Both partners answer the same questions with "Yes," "Maybe," or "No."
- If both partners answer "Yes" or "Maybe" to a question, it will be displayed as a match.
The matches are a list of sex ideas you both want to try. Any response of "No" by either partner will be hidden.
WHAT KIND OF QUESTIONS ARE AVAILABLE?
We offer a wide variety of questions that cover various interests and desires, so you're sure to find new and exciting sex ideas to explore together.
IS IT ANONYMOUS?
Yes, you don't need to provide any personal information to use the app. However, you have the option to create an account to save your answers if you uninstall and reinstall Tempty.
IS IT FREE?
Yes, everything in the app is completely free.

Explore the world around you in a whole new way with Geocaching Adventure Lab® outdoor scavenger hunts! Community-generated scavenger hunts let you uncover hidden gems, learn local trivia, discover landmarks, and everyday treasures through an interactive, outdoor, and contactless experience.

CalistX: Master Calisthenics Anywhere, Anytime!
Transform your body and unleash your inner strength with CalistX, the ultimate calisthenics workout app. Whether you're a beginner looking to learn the basics or an experienced athlete aiming to perfect your form, CalistX is your go-to platform for achieving your fitness goals.
What is CalistX?
CalistX is like Netflix for Calisthenics! Dive into a vast library of meticulously crafted calisthenics exercises, categorized for easy navigation. Our app is designed to help you:
・Learn New Exercises: Explore a wide range of calisthenics movements, from fundamental bodyweight exercises to advanced skills. Each exercise comes with detailed video tutorials.
・Workout with Trained Calisthenics Expert: Access exclusive workout playlists created by a calisthenics professional, ensuring you get expert guidance every step of the way.
・Transform Your Body: Take on our "28-Day Challenge" to sculpt your physique and build incredible strength. Stay motivated with a rewarding streak system—complete your daily lessons to maintain your progress, and restart anytime you need to!
Key Features:
・Extensive Video Library: Watch high-quality video tutorials for various calisthenics exercises under different categories.
・Expert-Curated Playlists: Follow professionally designed workout routines to maximize your results.
・28-Day Challenge: Embark on a guided 28-day program to build a stronger, more defined body.
・Streak System: Earn daily streaks for completing your challenge lessons and stay motivated.
・ Offline Access: Download your favorite lessons directly to your device and workout without an internet connection, perfect for the gym, park, garden, or home.
・Equipment-Free Options: Discover a wealth of lessons that require no special equipment, making home workouts incredibly convenient.
・Favorites List: Save your preferred workouts to easily access them again whenever you want.
CalistX is your all-in-one solution for mastering calisthenics. Download today and start your journey towards a stronger, fitter you!

bluejetty:00161112:ios.description:
The ALEX CROCKFORD App is more than a fitness platform - it’s your space to build a strong body, a balanced mind, and a confident life.
After years of working one-on-one with clients, Alex Crockford saw the need for something more than just workouts - a way to support the whole person, not just the physical aspect. That’s what makes this app special. It’s built from real experience, deep care, purpose, and a belief that movement, mindset, and wellbeing are all connected.
We believe that fitness and wellbeing aren’t about status, aesthetics, or perfection. They’re about showing up - through the good days and the tough ones - with kindness, consistency, and self-respect. We’re here to help you do that in a way that feels sustainable, empowering, and real.
Inside the app, you’ll find a growing library of home and gym workout programs, guided meditations, breathwork sessions, nutrition plans, lifestyle support, and so much more, with a global community that truly cares. Whether you’re looking to build muscle, burn fat, reduce stress, boost energy, or reconnect with yourself, there’s something here for you.
With millions of people in our community, we’re proud to offer a welcoming space for all levels and goals - physical, mental, and emotional. No gatekeeping. No intimidation. Just the tools, support, and inspiration to help you get started - or keep going.
Because when health and wellbeing feel simple, enjoyable, and accessible - that’s when the magic happens.
Let’s make showing up feel like second nature. Because when we consistently show up for ourselves, we can show up fully for the people we love, and for the world.

Encyclopedia by Farlex gives you free, instant access to more than 330,000 articles, over 77,000 audio pronunciations, and 24,000 images, all from the most trusted sources, including McGraw-Hill, Harper-Collins, Cambridge University Press, and more—all in one app!
Whether you're a student, professional, or just curious about the world, this free encyclopedia app can help you find clear, in-depth articles on vast amount of topics right on your iPhone or iPad. Search multiple authoritative encyclopedias and specialty dictionaries for entries on: 
Science 
History
Animals, plants, and the natural world 
Biographies of prominent figures
Countries
Technology
Art 
Business 
Music
Culture
Food
+ much more…
FEATURES:
* Search 330,000+ encyclopedia articles on any topic you can think of, all from top sources you won't find anywhere else.
* Learn by seeing: 24,000+ images, including vivid photos, diagrams, and illustrations.
* Save unlimited bookmarks to quickly access your favorite articles.
* Use native voice search to look up a word just by saying it. (With supported devices)
* See search suggestions as you type and always find what you're looking for.
* View your recent searches.
* Perform advanced searches, including "Starts with," "Ends with," "Contains," and "Wildcard."
* Adjust font size.
* Listen to 70,000+ audio pronunciations for both American and British speakers.
* Share your favorite articles via social networks, email, and text. (With supported devices)
User-friendly, comprehensive, and authoritative: Encyclopedia by Farlex is the perfect free app for students, professionals, and anyone curious about the world. This is NOT a preview or a trial version, and there is no "locked" content. Open the app on your iPhone or iPad and immediately access all content — no subscriptions required!
How do we do it?
TheFreeDictionary.com - Farlex apps have been downloaded tens of millions times across multiple platforms, with top ratings after hundreds of thousands of reviews. We work with the best publishers to bring together trusted content in the most comprehensive, authoritative dictionary apps on the market. Our flagship app is The Free Dictionary (TFD), powered by TheFreeDictionary.com. Find our other apps by searching "Dictionary by Farlex" in the App Store.

알림: 쇼핑혜택, 이벤트, 배송 정보 알림 시 사용

bluejetty:00044965:ios.description:
Connect with a City of Hope oncology expert directly and securely –– all from your mobile device. Through a scheduled visit, you can access your City of Hope physician with ease 
A cancer diagnosis can be scary. HopeVirtual from City of Hope is available to you as a City of Hope patient. 
HopeVirtual Highlights:
 One-on-one or multiway video to include your family members or caregivers in your visit
HopeVirtual wants to make sure you can connect with your City of Hope physician conveniently. You have a trusted partner in your cancer care to turn to for your cancer journey. During your scheduled visit, you can ask questions about your diagnosis, get help understanding treatment choices or get support and information to help prepare for your next visit. 
With just a few clicks, you will be connected with your expert focused on your type of cancer. You can choose to speak alone with a qualified physician, or you can enable multiway video so that your loved ones can participate in the conversation. 
About City of Hope: 
City of Hope is a leading research and treatment center for cancer, diabetes and other life-threatening diseases. Designated as a comprehensive cancer center, the highest recognition bestowed by the National Cancer Institute, City of Hope is also a founding member of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network, with research and treatment protocols that advance care throughout the nation. 
Our scientists work with doctors to treat both the physical and emotional needs of our patients. By attending to the individual, not just the illness, your life afterwards can be fuller and more rewarding. At City of Hope, we combine science with soul to make medical miracles every day.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

A cancer diagnosis can be scary. HopeVirtual from City of Hope is available to you as a City of Hope patient.  
 

HopeVirtual Highlights:

 One-on-one or multiway video to include your family members or caregivers in your visit

HopeVirtual wants to make sure you can connect with your  City of Hope physician conveniently.  You have a trusted partner in your cancer care to turn to for your cancer journey. During your scheduled visit, you can ask questions about your diagnosis, get help understanding treatment choices or get support and information to help prepare for your next visit. 

With just a few clicks, you will be connected with your expert focused on your type of cancer. You can choose to speak alone with a qualified physician, or you can enable multiway video so that your loved ones can participate in the conversation. 

About City of Hope: 

City of Hope is a leading research and treatment center for cancer, diabetes and other life-threatening diseases. Designated as a comprehensive cancer center, the highest recognition bestowed by the National Cancer Institute, City of Hope is also a founding member of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network, with research and treatment protocols that advance care throughout the nation. 

Our scientists work with doctors to treat both the physical and emotional needs of our patients. By attending to the individual, not just the illness, your life afterwards can be fuller and more rewarding. At City of Hope, we combine science with soul to make medical miracles every day.

If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit.  Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

UNE PRIÈRE POUR CHAQUE INSTANT
Commencez la journée avec une prière le matin, faites une pause spirituelle à midi ou méditez avant de dormir. YouPray propose des prières chrétiennes catholiques adaptées à tous les moments de la journée : prière du matin inspirée des laudes, Evangile lu et médité, complies, chapelet... Et, des prières pour des intentions particulières : famille, guérison, gratitude ou protection.
Des parcours et des enseignements pour grandir dans la foi, donner des clés pour vivre l’Evangile au quotidien et traverser les différents âges de la vie : enfants, étudiants, jeunes pros, mariés, célibataires, divorcés, veufs, retraités…
MIEUX COMPRENDRE LA BIBLE
Plongez dans la Parole de Dieu avec l’Evangile du jour lu et médité, suivez le podcast Il était une fois la Bible ou simplement écoutez le Nouveau Testament en version audio. Les Écritures n’auront bientôt plus de secrets pour vous !

VIVEZ LE CARÊME AUTREMENT
Préparez votre cœur pour Pâques avec chaque année un parcours spirituel spécialement conçu pour le carême. Chaque jour, recevez une prière, une méditation, un témoignage ou une lecture biblique pour avancer dans votre chemin de foi.
PRIÈRE EN FAMILLE 
Découvrez le Coin des enfants avec les histoires du soir, la vie des saints, et des parcours dédiés pour les grands moments liturgiques.
PRIÈRES POUR TOUTES LES ETAPES DE LA VIE 
Enfants, étudiants, jeunes pros, mariés, célibataires, divorcés, veufs… découvrez pour chacun des parcours, des méditations et des accompagnements adaptés.
PLAYLISTS
Découvrez des playlists avec vos artistes chrétiens préférés pour accompagner vos moments de prières, de louange ouet de méditation.
Comment ça marche ?
- Créez votre compte : Téléchargez l'application et inscrivez-vous gratuitement.
- Choisissez votre moment de prière ou le sujet qui vous intéresse
- Écoutez et méditez : Laissez-vous guider par des prières et méditations audio.
Témoignages de nos utilisateurs : 
"Grâce à YouPray, j'ai enfin réussi à prier tous les jours." - Sophie 
 "Les méditations m'aident à rester serein dans les moments de stress." - Thomas 
 "J'utilise YouPray chaque matin pour commencer ma journée avec Dieu. Un vrai soutien !" - Pierre 
 "Les prières sont inspirantes et m'aident à rester connectée à ma foi, même dans les périodes difficiles." - Claire
Téléchargez YouPray dès maintenant pour nourrir votre foi, vivre une prière quotidienne simple et profonde, et garder Dieu au cœur de votre vie.
Au sein de l’application, YouPray propose une offre d'abonnement mensuel à 6,99€/mois et annuel à 59,99€/an (soit 4,99€/mois)

Crew lets you experience the difference between following a budget and leading a budget. Instead of an app tell
bluejetty:00147398:ios.description:
"Simply put: there is no better way to manage your personal finances than what Crew has built." -Spencer (Crew user since 2025)
Crew lets you experience the difference between following a budget and leading a budget. Instead of an app telling you what to do with your money, you tell the app what to do — and it keeps doing what it’s supposed to even on nights, weekends, holidays, or when your blood sugar is low. 
With Crew you can:
- organize your money into pockets
- link pockets to your cards for mindful, intentional spending
- use Autopilot to program your budget
- add your partner and children to your financial plans
Most budgeting apps stand on the sidelines and tell you what you already spent. Crew is a high-yield checking account with budgeting features built in — It can tell you what you're spending and saving in real time, and even decline purchases when you're going over budget. Crew is strong enough to save real money but easy enough to use day-after-day.
Crew is perfect for:
- knowing what amount is safe to spend
- helping you aggressively pay down debt or save for goals
- having a digital envelope budget
- paying yourself first automatically
- giving every dollar a job
It takes most people less than 5 minutes to open an account and — unlike some personal finance and envelope budgeting apps — Crew has no required set-up fees, subscriptions, or minimums.
Still thinking? Here's what others have to say about using Crew to manage their banking and personal finances:
"They have the best and coolest features of any banking app that I've seen so far, and I've tried a few. Everything works super well and you can do SO MANY cool and useful things." - Jackson
“After switching to Crew, I realized I don’t really need a traditional budgeting app. My paycheck goes into Crew and everything just happens automatically. It’s one of those ‘set it and forget it’ setups that actually works.” -Tamil
"Financial stress has been a big part of my life and banking through Crew with Autopilot setting aside money for bills, I feel the stress lifting away." -Kristen
"After hiding monthly bills money from our view, our income-to-outgoing last month was over $1,500, which is honestly unheard of for us. We're having amazing results!" -Jesika
Still reading? Aren't you precocious! If you're this into the details of a banking app, you're definitely Crew material. Give it a try!

Deposit accounts and the Crew Mastercard Debit Card are provided by Bangor Savings Bank, Member FDIC. 
The Crew Mastercard Credit Card is issued by Celtic Bank.

bluejetty:00044470:ios.description:
ISN Home Inspection Software for Professional Home Inspectors
ISN Home Inspection Software is a powerful inspection app designed to help home inspectors manage their day, write detailed inspection reports, and run their business more efficiently from anywhere.
Built specifically for professional home inspectors, ISN combines scheduling, mobile report writing, client communication, and inspection management tools into one streamlined platform. Whether you’re in the field or at the office, ISN keeps your inspection workflow organized and productive.
Manage Your Day with Smarter Scheduling
Stay on top of your inspection schedule with tools built for busy inspectors:
• Offline inspection support - no connection needed
• Biometric access allows you to bypass the log in
• View upcoming inspections in agenda or calendar format
• Manage appointments and property details, getting all the information you need in the field at your finger tips.
• Track clients and agents in one place
• Send emails, log payments, add notes, upload reports, and more.
ISN helps you plan your day, reduce missed appointments, and keep your inspection business running smoothly.
Powerful Inspection Report Writing Tools
Write professional inspection reports directly from your phone or tablet with built-in report writing functionality.
• Work offline without losing progress.
• Create detailed inspection reports on-site
• Add notes, findings, and property information in real time - instantly syncing in the cloud.
• Take & Annotate photo's with our robust image editor.
• Record and upload videos.
• Breadcrumbs help you navigate your inspection quickly and efficiently.
• Edit and update reports from anywhere.
• Sync reports instantly across devices - no manual sync required.
• Progress tracking and section completion make it easy to see what still needs to be done.
• Color flags let you assign tasks to specific inspectors - great for multi-inspector jobs.
• Easily save comments you write in the field back to your template or comment library.
ISN’s report writing tools are designed to help inspectors complete reports faster, improve accuracy, and deliver high-quality documentation to clients.
From scheduling to final report delivery, ISN simplifies inspection management so you can focus on delivering exceptional service.
Built for Growing Inspection Businesses
Whether you're a solo inspector or managing a multi-inspector company, ISN provides scalable tools that grow with your business. Centralize scheduling, reporting, and communication in one reliable inspection app.
Thousands of inspectors rely on ISN to streamline operations, improve workflow efficiency, and manage their day with confidence.
The ISN mobile app requires an active ISN account. https://get.inspectionsupport.com/app/freetrial1/

bluejetty:00072455:ios.name: WordCraft - Solo Word Games
bluejetty:00072455:ios.summary: Unleash your inner word wizard with WordCraft - Solo Word Games! Craving a Scrabble fix? Look no further. WordCraft offers the classic Scrabble experience you love, plus a whole lot more. Build and play ANY Scrabble-like crossword game, fro
bluejetty:00072455:ios.description:
Unleash your inner word wizard with WordCraft - Solo Word Games! Craving a Scrabble fix? Look no further. WordCraft offers the classic Scrabble experience you love, plus a whole lot more. Build and play ANY Scrabble-like crossword game, from traditional Scrabble and Words With Friends to Wordfeud and Word Chums, all in one app. Play, Learn, and Expand Your Vocabulary! 
Unique features:
* Instantly view the definition of the word you form, as well as any word played by the AI (you may also swipe a word to see its definition).
* Play words in one- or two-languages (e.g., English + Spanish, French + German, and more).
* Enjoy Pass-and-Play up to 4 players. Bluffing with fake words and challenging a play in the physical game mode. Offline pass and play with the physical mode can be used to replace a physical game set.
* Access both classic scrabble and the alternative duplicate scrabble.
* Relaxing games with unlimited time or competitive timed games. 
Whether you’re honing your skills with unlimited offline play against a challenging AI or engaging friends in pass-and-play mode, WordCraft offers endless fun. Test your abilities across 7 levels of AI difficulty, from beginner to word master. Utilize the replay feature to analyze your games, gain valuable insights, and enhance your Scrabble prowess.
WordCraft isn’t just about playing—it’s also about learning. The app automatically displays definitions for any word you form or words played by the AI, making it easy to discover new terms and expand your vocabulary. For those interested in language learning, WordCraft supports dual-language gameplay (e.g., English + Spanish, French + German), offering a fun and immersive way to pick up a new language.
Take on daily and unlimited bingo challenges for an extra boost of fun. Stuck on a difficult move? Use the built-in Guru feature for helpful suggestions, which show all possible moves based on the dictionary or a curated list of common words. 
Customize your game with different board sizes (9x9, 11x11, 13x13, and 15x15) and classic bonus squares (2L, 3L, 4L, DW, TW). Tailor the
experience to perfectly match your favorite Scrabble-style game.
Key Features for Scrabble Lovers:
* Build Your Dream Board: Design ANY Scrabble-style board in minutes with our intuitive UI.
* Multilingual support: Play games in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, and some combinations of two languages (e.g. English+Spanish, French+German, etc).
* Offline Scrabble Anytime: Play solo against the AI or with friends via pass-and-play.
* Classic & Duplicate Modes: Enjoy traditional Scrabble gameplay or try the duplicate mode for a fresh challenge.
* Boost Your Vocabulary: Built-in word definitions help you learn new words as you play.
* Guru Guidance: Get expert hints whenever you need it.
* Bingo Challenges: Complete daily and unlimited bingo challenges for extra rewards.
* Multiple Board Sizes & Bonus Squares.
Download WordCraft today and experience the ultimate Scrabble companion! Play your way, offline, anytime. Word lists are based on Wiktionary, and inspired by TWL (Scrabble US), SOWPODS (Scrabble UK), and ENABLE (Words With Friends).

bluejetty:00184568:ios.description:
Watch any web video or camera-roll video on your Roku and enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for Roku you can browse the web and stream any web video or online TV show on your Roku. Mp4, m3u8, hls livestreams, video over https and of course Full HD are supported.
Just open Video & TV Cast, navigate to a website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
* SUPPORTED Roku Players: Roku TV, Roku Streaming Stick, Roku Express, Roku Premiere, Roku Ultra, Roku 2, Roku 3, Roku 4, Roku HD (2500), Roku LT (2400+2450) Player, Telstra TV, NOW TV Stick & Box. Please make sure that firmware 5.1 or later is installed.
* NOT SUPPORTED Roku Players: Roku classic models (N1000, N1050, N1100, N1101), Roku 2000, 2050, 2100, Sky Ticket (WOW TV).
* COMPATIBILITY: Please test your favorite videos with the free app edition before upgrading! Compatibility may depend on your Roku device and firmware.
* iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. 
* If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible.
>>> UPGRADE FEATURES (available as in-app purchases)
* Premium Edition: Unlocks all of the features listed here. Also future features are included, so you do not have to pay for them when they are released in an updated app version. 
* Remote Playbar: Use the Playbar for advanced video control while browsing, including video scrubbing, forward, rewind, play, pause, stop.
* Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. 
* Ad-Blocker: Blocks ads & popups on most websites and removes the sponsoring ads from the app. You can update and enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
>>> USER FEEDBACKS

bluejetty:00062580:ios.description:
Pony Unicorn Coloring Book is an addictive coloring entertainment for all ages! Color easy and without stress inside the lines! 
This simple and cute drawing app will help you to calm down and to improve your mood. Just download it now and enjoy a lot of amazing coloring pages!
• HOW TO PLAY
 There are 2 main modes you can use to colorise images:
1. With finger drawing mode, you can easily color the pages within the lines with your finger:
 - for this, select any coloring page you want and then select the "pen" tool from the top menu
 - then select the color you like from the bottom menu and then draw with your finger on the selected image
2. In 1-touch color mode, you can easily color image segments with just 1 touch:
 - to do this, select the "tube" tool from the top menu and then the color you like from the bottom menu.
 - after that, just tap anywhere on the coloring page and the corresponding image part will be filled with the selected color
3. When you finish your coloring page, feel free to share it with your friends and family on all available social networks by pressing the "photo" button.
4. If you want to clear the coloring page and start over, use the "reset" button to do so.
• Major Features:
- Huge collections of the unique coloring pages, designed specially for this app only
- Simple an easy freehand drawing mode which never comes over the borders
- Color fill mode just to to select and fill any part with desired color
- Erase mode for fine erasing or complete coloring reset
- Save, share and print your works on any connected devices
- Slim and user friendly interface
- Nice relaxing background music, or use your own background music if you like
- Universal app which works on iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad
• Your benefits:
- Relax and anti-stress effect
- Improves hand-eye coordination
- Helps to develop creativity
*******************************
• HOWTO RESTORE PURCHASES
If for whatever reason you accidentally get the app locked, you can easily restore in-app purchase back without paying again! To do this please follow these simple steps:
1. Start the app
2. In the main menu press setting button and then select "restore purchases" menu
3. Provide your iTunes login/password if required
4. Done :)
*******************************

bluejetty:00161127:ios.name: Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi
bluejetty:00161127:ios.summary: Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi’s Patient Portal app represents part of our commitment to provide you with secure, quick and easy access to the right level of care when you need it. This app is free to install and use as well as safe and secure.
bluejetty:00161127:ios.description:
Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi’s Patient Portal app represents part of our commitment to provide you with secure, quick and easy access to the right level of care when you need it. This app is free to install and use as well as safe and secure. The installation and sign-up process is simple. 
Register on our patient portal app using your activation code and immediately start scheduling appointments with our doctors and gain access to all of our digital healthcare features. 
Once you’ve completed your first appointment, you would be able to see a comprehensive overview of your medical information in the Patient Portal app. 
Message your doctor, view your medical test results and records in addition to the ability to manage your medication refills, securely and safely through the Patient Portal app. 
Features: 
• Schedule and track appointments 
• View your health history and medication 
• Message your doctor with non-urgent clinical questions or concerns, and receive a reply directly through the app 
• View your latest test results 
• Request prescription refills and be informed when they are ready for pick-up at the hospital pharmacy 
• Receive helpful reminders 
• Connect your account to Apple Health to pull health-related data from your personal device right into the CCAD patient portal app 
Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi will continue to add regular updates to the Patient Portal app, aiming to build one of the most interactive and innovative services available in the UAE. 
To provide suggestions or feedback on the app, please get in touch at 800 8 2223 (+971 2 659 0200 from outside the UAE) or send an email to info@clevelandclinicabudhabi.ae. 
يمثل تطبيق بوابة المراجع من كليفلاند كلينك أبوظبي جزءاً من التزامنا تجاهك للحصول على إمكانية الوصول الآمن والسريع والسهل إلى المستوى المناسب من الرعاية عند الحاجة إليها. يمكن تحميل تطبيق بوابة المراجع مجاناً وهو آمن وسهل الاستخدام، حيث تتسم عملية التسجيل وتحميل التطبيق بالسهولة. 
قم بتحميل التطبيق للبدء فوراً في طلب المواعيد والاستفادة من نموذج الرعاية الخاص بكليفلاند كلينك أبوظبي. 
بمجرد الانتهاء من أول موعد لك في كليفلاند كلينك أبوظبي، سيزودك تطبيق بوابة المراجع بلمحة عامة عن معلوماتك الطبية. 
بوسعك مراسلة طبيبك، واستعراض فحوصاتك الطبية وسجلاتك بالإضافة إلى القدرة على إدارة الوصفات الطبية الخاصة بك بأمان من خلال تطبيق بوابة المراجع. 
الخصائص: 
• حجز ومتابعة المواعيد 
• الاطلاع على التاريخ الطبي والدوائي 
• مراسلة طبيبك بشأن الأمور الطبية غير العاجلة والحصول على الرد من خلال التطبيق
• الاطلاع على أحدث نتائج الفحوصات 
• طلب تجديد الوصفات الطبية وإعلامك بأوقات الاستلام من صيدلية المستشفى 
• تلقي ارشادات مفيدة 
• قم بربط حسابك بتطبيق  Apple Health لنقل البيانات الصحية من جهازك الشخصي إلى حسابك في تطبيق بوابة المراجع من كليفلاند كلينك أبوظبي.
ستواصل كليفلاند كلينك أبوظبي إضافة تحديثات منتظمة إلى تطبيق بوابة المراجع، بهدف تقديم واحدة من أكثر الخدمات التفاعلية والمبتكرة المتاحة في دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. لتقديم الاقتراحات أو التعليقات على التطبيق، يرجى الاتصال بالرقم 2223-8-800 (أو 0200-659-2-971+ من خارج دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة) أو إرسال رسالة إلكترونية إلى العنوان info@clevelandclinicabudhabi.ae.

bluejetty:00069450:ios.description:
The game of eXtra Keno is like classic keno, with a twist. The twist is that you earn extra balls for each winning ball that is called. That means, if a number comes up and it rewards you a payout, or a higher payout, then you get a free eXtra ball for it. You can then use those extra balls at the end of a winning game, after the normal twenty balls have already come up. You can choose to have 5, 10, or 20 more balls be called on that game. In addition to the free eXtra Balls you earn, you can also purchase eXtra balls via in-app purchase.
Every Keno player has likely uttered the same words at the end of the game "Oh, I only needed one more... I wish I could get a few eXtra balls" Well, now you can with eXtra Keno.
Features:
• Casino Quality
• eXtra Balls
• Win-O-Meter
• Quick Pick (Random Numbers)
• Saves Credits Between Sessions
• Variable Speeds
• Bet up to 10,000,000 Credits per Game
• … OH, AND IT'S FREE!
We give you FREE credits to play with every time you run out and you also have the option to get even more through in-app purchase. 
If you like other casino games like poker, texas hold 'em, slot machines, roulette, or black jack, then you'll want to add this exciting Keno game to your collection!

bluejetty:00071673:ios.description:
About Game
-------------
Word Connect Letter Master, is the best word line connect Game for word game lovers.
In this Word game, you need to connect word by line.
When the word matches with your connected line, the word will be added to the word box.
You also find extra words from the given puzzle so you will earn coins from that words.
Each level complete you get extra coins.
Spinner was added to the game so you will get an extra coin for hints.
Free Game.
Word Connect
---------------
More than 1500 episodes added to this game.
All Episodes contain 12 Levels.
Each level contains approx 5 words with 3 extra words.
So at the end of this game, you will learn new 1,50,000+ words appropriately.
Word Cross/Crossword 
-----------------------
More than 200 levels.
Each level has 5 to 8 words.
By swiping on letters draw a line.
Word/Text Battle
-----------------
Now, You can play with AI.
You Need to start a word with the end of your opponent's completed words.
Get target first will win!!!
Use Coins to better words.
Typing Master Mini Game
-------------------------
Type the word that comes from the top of the screen.
As fast as you type you will get more coins.
Word Search Puzzle
--------------------
More than 8 different categories.
Each one contains 25 dynamic levels.
Word Pearls
------------
Word Pearls is a combination of the word connect and word search game.
More than 500 levels.
All levels are unique.
Each level is related to the topic to solve the puzzle.
If you love word games like crossword, word search, and word cross then you are at the right place.
If you getting stuck use a hint.
How to Play ?
-------------
By swiping on letters draw a line.
There is a hint functionality so if you getting stuck in guessing so you can use it.
The spinner will help you to get more coins.
Who can play ?
---------------
Anybody can play this game.No age limit to play game.
Game Features
---------------
Stunning Graphics with Classic Design.
Interactive User Interface.
Smooth sound effects and music quality.
Tablet devices support.
1,50,000+ Words.
Extra words reward.
Spinner functionality for extra coin collection.
Improve Vocabulary skills.
Hint to complete your word.
Earn hint functionality.
Tap or swipe words for choosing letters.
Also works offline.
Reset functionality to revision.
Important Point
----------------
Please do not try random combinations just think and try you will get your word.
If you get stuck you can use a hint and save hangman.
Benefits
--------
Improve Vocabulary skills.
Learn new combinations from single words.
Improve IQ.

bluejetty:00078988:android.description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our FREE and easy-to-use app, featuring the soulful recitation of the Holy Quran by Sheikh Mohamed Al-Minshawi. This user-friendly app is designed for seamless navigation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the divine wisdom of the Quran at your convenience and without the need for an internet connection.

✅ Offline Listening : Access the entire Quran offline. Enjoy Sheikh Fares Abbad recitations without needing an internet connection, ensuring your spiritual journey is uninterrupted. 
✅ HD Quality Audio : Enjoy the highest quality MP3 audio that brings each verse of the Quran to life with clarity and precision. 
✅ Listen and Read Simultaneously : Experience a multi-sensory engagement with the Quran. Listen to Sheikh Mohamed Al-Minshawi’s recitation while reading the Arabic text or translation, enhancing understanding and retention. 
✅ Advanced Search Functionality : Quickly locate specific verses or surahs with a few taps, making your Quran study more focused and efficient. 
✅ Shuffle Play : Mix up your daily Quran listening with our shuffle feature, which randomly plays different surahs, offering a refreshing way to engage with the Quran. 
✅ Background Play : Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption. 
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights : Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.
Our app is designed to be straightforward and accessible for everyone, from beginners to those who regularly recite the Quran. 
Share the beauty of Sheikh Mohamed Al-Minshawi’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.

Download now and immerse yourself in the soothing recitation of the Quran, available anytime, right at your fingertips !

• Browse the latest gear from the Official INDYCAR Shop
• Set push notifications for breaking news and key INDYCAR updates
Features and content within the INDYCAR App are subject to change.

Design and Build Your Ultimate City Skyline in Designer City 2

bluejetty:00019039:ios.description:
Design and Build Your Ultimate City Skyline in Designer City 2
Tired of waiting in other city games? In this free offline city building simulator there are no timers or energy bars - you control the pace. Design and build your dream town, evolve it into a city, and expand into a massive metropolis with a unique city skyline.
BUILD YOUR DREAM CITY
Construct houses, apartments and skyscrapers to attract residents. Zone commercial and industrial areas to provide jobs. Add parks, schools, hospitals, police and fire stations to keep citizens safe, happy and productive.
CREATE YOUR SKYLINE
Design a city skyline filled with world landmarks, monuments and over 2,000 unique buildings. Shape the land by raising mountains, carving rivers, or creating coastlines. Every city is unique, every skyline different.
CITY MANAGEMENT & STRATEGY
This is more than just a casual builder—it’s a city tycoon simulator. Balance jobs and housing, manage resources, control pollution, and deploy services efficiently. Build complex transportation systems with roads, highways, railways and subways to keep traffic flowing.
EXPAND BEYOND THE CITY
Boost your economy with airports, seaports and farms. Explore military and space programs to add extra depth to your growing city empire.
PLAY OFFLINE OR ONLINE
Designer City 2 is completely free to play and works offline. No internet connection needed, no energy bars, no timers. Play your way, whenever you want.
THE ULTIMATE CITY BUILDER
If you love city building games, town builders, city simulators, tycoon games or skyline design, Designer City 2 gives you endless freedom. Build again and again on new landscapes with the city reset feature.
Download today and start your city building adventure. Free, offline and without limits, this is the city skyline game you’ve been waiting for.

bluejetty:00175052:ios.description:
Everything you need to grow your photography business, in one spot.
Unscripted is the all-in-one app built to help photographers feel more confident behind the camera and more in control of the business around it.
Find inspiration from 40,000+ poses and prompts. Manage clients, contracts, invoices, questionnaires, automated emails and shoot details. Then deliver beautiful native client galleries from the same connected platform, without piecing together a different tool for every part of the job.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO RUN YOUR PHOTOGRAPHY BUSINESS
Keep the work around every shoot organised, from booking to delivery.
• Manage clients and session details
• Send photography contracts for e-signature
• Create and track invoices
• Send questionnaires, guides and automated emails
• Keep important documents and communication together
• Access your business from mobile and web
NATIVE CLIENT GALLERIES
Deliver photos from the same platform you use to manage the booking, contract and invoice.
Create and share native client galleries through Unscripted. On the web platform, eligible business plans also include additional gallery features such as design customisation to suit your branding, white labelling, download limits and more.
Gallery features are not included with posing-only access.
40,000+ POSES AND PROMPTS
Never run out of ideas halfway through a session.
Explore more than 40,000 posing ideas and prompts for families, couples, weddings, newborns, portraits and more. Save your favourites before a shoot and keep inspiration close when you need it on location.
Use every pose as a starting point, then adapt it to the people in front of you.
PLAN EVERY SHOOT WITH MORE CONFIDENCE
Prepare before you arrive and stay organised while you work with practical tools including:
• Sun tracking and golden-hour times
• Saved pose collections
• Camera settings guidance
• Session checklists and timelines
• Client information available on the go
BUILT FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
Unscripted was created for photographers who want to spend less time juggling admin and more time doing the work they love.
Whether you are booking your first client or growing a full-time photography business, Unscripted brings your business tools, creative inspiration and client experience together in one place.
Download Unscripted and start building the photography business you have been dreaming about.
Feature availability varies by plan.
Read the terms and conditions here: https://www.unscriptedposingapp.com/terms 
Read the privacy policy here: https://www.unscriptedposingapp.com/privacy-policy

•Seamless Access – Log in using your golfersjournal.com credentials—no extra apps or steps.
This isn’t a forum. It’s not a social feed. It’s a thoughtfully built extension of The Golfer’s Journal—crafted to reflect our values, our readers, and the way we believe community should feel.
Access is exclusive to active subscribers.

Welcome to Show Your Score, the ultimate graphic generator for football and basketball, designed to revolutionize the way you celebrate and share your sports moments. Player lists
Jersey layouts on the pitch or court

Save Time, Amplify Your Sports Message

Discover how “Show Your Score” can transform your sports media. Download the app today and start creating graphics that captivate fans and elevate your team’s presence. Perfect for clubs, supporters, and professional designers.
Download Show Your Score now and start creating match graphics and lineups that make every football and basketball game unforgettable!

Get ready to embark on a captivating musical adventure with Melody Run! Jump into the world of rhythmic melodies and test your skills in this thrilling rhythm game. Immerse yourself in hand-crafted levels where you must step on the correct notes of well-known song melodies. ◈ Share your custom songs with others using a special code
◈ Import and play any MIDI file for a personalized experience
◈ Multiple game modes to suit your style:
 ◈ Third-person view: Experience the melodies from a wider perspective
 ◈ Piano tiles: Tap on the tiles to stay in rhythm with the music

◈ Cat mode: Replace instrument sounds with adorable cat sounds and play as a cat character for added fun
◈ 6 different themes to explore:

bluejetty:00186345:ios.name: Parathyroid Surgery Guide
bluejetty:00186345:ios.summary:
Description:
Going to have parathyroid surgery? This free app will guide you through every aspect of your parathyroid operation. Produced by the Norman Parathyroid Center for their patients, but also designed to benefit all persons having p
bluejetty:00186345:ios.description:
Description:
Going to have parathyroid surgery? This free app will guide you through every aspect of your parathyroid operation. Produced by the Norman Parathyroid Center for their patients, but also designed to benefit all persons having parathyroid surgery at any hospital. From the basics on what to wear and what to bring to the hospital, to when you can exercise and go back to work. Contains advice on vitamin D, calcium, and osteoporosis medications after surgery among dozens of other topics. Potential surgery problems are covered so you understand what is normal and what is not. Made by the most experienced parathyroid surgeons in the world; with over 35,000 parathyroid operations performed, these doctors have seen every possible situation and have put that knowledge into an easy to use format.
Download the app and make your parathyroid operation the best experience it can be! And make sure the people going with you to the hospital download the app too so they know what is going on.
 Features:
Before Your Operation - How to prepare for the operation including buying your calcium pills.
Day of Your Operation - What to bring, what to wear and other basics. Overview of who you will meet and how your day will proceed.
After Your Operation - What to expect on every topic, from incision pain, taking calcium pills, followup with your doctors and when you can expect to be a new person!
Frequently Asked Questions - Tons of questions we have been asked while performing over 3,700 parathyroid operations per year.
Video Testimonial Producer - Make a video testimonial to help teach other patients about parathyroid disease and how it has affected your life before and after your operation.
Search Tool - Easy access to the hundreds of topics covered in this app.
Arrival Time and Location - Personalized for Norman Parathyroid Center (NPC) patients with the correct appointment time and map. Non-functional if using as Guest.
Family and Friends - People going with you should download app to understand what is happening, and what they should bring with them.
About the Parathyroid Center - History and significance of the Parathyroid Institute in Tampa and how it has impacted countless lives like yours.
Hotel Reservations - Having surgery in Tampa? -- Connect with our partner hotels.
Notifications - Patients having surgery at NPC will receive 5 reminders to help organize their operation. Non-functional if using as Guest. 
Disclaimer:
This app does not provide medical advice, nor provide for the diagnosis or treatment of disease. Always seek the advice of your physician or other healthcare provider for any issues, questions, or concerns you may have about your health, surgery, or after surgery complications. Some information is written specifically for patients undergoing surgery at the Norman Parathyroid Center and therefore will be different for those having surgery at another institution. Some information may not apply to you if you are having surgery at another institution, and may be in conflict with advice or information given to you by your doctors. Always follow the advice of YOUR doctors over the information contained within this app. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking medical care/assistance because of something you have read on the parathyroid.com website or from using this app or any of the apps associated with the Norman Parathyroid Center or Calcium Science, LLC.

bluejetty:00063115:ios.description:
tChess Pro is the high-quality, critically acclaimed chess game with the richest features for the iPhone, iPod touch, and iPad. It's perfect for every player:
Beginners:
Not everybody is a chess master! Most chess games are too strong or just make random mistakes at easier levels. tChess Pro has unique algorithms to simulate human opponents.
Experts:
tChess Pro has a top-tier chess engine. (Over 380 ELO points stronger than Caissa Chess.)
Enthusiasts:
tChess Pro's Analysis Mode is like having a chess master in your pocket. You can get the engine's "expert opinion" about any game or position in real-time: which side is winning, and the best sequence of moves. Just like a professional desktop chess package.
More key features:
- Perfect for 1- or 2-player games
- Strong computer opponent
- Play against any ELO rating from 500 to 2500
- Integrated "Learn Chess" e-book app (Apple Staff Favorite!)
- Opening Library feature lets you explore chess opening theory as you play
- PGN Database feature lets you download and view PGN files
- Support for 3-stage time controls with Fischer increments
- Position Editor to enter positions from books, newspapers, etc.
- Save and load games; export them in standard PGN format
- Use the Profile feature to play rated games against the computer and track your progress
tChess Pro is developed by Tom Kerrigan, author of the TSCP and Stobor chess engines.

Authenticator App helps you keep your online accounts safe by giving you secure two-factor authentication codes for all your accounts.
Key Features of the Authenticator App:
- Secure & Private Encryption
Your data is always encrypted, even in iCloud. Only you have access to your two-factor authentication data.
- Encrypted Backup
Create an encrypted backup of your codes to ensure seamless recovery in case you lose or upgrade your device.
- Automatic Synchronization Across Apple Devices
Enjoy real-time synchronization of your accounts across all your Apple devices, including iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
- Groups
Organize your accounts into groups for a cleaner setup. Share your groups with others and control access with flexible permissions.
- Quick Access with Widget
Access your 2FA codes instantly from the Home Screen with the Authenticator Widget, providing faster authentication.
- Offline Two-Factor Authentication
Generate secure codes even when your device is offline or in airplane mode. Your accounts remain protected no matter your connection status.
- Multi Import
Easily import accounts and 2FA codes from other authenticators like Google Authenticator, password managers, and files.
- Native Apple Experience
Enjoy a seamless experience on all Apple devices, with features like dark mode, intuitive gestures, and automatic data sync.
- All Popular Accounts
Authenticator App supports major platforms like Microsoft, Google, Facebook, Amazon, Instagram, Coinbase, Roblox, and thousands more. It’s the perfect solution whether you’re looking for an Authenticator App for Microsoft, an Authenticator App for Facebook, or an Authentication App for Instagram.

bluejetty:00177720:ios.description:
SoundNote offers AI-powered transcription features that easily generate meeting minutes, class notes, interview summaries, and paragraph summaries. It allows you to quickly capture important information, save time, and enhance work efficiency. The AI-driven transcription and summarization features significantly reduce work time and provide a smarter, more productive work environment.
Supporting MP3, WAV, and M4A formats, SoundNote is a high-quality voice recorder with speech-to-text conversion and AI noise reduction capabilities. It's the perfect solution for anyone needing to manage voice memos, including business professionals, reporters, tutors, audio experts, sound engineers, and students.
With excellent playback control and audio editing features, SoundNote makes it easy to edit and modify recorded files for greater efficiency.
It supports Apple Watch and is available on both iPhone and iPad.
■ Main Features
· AI-powered meeting minutes, lecture notes, interview summaries, and general summarization
· AI noise reduction
· Speech-to-text transcription
· Live Activities (Dynamic Island), Now Playing
· Direct recording in MP3, WAV, and M4A formats
· High-quality audio recording
· Unlimited recording time
· Background recording
· Wave display for recording status
· Various audio quality options (11,025KHz, 22,050KHz, 44,100KHz, 48,000KHz)
· Mono/stereo recording
· Playable on various media
· Resume recording after phone call pause (up to 3 minutes)
· Add descriptions to recordings
· Easy and fast to use
· Display file size
· Safe stop for low battery or storage space
· Bluetooth support
· Music library import function
· File sorting
· Voice-to-text transcription
■ AI-powered
· Meeting minutes, lecture notes, interview summaries, and general summarization
· Noise reduction
· Speech-to-text transcription
■ Powerful File Sharing & Management
· Transfer files via iTunes, Email, AirDrop, or Wi-Fi
· File sharing with other apps (“Open in”)
■ Folder Management
· Create, edit, delete, and organize folders efficiently
■ Playback Control
· Repeat, slow, or fast play; adjust playback speed (0.1x ~ Play)
■ Trim & Cut Audio
· Trim and cut recordings as needed (MP3, WAV, M4A formats)
■ Audio Visualization
· Visualize recordings to identify sections easily
■ Sound Tags
· Add tags to specific locations for instant playback
■ File Combination
· Combine multiple audio files into one, creating a custom sequence
■ PREMIUM Subscription
· Payment will be charged to your Apple ID upon confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal charges occur within 24 hours of the period's end. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store account settings.
Subscription Options:
· Monthly Subscription: Auto-renew with 3-day free trial, unlocks all features / AD-Free
· Yearly Subscription: Auto-renew with 3-day free trial, unlocks all features / AD-Free

bluejetty:00033279:ios.summary:
Trusted by over 1,300,000 lifters. 300M+ workouts logged. 4.8 stars.
Boostcamp is a free workout tracker and gym logger with 11,000+ programs and an AI coach that builds a custom plan from your goal, schedule, and equipment. Log every set.
bluejetty:00033279:ios.description:
Trusted by over 1,300,000 lifters. 300M+ workouts logged. 4.8 stars.
Boostcamp is a free workout tracker and gym logger with 11,000+ programs and an AI coach that builds a custom plan from your goal, schedule, and equipment. Log every set. Run nSuns, GZCLP, 5/3/1, Reddit PPL, PHUL, PHAT, or 130+ coach programs. No spreadsheet.
Garage Gym Reviews named Boostcamp the Best Workout App Overall in 2026.
"I primarily train for strength and hypertrophy, and Boostcamp is the best app I’ve ever used. I love all the data it provides, and there are so many great programs to choose from within the workout library." – Matt Dustin, CSCS, PN1-NC, Garage Gym Reviews
Featured in Fortune’s 2026 trainer-approved Boostcamp review.
"Boostcamp has all the features of Strong and Hevy, but what puts Boostcamp decidedly #1 is that it features a library of programs from some of the most recognizable figures in fitness." – Alex Bromley, Professional Strongman
"Boostcamp puts all of Reddit's best free workouts in one slick app...give Boostcamp a try." – Lifehacker
WHAT YOU GET
• Workout Tracker – Log sets, reps, and weight with RPE, RIR, and e1RM. Auto-progression sets your next weights. Rest timer, plate calculator, supersets, drop sets, warmup templates, form videos, and mid-set exercise swaps that keep your numbers. PRs flag in-session. Weekly Sunday reports and year-end Wrapped. Offline. Live Activities put your set and rest timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Syncs bodyweight with Apple Health.
• AI Coach – Short questionnaire, then a customized multi-week program you log in the same tracker. Or pick a named coach program and start today. Fork any program, or build your own with no cap.
• 11,000+ Programs – 130+ coach-designed plans with progressions, periodization, and deloads, plus a huge community library. Filter by goal, level, and days per week. The library is free. No ads.
• Analytics – Volume, muscle-group engagement, PRs, and training history. Pro adds Strength Score (0–100 across the big lifts) and a per-muscle volume heatmap.
POPULAR PROGRAMS
nSuns 5/3/1, GZCLP, 5/3/1 BBB, 5/3/1 for Beginners, Building the Monolith, Candito 6 Week, TSA, Bullmastiff, Greyskull LP, PHUL, PHAT, Reddit PPL, KONG, MASS IMPACT, Jacked and Tan 2.0, Strong Curves, Alberto Nuñez Upper Lower, Eric Helms Intermediate Bodybuilding, Greg Nuckols Beginner, Reddit Bodyweight Fitness RR, and thousands more.
COACHES
Dr. Eric Helms, Alex Bromley, Cody Lefever (GZCL), Geoffrey Verity Schofield, Alberto Nuñez, Bryce Lewis, Greg Nuckols, Jonnie Candito, Bald Omni-Man, Natural Hypertrophy, Basement Bodybuilding, Brandon Campbell (PHUL), Dr. Swole, Matt Vena, Menno Henselmans, Justina Ercole, Tiffany Ma, Rebecca Rouse, and 50+ more. Competitive athletes and researchers, not random influencers.
WHO IT'S FOR
Beginners who want a plan and a gym logger. Intermediate lifters done with spreadsheets. Anyone who wants an AI coach plus a real tracker. Men and women. Full gym, garage gym, or dumbbells at home. 2–6 days per week.
ABOUT
Boostcamp started by putting Reddit’s best programs into a workout tracker that works. 1.3M+ lifters now log training, follow 11,000+ programs, and build custom plans with an AI coach. Free to start. No ads.
Questions? support@boostcamp.app

Global CU
Take advanced control of your finances with enhanced card management, budgeting tools, and the ability to connect your other financial accounts—all in one place. Say hello to your everyday financial app!
• Advanced card controls: Set how, where, and how much your card can be used, online, in-store, contactless, or at ATMs, at home or abroad, with custom spending limits. 
• Merchant controls: See merchants who stored your card for faster checkout and manage recurring payments to spot and cancel unwanted subscriptions. 
• Card security: Instantly lock or unlock your card and set or reset your debit card PIN anytime. 
• Card notifications: Get alerts on card spending and view pending and recent transactions to catch unauthorized charges quickly. 
• Money management: Deposit checks, pay bills, transfer funds between institutions, send money to friends, and track your spending. 
• Direct deposit switch: Set up or switch your paycheck in minutes and get paid up to 3 days sooner with Global's Early Payday. 
• Budgeting and tracking: See where your money goes with personalized budgets and automatic transaction categorization. 
• Stay informed: Set custom alerts for spending, low balances, large deposits or withdrawals, budget overages, and bill and debt payment reminders.

bluejetty:00178831:ios.description:
Time Princess x Mauritshuis, The Hague Collab Returns!
Do you still remember your artistic encounter with the 17th century? Once again, Girl with a Pearl Earring is back, bringing even more masterpieces from the museum's collection. Time Princess invites you to return to 17th century Netherlands and experience the serene beauty of art!
Enter a World of Stories! 
Your grandmother has gone missing, and you have unknowingly activated a magical story desk that grants you the ability to traverse time and space. Learn about a mysterious world, your grandmother's past, a withering goddess' tree, and more. 
Guided by the hand of fate, where will your destination be?
Travel to Versailles and become the legendary Marie Antoinette, quelling the national crisis caused by the "affair of the diamond necklace." Or visit Arabia to summon the fabled genie and fulfill your true wishes. 
You can also appreciate the Rococo art of early 18th-century France, admire the magnificent legends of ancient China, or venture into the future and witness the vastness of time.
Embark on perilous investigations to uncover the truth, compete for glory in the arena, meet the person of your destiny, confront numerous difficult choices, and write your own ending to the story. 
This is a world that belongs to you, Traveler. Come forth and embark on your destined journey!
※Our character creation system offers a diverse range of options, allowing you to create a character that truly represents you. Be whoever you want to be! 
※Collect a ton of outfits of ever-changing styles, ranging from elegant 18th-century Rococo to the captivating styles of Arabia and Egypt. Each story features unique outfit choices, so present your beauty and adorn yourself in clothes befitting your grand destiny!
※Encounter companions and make intense and gripping decisions. The story's conclusion and the characters' destinies will all be shaped by your choices!
※Customize your clothes by choosing from a plethora of patterns, prints, and colors. It's time to showcase your ingenious creativity!
※Meet adorable cats on your travels through time and space. Collect them, and they will help gather materials to make crafting clothes a breeze! 
※Meet and befriend fellow fashion enthusiasts from around the world! Share your wardrobe with them and showcase your creative designs!

Instant stress relief with realistic ASMR slime and sensory textures.

Feelsy is a calming ASMR relaxation app that combines interactive slime simulation, soothing sounds, guided meditation, and sleep sounds to help reduce stress, anxiety, and mental fatigue.
Feelsy transforms your phone into a calming sensory experience with realistic ASMR slime simulations, satisfying textures, relaxing sounds, guided meditation, and sleep sounds designed to help you unwind anytime, anywhere.
Whether you're looking for a stress relief app, anxiety relief tools, calming ASMR sounds, or a relaxing fidget experience, Feelsy helps you slow down, focus on the present moment, and find comfort through soothing sensory interactions.
Stretch slime, pop bubbles, play with satisfying textures, listen to relaxing sounds, and enjoy a peaceful break whenever life feels overwhelming.
► WHY FEELSY IS DIFFERENT
Unlike traditional relaxation apps, Feelsy combines multiple calming experiences in one place.
Enjoy realistic slime simulations, sensory textures, ASMR sounds, guided mindfulness exercises, sleep audio, and anti-stress activities designed to help reduce anxiety and promote emotional well-being.
Whether you're taking a short mental break during a busy workday, relaxing after school, preparing for sleep, or simply looking for a satisfying sensory experience, Feelsy adapts to your needs.
Created for modern lifestyles filled with constant notifications, screen fatigue, and daily stress, Feelsy offers a simple and effective way to relax your mind and recharge.
► KEY FEATURES
- Realistic Slime & Texture Simulation
- Over 80+ anti-stress textures: slimes, fluids, particles, orbs
- Create and customize your own slime
- Pleasant ASMR Sounds
- High-quality satisfying sound effects
- Volume control for a personalized calming experience
- Guided Meditation for Relaxation
- Short guided sessions to reduce anxiety
- Mindfulness exercises to calm racing thoughts
- Relaxing Sleep Sounds
- Sleep sounds to help you fall asleep faster
- White noise and ambient audio for deeper rest
- Daily Stress Relief Tool
► WHO IS FEELSY FOR?
Feelsy is perfect for anyone looking to:
• Relieve stress
• Reduce anxiety
• Improve sleep quality
• Practice mindfulness
• Enjoy ASMR experiences
• Relax after a busy day
• Explore satisfying sensory activities
• Take calming mental breaks
Whether you're at home, at work, traveling, or preparing for bed, Feelsy is always available when you need a moment of calm.
► TAKE A BREAK. RELAX YOUR MIND. FEEL BETTER.
Life can be overwhelming. Sometimes all you need is a few minutes of calm.
Discover a relaxing world of ASMR, sensory play, meditation, sleep sounds, and stress relief.
Designed to support anxiety relief and emotional balance
A simple sensory escape anytime you need to reset
•••Take a break from overthinking.
•••Relax your mind.
•••Sleep better.
Download Feelsy today and turn stress into calm.

KVB - DLite the most comprehensive and secure Mobile Banking application, getting payments done instantly through IMPS, UPI, Bharat QR, FASTag and offers many more s
bluejetty:00065043:ios.description:
KVB DLite is the official mobile banking application of Karur Vysya Bank. 
KVB - DLite the most comprehensive and secure Mobile Banking application, getting payments done instantly through IMPS, UPI, Bharat QR, FASTag and offers many more services at your fingertips.
If you are not an existing KVB customer, you can open a DLite Savings account instantly.
What we offer in KVB – Dlite?
Now manage your financial transactions on the go, transact through, IMPS & UPI. Request for a cheque book, Hotlist debit card, Apply debit card and much more
- Apply for FASTag, recharge on the go and track your payments from Dlite app
- Sit and apply for IPO using e-ASBA
- Add frequently paid Mobile Recharge, DTH payments, TNEB bills and pay by single tap
- Control your Debit Card by setting your own ATM and PoS transaction limit, switching your Debit card transactions On or Off, Set ATM Pin and much more.
- Rewards Redemption and much more services
What do I require for using Mobile banking services?
Just stay relax. All you need is
- Apple iPhone (non Jail-broken device)
- Operative CASA account with KVB
- Active debit card/Internet banking credentials for authentication
- Internet connectivity through Mobile Data/ Wi-Fi
Be cautious: Do not use any other websites/Email links for downloading this application. Download the KVB - DLite & Mobile Banking from the official iOS App store.
For more details visit https://www.kvb.co.in/personal/digital-products/kvb-dlite-mobile-banking/
How to register?
- Download the app from iOS App Store
- Click “Register for Mobile Banking”
- Enter Nickname/Customer id/Reg Mobile number
- Enter the received OTP
- Once validated, authenticate with Debit card/Internet Banking
 - Post Authentication set your 6 digit Login pin & 4 digit mPin
- Once pins are successfully set, you are now ready to use a very Secure, Convenient & User friendly Mobile Banking application.
Note: KVB or its employees do not ask ATM card number/Pin/CVV/OTP and other sensitive information. If any such incident reported, reach our 24* 7 support.
Support 24 X 7: 
Email id: customersupport@kvbmail.com
Toll Number: 18602581916
Apart from the above, KVB - Dlite also empowers you to do much more
- Maximum of 10 users can be added
- Personalize with a selfie picture or choose a favorite image from your mobile gallery.
- View account summary, mini statement and transaction details for all your savings/current, loan and deposit accounts
- Transact upto Rs.50,000/day to other bank accounts without adding beneficiary.
- User specific transfer limits
- Save favorite transactions
- Apply for FASTag
- Pay TNEB bills
- Apply for new debit card, set ATM Pin and control card features
- Check your rewards points 
- Set your card limits or instantly Block card if misplaced or lost
- Select your frequently used options to appear on the main screen
Permissions for App and reasons:
Please note that your data is safe with India’s most secure bank. We do not share any information with third parties without your permission. 
- Contacts: This is required to allow you fetching mobile number while mobile / DTH recharge or sharing IFSC/MMID
- Location: This is required for Branch / ATM locator and FASTag.
- Photos / Media / Files / Camera: This is required to let you access gallery / click an image to set profile picture. 
- Phone: This is required to let you dial customer contact center
- SMS: This is required to verify the customer and mobile number linked to it.
Welcome, you’re all set to explore the new KVB - DLite Mobile Banking Application.

● Quickly view property details, photos, street-view mapping, rental estimates, school information, property tax and price history, auction dates, bid prices and more
● Be the first to see new properties and promotions on Hubzu
● Save your favorite properties and bid directly from your smartphone
● Receive real-time alerts when you’ve been outbid or an auction is ending soon
● Get updates about upcoming auctions and the latest available properties

Using our interactive app, you can quickly view property details, photos, auction dates, bid prices and more. Our smart technology, educational resources and wide selection of properties are just a few of the perks accessible to you on-the-go, wherever you are.
Save and favorite properties you like and receive instant notifications, so you’ll never lose track of your investments. Join us on the Hubzu app now for a better way to bid.
Don't miss out on your next investment opportunity. With the Hubzu app, it's all at your fingertips.

- Your whole home’s hourly energy use data up to the previous day.

- Control compatible smart home devices (lights, thermostats, plugs, etc.) all in one app.

bluejetty:00071486:ios.description:
Control your HomeKit home faster with fully customizable widgets for your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch. Home Widget brings accessories, scenes, groups, sensors, cameras and shortcuts together in panels built around your routines.
LAUNCH HOMEKIT ACTIONS FROM YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Open a compatible gate or garage when you arrive, turn on an accessory or run your Welcome Home scene with one tap on your configured widget.
BUILD YOUR OWN HOME SCREEN CONTROL PANEL
Create a panel, add accessories, scenes, sensors and shortcuts, then place the widget: your dashboard is ready in minutes. Turn a room's lights on or off together, run a shortcut or control several HomeKit homes.
OPEN A CAMERA WITH ONE TAP
See who is at the front door, check the driveway or look in on your pets. A Home Screen or Lock Screen widget opens the selected HomeKit camera or video doorbell in Home Widget. Audio options depend on your camera.
OPEN YOUR CAMERA MOSAIC WITH ONE TAP
Check several cameras on one screen instead of opening them individually. Launch the mosaic from your Home Screen, Lock Screen or Control Center, and choose which cameras to include.
ADJUST LIGHT BRIGHTNESS AND COLOR
Dim the living room for a movie or change the color of a lamp. Use interactive Home Screen controls or open the light control from a Lock Screen widget. Control one light or the lights in a room.
SET BLINDS AND SHADES TO THE POSITION YOU WANT
Let in the morning light or lower your blinds partway for privacy. Open the position control from your Home Screen or Lock Screen instead of settling for fully open or closed.
ADJUST YOUR HOMEKIT THERMOSTAT

bluejetty:00119600:ios.description:
Tookstock is the easiest way to track and reorder inventory. Scan barcodes, add products with AI, track stock levels, manage multiple locations, and reorder supplies — all from your mobile device.
Access your Tookstock account while on the go:
- Add Your Products in Seconds: Skip the manual data entry. Snap a quick photo and let AI fill in the details for you.
