- Multi-Location Tracking: Each site has its own inventory, cart, and history.
- Role-Based Permissions: Invite users with peace of mind using fine-grained permissions controls.
- Custom View Permissions: Restrict users to specific locations or departments.
- Barcodes Made Easy: Scan labels with auto-adjusting counts.
- Real-Time Transfers: Move stock instantly between locations.
- Smart Purchase Workflows: Build carts by location, send P.O.s, and approve purchase requests.
- Mobile + Web Access: Manage everything seamlessly from any device.
- Min/Max Thresholds: Set thresholds to prevent stockouts or over-ordering.
- Organize with Tags: Add custom product categories for faster search.
- Vendor Management: Add vendors, track costs, and reorder from anyone.
- Purchase History: View detailed past orders with cost breakdowns per user and location.
Why Businesses Love It:
No more guesswork, no more wasted time, no more emergency supply runs. Our app gives you control, clarity, and confidence—so your team can focus on serving customers, not chasing parts and supplies.
Download now and take charge of your inventory today.

bluejetty:00069982:ios.description:
Converting images to JPEG and PNG format just got a whole lot simpler!
With ConvertMagic you can select the images you want in JPEG or PNG and convert them with ease.
Some of the cool features of this app include:
- Quick conversion from GIF/PNG/BMP to JPEG.
- The transparent parts in GIF or PNG files will be automatically converted to white.
- Sharing after you've converted your images is really easy, you just have to tap the share button.
- After conversion all your new JPEG/PNG files will be saved to your photos library for easy access.
It's pretty handy for when:
- You have a lot of images you want changed to JPEG or PNG format.
- You need to send an image to a device that only supports JPEG/PNG.
- You want fill the transparent parts of an image file with white.

bluejetty:00166735:ios.name: Backpacker™ Go!
bluejetty:00166735:ios.summary: Pack your bags and get ready to roll the dice! In Backpacker® Go!, you’re not just playing a board game – you’re exploring the world! Kick off your adventure in the iconic cities of New York, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro. Dive into their vibra
bluejetty:00166735:ios.description:
Pack your bags and get ready to roll the dice! In Backpacker® Go!, you’re not just playing a board game – you’re exploring the world! Kick off your adventure in the iconic cities of New York, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro. Dive into their vibrant cultures, uncover fascinating landmarks, and answer trivia questions to learn fun facts. Ready to become a globe-trotter from your couch?
Backpacker® Go! is your ticket to a fun, educational adventure across the globe. Perfect for trivia buffs, travel lovers, and curious minds, this board dice game combines the thrill of exploration with the joy of learning. Roll the dice, embrace the adventure, and become a global trivia master with Backpacker® Go! Download now and start your journey in New York, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro today!
Story and Gameplay
Start your journey in the bustling streets of New York, the romantic avenues of Paris, or the lively beaches of Rio de Janeiro. Every dice roll takes you to a new corner of these incredible cities. Chat with locals, take on trivia challenges, and help with tasks to earn your ticket to the next city. Your knowledge of geography, history, and culture will be your guide as you travel the world!
From Empire state building to the Eiffel Tower, and Christ the Redeemer, each city is packed with exciting trivia and unique quests. Test your smarts, learn amazing facts, and collect cool souvenirs along the way. It’s all about expanding your global knowledge while having a blast!
Features
Explore Famous Cities: Start in New York, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro – with more cities to come!
Trivia Fun: Answer tons of trivia questions about each city’s landmarks, culture, and history.
Interactive Quests: Help locals with their everyday tasks and dive deeper into their lifestyles.
Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning visuals of each city’s most famous spots.
Learn and Play: Perfect for anyone who loves to learn new things while having fun.

bluejetty:00015174:ios.description:
Get the step-by-step horsemanship help you need to get results and build a safe, fun partnership with your horse. 86 hours of free videos! Horse trainer Clinton Anderson is best known for his easy-to-understand teaching style that makes it possible for horsemen of all levels and horses from all disciplines to get results. 
Whether you’re a rank beginner or a professional horseman, you’ll find training tips and inspiration in this easy-to-use app to take your horsemanship to the next level and fine-tune your skills. Retrain a problem horse with dangerous behavior or train a futurity prospect – the Downunder Horsemanship Method will help you achieve your dreams! 
This on-the-go, interactive training tool:
• Provides free access to the Downunder Horsemanship Method, Clinton’s tips and selected full-length training sessions to improve your horsemanship. 
• Connects No Worries Club members to exclusive content, including monthly videos, Q&As with Clinton, the Testing the Method series, forums, and issues of the quarterly No Worries Journal. 
• Allows you to interact with your digital kits and premium content purchased through Downunder Horsemanship. 
Key features of the Downunder Horsemanship app:
• Download videos and training content to access while you’re at the barn or on the trail without eating up your data.
• Bookmark important tips you want to refer back to.
• Take notes while watching the Fundamentals Series videos. 
• Use integrated links within the app to always stay connected to Downunder Horsemanship’s events and news and updates. 
The app will continually be updated with new and helpful video tutorials and content.

bluejetty:00069422:ios.description:

After that battle with Bo-Peep in the toy world, many things happened and very strange things happened trying to rescue Santa and my father, many scary stories, scary fights, unexpected scares... but all that happened.

I think I'll go back to that cursed cabin in the woods and find out what strange spirits are clouding this poor woman's soul.
Emily, it is time to pay you a visit.

bluejetty:00136237:ios.description:
First Stop Health. Care that people love.
First Stop Health gives employees virtual access to a board-certified physician 24/7 for diagnosis and treatment of illnesses including infections (e.g. sinus, eye, ear or skin), sore throat, women’s health issues, and medication refills.
Getting a phone or video consultation with a doctor is quick and easy with the First Stop Health app. Simply confirm the information provided by your employer and answer a few diagnostic questions and you’ll be connected with one of our doctors. Wait times are usually in less than 5 minutes, and prescriptions can be ready in less than an hour. Our app also allows employees to download sick notes, review consultation details, and contact our support team.
First Stop Health is available exclusively to our client's employees as an employee benefit - consultation fees vary depending on your health plan. Most members have access with no copay or consultation fee.
Pre-registration is not required.
Download the app today and talk to a First Stop Health physician via phone or video in minutes.
Health App integration is available as an option for blood pressure and weight to provide doctors with valuable data to support patients requested diagnosis and triage. This data is used for diagnostic and quality assurance purposes only.

bluejetty:00029567:ios.name: Monster Country Idle Tycoon
bluejetty:00029567:ios.summary: Build a spooky town where monsters run the shops! Monster Country Idle Tycoon is an idle tycoon game that combines town building, monster collecting and a humorous story. Recruit unusual shopkeepers, automate your shops and turn a forgotten
bluejetty:00029567:ios.description:
Build a spooky town where monsters run the shops! Monster Country Idle Tycoon is an idle tycoon game that combines town building, monster collecting and a humorous story. Recruit unusual shopkeepers, automate your shops and turn a forgotten town into a growing monster empire.
Enjoy idle games and tycoon games? Put your monsters to work in a town full of strange food, quirky craftspeople and spooky surprises. Upgrade shops, collect idle cash and reinvest your in-game profits. An evil governor and her cronies want to stand in your way. Give them a town they cannot ignore!
BUILD YOUR MONSTER TOWN
Start small and develop your town one shop at a time. Open businesses, improve your operations and work toward your next expansion. Turn a quiet corner of the monster world into a destination that visitors will want to explore.
Combine town building with the steady progress of idle tycoon games. Choose where to invest your earnings and develop the shops that keep your town running. Your monsters are not just here to scare the neighbors. They have customers to serve and an empire to grow.
COLLECT MONSTERS AND DISCOVER THEIR STORIES
Unlock unique monster characters and meet the personalities behind your growing town. Train your monsters, upgrade your characters and build a community of unusual shopkeepers. Each new face adds more character to your spooky empire.
Follow a playful story full of funny monsters and unexpected trouble. Get to know the residents as you develop their shops and help your town grow. This is a monster game about putting your characters to work, not sending them into battle.
AUTOMATE YOUR SHOPS AND EARN IDLE CASH
Recruit monster managers to automate your operations. Meet each shop's requirements to automate it, then focus on upgrades without constant tapping. Let your monsters handle the work as you plan your next investment.
Your automated shops keep earning between sessions. Return to collect your idle money, check your progress and choose the next improvement. Enjoy the relaxed rhythm of idle games without having to spend the whole day tapping.
UPGRADE YOUR TOWN AND GROW YOUR EMPIRE
Make your next investment count. Upgrade shops, develop your characters and put your in-game money into improvements that help your town grow. Turn small earnings into bigger upgrades and keep building your monster empire.
Enjoy idle clicker games? Play actively with optional tapping, or leave the operations to your monster managers. Whether you prefer quick check-ins or spending time on your next upgrade, you can build at your own pace.
TAKE ON THE EVIL GOVERNOR
Not everyone is pleased to see your monster community thrive. An evil governor and her cronies have plans of their own. Follow the story as you expand your town and work toward taking them down.
Bring a story-driven twist to tycoon games with a cast of bizarre shopkeepers and quirky craftspeople. Keep your town growing, discover what happens next and prove that your monsters have more to offer than a good scare.
PLAY THEMED EVENTS AND CHALLENGES
Explore limited-time events alongside your main town. Compete against other players, work toward rewards and put your management skills to use on new goals. Earn achievements and enjoy another reason to return.
Love the playful atmosphere of Halloween games? Keep the spooky fun going with a town full of unusual characters. From the next shop upgrade to another event challenge, there is more to explore in your idle monster adventure.
BUILD YOUR OWN MONSTER EMPIRE
From your first shop to a thriving town, every upgrade is part of a bigger plan. Monster Country combines the progress of idle tycoon games with monster collecting, shop management and a humorous story.
Recruit your monsters, automate your shops and grow your town in Monster Country Idle Tycoon!
Got ideas or issues? Contact us at scare.idle@kanoapps.com
Playing Monster Country Idle Tycoon requires an internet connection.

bluejetty:00019469:ios.description:
We never interrupt your thinking!
There are no full-screen or video ads—only a small banner at the bottom of the screen.
There are no in-app purchases either. You can enjoy every single puzzle, from easy to extreme, completely free of charge.
## The Ultimate Minimalist Sudoku
A pure Sudoku experience where you can fully immerse yourself in the classic number puzzle!
No unnecessary features! We removed daily challenges, achievements, annoying notifications, and long tutorials.
## Play Anytime, Anywhere
Perfect for your daily commute, waiting times, or relaxing before bed. Enjoy at your own pace!
100% playable offline. All features are available even without an internet connection.
## User-Friendly Design for All Ages
A clean, purple-themed UI that is easy on the eyes. With large numbers and intuitive controls, it is comfortable for everyone from beginners to seniors.
## 2,000+ Puzzles & Multiple Difficulties
- Easy: Perfect for beginners learning the basic rules.
- Medium: Standard puzzles that require a bit more thought.
- Hard: Challenging puzzles requiring advanced logical thinking.
- Extreme: A true challenge for Sudoku masters.
With over 2,000 puzzles included, you can enjoy endless hours of brain-teasing fun!
## Train Your Logical Thinking
Every puzzle is mathematically verified to be solvable by pure logic alone—no guessing required.
Great brain training to improve your concentration, memory, and cognitive skills!
## The Culmination of Our Series
From a series with over 1,000,000 total downloads!
We have combined our previous 5-color apps (Red, Blue, Green, Orange, Purple) into this single, definitive purple edition.
## Classic Sudoku Rules
- Fill each column with numbers 1-9.
- Fill each row with numbers 1-9.
- Fill each 3x3 block with numbers 1-9.
## Helpful Features
• Pen Mode: Enter your final answers.
• Pencil Mode: Take notes for candidate numbers.
• Undo/Redo: Easily fix any mistakes.
• Eraser: Clear a selected cell instantly.
## A Stress-Free Experience
- No penalties: Make a mistake? No problem, there are no game overs.
- Banner ads only: No intrusive ads to disrupt your focus.
- All puzzles are unlocked from the start.
- All features are available immediately.
Highly recommended for those who want to enjoy pure Sudoku without any stress.
The definitive minimalist Sudoku app, perfect for your daily brain training!

bluejetty:00087561:ios.description:
Cards Online, Your Way
Let the fun begin. Play the games you love with friends and family or get matched with other live players at your level. Trickster Cards offers customizable rules, so you can play cards your way!

Friends and Family Included

Play Across Devices
Have an iPhone, but your friends don’t? No problem. Trickster Cards works on more devices so you and your friends can play where you want, when you want, with whom you want. Great on phones, tablets, laptops and desktops!
Fast and Friendly Chat
Express reactions quickly using chat presets. Focus on the game without the distraction of off-topic comments. Then socialize with full chat after the game. Or set up a private game with friends to use full chat anytime — even add live video chat!

"It looks great, it controls wonderfully, and it's got a cheeky sense
bluejetty:00182719:ios.description:
An ordinary guy forced to defend the world from an alien invasion of infectious zombies. A point-and-click adventure with beautiful pixel art and bombastic retro sound. 
"It looks great, it controls wonderfully, and it's got a cheeky sense of humor" - Pocket Gamer: 8/10
"Without a doubt a graveyard smash" - Keen Gamer: 8/10
Featured in App Store section "New Games We Love".
Top 100 of App Store games in 15 countries!
The Gameplay
Gameplay is similar to old games like Maniac Mansion, Zac McKraken, Beneath A Steel Sky and Monkey Island, but the game has a unique interface that is optimized for touch. Unlike most other point-and-click adventures the player actually holds the current item in his hand.
The Graphics
All handcrafted pixel art.
The Music
All game music only uses original Commodore C64 SID chip sounds, but polyphonic and with professional effects. The main theme of the Paul Pixel game was composed by the Pixel Lover Orchestra and is called "They Want To Get Us". Other chiptune highlights are "The Awakening" by the underground duo Retro Arcade Boys and "The Giant Meteor" by 8-Bit Factory.
The Story
An average guy called Paul Pixel discovers that the part of the city where he lives was put in quarantine. Apparently there has been a zombie outbreak. He needs to get out...
Of course, a short time later he needs to save the whole earth from this zombie apocalypse.
Playtime: 2.5 - 3 hours
Supported Languages
English, German, French, Russian, Italian, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America).

bluejetty:00023854:ios.description:
[A Refreshingly Simple Puzzle & Island Renovation Game]
Work has begun again on the mysterious Mystic Islands!
Complete colorful match 3 puzzles to fix up dilapidated islands alongside cute characters!
A fun story and lovable characters full of personality await!
◆A puzzle and management sim perfect for those who:
・Love sim games
・Love simple puzzle games
・Love cute characters
・Love renovating
・Love free games
◆Story
You're unexpectedly approached by a mysterious cat-like figure called Meowlin.
"Greetings. Welcome to the Mystic Islands.
I'm certain you will find everything you're looking for here.
Make yourself at home, hehehe..."
You arrive on a dilapidated island.
"I heard someone was coming to work part time. It's you, right?
The name's Purrcy. I'm the manager of the Mystic Islands."
Before you appears a cute kitten-like figure named Purrcy.
"Your job is easy! You've just gotta renovate this island.
If you don't do your job well, you can't go back alive.
Heheh."
Who is this mysterious Meowlin and his (her?) cute manager Purrcy?
What are these strange, dilapidated islands?
Unravel the mysteries of the Mystic Islands, meet cute characters, and experience an entertaining story full of dark humor and touching episodes!
[Puzzles]
◆A match 3 puzzle using colorful pieces.
・Just move the pieces around and line up 3 of the same ones!
・It's a simple match 3 puzzle game that anyone can pick up and play.
◆Try out lots of different stages!
Face a variety of interference mechanics! Pick up tons of coins from bonus stages!
Whether you're a match 3 puzzle beginner or veteran, take on one fun puzzle stage after the next!
◆Experience the thrill of matching booster pieces!
Match booster pieces together to change them into a special booster!
Use this to take out a group of pieces on the puzzle stage all at once!
[Renovation]
◆Renovate the islands with unique decorations!
Use Stars obtained from puzzle stages to renovate the islands and make them a relaxing paradise!
Complete renovations to get rewards like coins and items!
◆There are many islands waiting to be renovated.
A summer island, an island of toys, a snowy island, and more just waiting to be discovered!
Even more islands will be added in future updates!

bluejetty:00174859:ios.name: Live Home 3D Pro: House Design
bluejetty:00174859:ios.summary:
An outstanding home design app that can turn anyone into a designer. Create detailed floor plan layouts, 3D home design visualizations, plan a garden and work with the surrounding landscape—everything is possible with Live Home 3D Pro.
Flo
bluejetty:00174859:ios.description:
An outstanding home design app that can turn anyone into a designer. Create detailed floor plan layouts, 3D home design visualizations, plan a garden and work with the surrounding landscape—everything is possible with Live Home 3D Pro.
Floor Plans, Building and Terrain: 
• Сreate detailed 2D floor plan layouts. 
• View real-time dimensions for walls, ceilings and floors when drawing in the 2D Plan view.
• Get unlimited floor levels: you will be able to create multi-story buildings and even skyscrapers.
• Design from scratch or rely on ready-made house and interior design samples (e.g., kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms, etc).
• Work with terrain editing tools for landscape design: create elaborate terrain around your house, lay paths and driveways and plan out your garden or backyard.
• Choose from the ready-made roof templates (12 roofs and 16 dormers) or customize the roof by editing its segments to create roofs of any form and complexity. 
• Work in 2D Elevation view that displays the side view on walls and roof, a perfect tool for working with openings, niches and wall panels. 
• Scan your room or house using the Room Scanner feature based on LiDAR technology to recreate its digital copy (only for devices with LiDAR sensors built-in).
• Use a multi-purpose Building Block tool to create porches, custom columns, beams or even furniture.
• Bosch laser measure integration: take accurate measurements with a laser measure, and easily transfer and apply them to objects.
Objects and Materials: 
• Add and move furniture and other objects (5,000+ items), and apply physically based materials (3,000+ supplied materials). 
• Access thousands of free models that can be imported from the Trimble 3D Warehouse and Sketchfab.
• Import 3D models from other applications in most popular formats (COLLADA, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, 3DS, glTF / glb, etc.)
• Create sophisticated custom materials, and control their texture and light emissive properties using the Material Editor. 
Lighting Settings: 
• Work with natural lighting by setting up true geolocation, time of day and cloudiness.
• Adjust light fixtures throughout the house to achieve a realistic lighting scene.
• Create custom lamps or achieve the best lighting for your projects with Light Source Editor.
Viewing and Sharing Your Project:
• Walk through your 3D interior designs.
• Project your 3D home into real-world surroundings, and even walk around or inside the house using View in the AR option.
• Create flyover videos and 3D renderings of your projects from different angles.
• Seamlessly share your projects among iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, macOS or Windows devices.
Export:
• Export 2D floor plans as PDF and 3D views of your projects as high-resolution images.
• Export the entire house design or several objects to USDZ, glTF, SCN, SCNZ, FBX or OBJ format.
• Get highly realistic views of your designs with the Cycles offline rendering engine (unlimited number of renders at no extra cost).
• Export fast and high quality AI renders of your designs: choose from a multitude of presets and adjust simple settings.
• Get Ultra HD export quality for movies and 360° Panoramas and Hi-res (16,000 x 16,000) for still shots.
• Create Stereo 3D Video, 360° Video, Stereo 3D 360° Video and 360° Panorama JPEG images.
Note: Starting with Live Home 3D version 5.0, you can create an app account and link all your in-app purchases to it, sharing them across all available platforms without re-buying.

apple-macos:6758967337.description:
Vox.md is a local-first quick capture app for Obsidian vaults and Markdown folders. Send text, links, photos, files, document scans, sketches, and voice to the right note without stopping to organize first.
CAPTURE MORE THAN VOICE
Add typed Markdown, a URL, photos or screenshots, files, a document scanner with on-device OCR, a sketch, or a voice recording. Combine several items in one capture, preview the result, then save it as plain Markdown.
SEND IT WHERE IT BELONGS
Capture Presets remember the destination and formatting for workflows such as your inbox, journal, task list, or meeting notes. Create a note, append or prepend to an existing file, insert beneath a heading, or write to rolling daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly notes.
Each preset can keep its own template, metadata, attachment folder, filename rules, placement, and processing preferences. Override a destination or template for one capture without changing the preset.
CAPTURE FROM MORE PLACES
Use Vox.md from the app, Share Sheet, custom keyboard, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Shortcuts, or Apple Watch. Pending and failed deliveries remain available for retry, so a temporary folder permission or sync issue does not lose your work.
PRIVATE VOICE TRANSCRIPTION
Transcribe speech into text on your device with Apple Speech, Whisper, or Parakeet, depending on your settings and device. Audio and transcripts are never sent to Vox.md servers. Use offline dictation and voice typing from the custom keyboard, record on Apple Watch, or export transcripts as TXT, Markdown, JSON, or YAML.
PLAIN FILES, NO LOCK-IN
Vox.md writes standard Markdown to the folders and Obsidian vaults you choose. You do not need an account or a proprietary notes database. Your files remain readable in any Markdown app.
New Capture and transcription require paid access. Choose Individual or Family: weekly, yearly, or lifetime. Eligible subscriptions include a seven-day free trial, then renew automatically at the displayed price until canceled in Apple Account settings. Existing purchases remain valid. Viewing and exporting existing history require no new purchase.
PRIVACY
Capture contents are processed on your device and saved or sent only to destinations you explicitly configure. This version removes custom app usage analytics and advertising attribution. Optional HTTP delivery sends the capture payload to your chosen endpoint; model downloads, quotes, and other connected features are described in the Privacy Policy. Permissions are requested for the capture features you choose. Earlier versions and retained service records are covered separately.

apple-macos:6761168281.name: Cinely: AI Movie & Music Video
apple-macos:6761168281.description:
Cinely turns an idea into a film.
Type one line, or paste a whole script. Pick a genre, cast your characters, and Cinely shoots it — scene by scene, with dialogue, subtitles and sound. Up to 100 scenes, about 13 minutes, in Standard or Cinematic quality.
ALREADY HAVE A SONG?
Upload your MP3 — a track you recorded, or one you made with an AI music app — pick a character, and get its music video: the full song, scenes that match it, and the character singing it on camera. Not a lyric video or a visualizer: a real music video for your own song.
ONE APP, TWELVE WAYS TO TELL IT
• Movie — from one idea or a full script, kept word for word
• Music video — upload your own song or describe one; the whole track, scenes that match it, and the character sings it on camera
• Trailer — cut from your movie or made from a logline, with title cards and a score
• Ad video — a 15 to 60 second ad from a few product photos
• Story — a fable or bedtime story read by a narrator, with the moral at the end
• Comic — manga, webtoon or classic comic pages, with the speech bubbles lettered in
• Kids lesson — a short educational cartoon your child can star in
• Video greeting — a birthday, holiday or wedding message said on camera by a character who looks like you
• Explainer video — any topic as a narrated video with the key facts on screen
• Social video — TikTok, Reels and Shorts clips with the hook, captions and post text written for you
• UGC video — an AI creator holds your product and talks to the camera
• Movie script — paste a screenplay and get the whole film
TELL THE AGENT
Describe what you want in the chat. The Agent writes the scenes and the characters with you and shows the full cost before anything is made. Chatting is free; credits are only used when you confirm. Afterwards, ask it to fix a subtitle, change the cover, rename the film or remake a scene in Cinematic.
THE SAME FACE IN EVERY SCENE
Create a character once — from a photo of yourself or a description — and keep the same look across every scene and every episode. 30 narrator voices and 17 languages.
TURN IT INTO A SERIES
One film is a start. Build a multi-episode series, keep the same cast and the same world, and give people a reason to come back.
REMIX, OR START FROM A TEMPLATE
Swipe through films in Explore and tap Remix to make your own version. Or pick a ready-made story and make it yours without writing a prompt.
WATCH, NOT JUST MAKE
Browse short AI films and series from creators all over the world — fantasy, romance, comedy, horror, sci-fi — and follow the channels you like.
PUBLISH AND EARN
Open your own channel and publish your series. When viewers unlock your episodes, you earn credits — put them straight back into the next film.
CREDITS EVERY DAY
Daily check-in and challenges hand you credits for creating, sharing and watching, so there is always something left for the next idea.
Cinely is for anyone with a story and no crew.
Privacy Policy: https://www.cinelyai.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.cinelyai.com/terms

Save the text you use again and again. Snippeta keeps your replies, links, email templates, and prompts organized and ready to copy or paste.
COPY AND PASTE FASTER
- Copy a saved snippet with one tap.
- Paste saved text using the Snippeta keyboard in apps that support custom keyboards.
- Reach your snippets from Home Screen widgets.
- Search titles and content to find what you need.
KEEP YOUR TEXT ORGANIZED
- Create groups and arrange snippets your way.
- Write and edit snippets up to 5,000 characters long.
- Save snippets on your device, including for offline use.
- Export and import library backups.
- Choose themes and light or dark appearance.
SNIPPETA PRO
An optional subscription unlocks cloud sync and backup, access to your cloud snippets on multiple devices, nested groups, and Pro themes. Cloud features require an account.
Designed for iPhone and iPad, with improved full-width layouts for both iPhone Duo displays.
